items.translation: Tekan betul-betul di belakang fret dengan tekanan biasa dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.key: Lengthen the string: move its saddle away from the neck.
items.source: Lengthen the string: move its saddle away from the neck.
items.translation: Panjangkan tali: gerakkan pelananya menjauhi leher.

items.key: Shorten the string: move its saddle toward the neck.
items.source: Shorten the string: move its saddle toward the neck.
items.translation: Pendekkan tali: gerakkan pelananya ke arah leher.

items.context: A word every language translates: the system face, at `.caption2` like the names.

items.key: +%lld BPM every %lld bars up to %lld BPM
items.source: +%lld BPM every %lld bars up to %lld BPM

items.key: Every note is part of a hidden tune
items.source: Every note is part of a hidden tune
items.translation: Setiap not ialah sebahagian daripada melodi tersembunyi

items.key: Hold inside the green ring for a bullseye
items.source: Hold inside the green ring for a bullseye
items.translation: Kekal dalam gelang hijau untuk mendapat bullseye

items.key: Hit %lld bullseyes to win the round.
items.source: Hit %lld bullseyes to win the round.

items.context: The metronome, drone, chords, scales and ear games: practice, not a game controller's "Play".

items.key: Hear two notes. Name the gap.
items.source: Hear two notes. Name the gap.

items.key: Whole neck · pick a position to focus on
items.source: Whole neck · pick a position to focus on
items.translation: Seluruh leher · pilih kedudukan untuk difokuskan

items.source: Choose a comfortable note, listen to it, then sing it.
items.translation: Pilih not yang selesa, dengar, kemudian nyanyikannya.

items.source: Audio is analysed on this device. Only a practice summary is saved.
items.translation: Audio dianalisis pada peranti ini. Hanya ringkasan latihan disimpan.

items.source: Keep the note comfortable. Stop if your voice feels strained.
items.translation: Pastikan not selesa dinyanyikan. Berhenti jika suara anda terasa tegang.

items.key: Your comfortable range today. A description, not a classification.
items.source: Your comfortable range today. A description, not a classification.
items.translation: Julat selesa anda hari ini. Ini penerangan, bukan pengelasan.

items.source: No reliable range yet. Try two comfortable notes.
items.translation: Belum ada julat yang boleh dipercayai. Cuba dua not yang selesa.

items.context: Ear and games

items.key: Play a lesson or tune up on a few days: notes on your timing, chords and strings show up here.
items.source: Play a lesson or tune up on a few days: notes on your timing, chords and strings show up here.
items.translation: Mainkan pelajaran atau tala pada beberapa hari: catatan tentang pemasaan, kord dan tali anda akan muncul di sini.

items.key: Your notes sat about %lld ms behind the click. Play along with the metronome at %lld BPM and land right on it.
items.source: Your notes sat about %lld ms behind the click. Play along with the metronome at %lld BPM and land right on it.
items.translation: Not anda kira-kira %lld ms selepas klik. Main bersama metronom pada %lld BPM dan pastikan not tepat pada klik.

items.key: Your notes ran about %lld ms ahead of the click. Play with the metronome at %lld BPM and let each beat come to you.
items.source: Your notes ran about %lld ms ahead of the click. Play with the metronome at %lld BPM and let each beat come to you.
items.translation: Not anda kira-kira %lld ms mendahului klik. Main dengan metronom pada %lld BPM dan tunggu setiap detik.

items.key: %lld%%, but only below the lesson tempo, so two stars. One take at the full %lld BPM earns the third.
items.source: %lld%%, but only below the lesson tempo, so two stars. One take at the full %lld BPM earns the third.
items.translation: %lld%%, tetapi hanya di bawah tempo pelajaran, jadi dua bintang. Satu cubaan pada tempo penuh %lld BPM memperoleh bintang ketiga.

items.key: Your play-along came in at %lld%%. Three stars need %lld%% on it.
items.source: Your play-along came in at %lld%%. Three stars need %lld%% on it.
items.translation: Permainan bersama anda mencapai %lld%%. Tiga bintang memerlukan %lld%%.

items.key: Clean run: %lld of %lld at 90%% or better. Nothing slipped.
items.source: Clean run: %lld of %lld at 90%% or better. Nothing slipped.
items.translation: Pusingan bersih: %lld daripada %lld pada 90%% atau lebih. Tiada yang tersasar.

items.key: Your %@ string drifts %lld¢ flat a day. Time for new strings; until then, tune up before you play.
items.source: Your %@ string drifts %lld¢ flat a day. Time for new strings; until then, tune up before you play.
items.translation: Pic tali %@ anda turun %lld¢ sehari. Sudah tiba masanya untuk tali baharu; sementara itu, tala sebelum bermain.

items.key: Your %@ string drifts %lld¢ sharp a day. Tune up before you play, and check it is wound firmly at the peg.
items.source: Your %@ string drifts %lld¢ sharp a day. Tune up before you play, and check it is wound firmly at the peg.
items.translation: Pic tali %@ anda naik %lld¢ sehari. Tala sebelum bermain, dan pastikan lilitannya pada pasak kukuh.

items.key: Your strings went on %lld weeks ago. A fresh set holds its tune and sounds brighter.
items.source: Your strings went on %lld weeks ago. A fresh set holds its tune and sounds brighter.
items.translation: Tali anda dipasang %lld minggu lalu. Set baharu mengekalkan tala dan berbunyi lebih cerah.

items.key: Your %lld-day streak is still on. A one-minute tune-up keeps it going.
items.source: Your %lld-day streak is still on. A one-minute tune-up keeps it going.
items.translation: Rentetan %lld hari anda masih berterusan. Penalaan seminit mengekalkannya.

items.key: %lld of %lld done today. Next up: %@, about %lld min.
items.source: %lld of %lld done today. Next up: %@, about %lld min.
items.translation: %lld daripada %lld selesai hari ini. Seterusnya: %@, kira-kira %lld min.

items.key: %lld minutes this week, %lld%% more than last week. That is how it sticks.
items.source: %lld minutes this week, %lld%% more than last week. That is how it sticks.
items.translation: %lld minit minggu ini, %lld%% lebih daripada minggu lalu. Begitulah kemahiran kekal.

items.key: Your tune-ups land within ±%@¢ now, down from ±%@¢ a few weeks ago.
items.source: Your tune-ups land within ±%@¢ now, down from ±%@¢ a few weeks ago.
items.translation: Penalaan anda kini dalam lingkungan ±%@¢, berkurang daripada ±%@¢ beberapa minggu lalu.

items.key: %@ → %@ didn’t land (%lld of %lld). Practice the change at %lld BPM until your hand knows the way.
items.source: %@ → %@ didn’t land (%lld of %lld). Practice the change at %lld BPM until your hand knows the way.
items.translation: %@ → %@ tidak tepat (%lld daripada %lld). Latih pertukaran pada %lld BPM sehingga tangan anda biasa dengan gerakannya.

items.key: %@ → %@ didn’t land (%lld of %lld). Practice the move at %lld BPM until your hand knows the way.
items.source: %@ → %@ didn’t land (%lld of %lld). Practice the move at %lld BPM until your hand knows the way.
items.translation: %@ → %@ tidak tepat (%lld daripada %lld). Latih gerakan pada %lld BPM sehingga tangan anda biasa dengan gerakannya.

items.key: %@ → %@ was %lld ms late on beat %lld. Practice the change at %lld BPM until it lands.
items.source: %@ → %@ was %lld ms late on beat %lld. Practice the change at %lld BPM until it lands.
items.translation: %@ → %@ lewat %lld ms pada detik %lld. Latih pertukaran pada %lld BPM sehingga tepat.

items.key: %@ → %@ was %lld ms late on beat %lld. Practice the move at %lld BPM until it lands.
items.source: %@ → %@ was %lld ms late on beat %lld. Practice the move at %lld BPM until it lands.
items.translation: %@ → %@ lewat %lld ms pada detik %lld. Latih gerakan pada %lld BPM sehingga tepat.

items.key: %@ → %@ came in %lld ms early on beat %lld. Practice the change at %lld BPM and wait for the click.
items.source: %@ → %@ came in %lld ms early on beat %lld. Practice the change at %lld BPM and wait for the click.
items.translation: %@ → %@ awal %lld ms pada detik %lld. Latih pertukaran pada %lld BPM dan tunggu klik.

items.key: %@ → %@ came in %lld ms early on beat %lld. Practice the move at %lld BPM and wait for the click.
items.source: %@ → %@ came in %lld ms early on beat %lld. Practice the move at %lld BPM and wait for the click.
items.translation: %@ → %@ awal %lld ms pada detik %lld. Latih gerakan pada %lld BPM dan tunggu klik.

items.key: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms late on beat %lld. Land that change right on the click.
items.source: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms late on beat %lld. Land that change right on the click.
items.translation: Tahap seterusnya: %@ → %@ lewat %lld ms pada detik %lld. Pastikan pertukaran tepat pada klik.

items.key: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms late on beat %lld. Land that move right on the click.
items.source: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms late on beat %lld. Land that move right on the click.
items.translation: Tahap seterusnya: %@ → %@ lewat %lld ms pada detik %lld. Pastikan gerakan tepat pada klik.

items.key: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms early on beat %lld. Let that change wait for the click.
items.source: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms early on beat %lld. Let that change wait for the click.
items.translation: Tahap seterusnya: %@ → %@ awal %lld ms pada detik %lld. Tunggu klik sebelum bertukar.

items.key: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms early on beat %lld. Let that move wait for the click.
items.source: Next level: %@ → %@ came %lld ms early on beat %lld. Let that move wait for the click.
items.translation: Tahap seterusnya: %@ → %@ awal %lld ms pada detik %lld. Tunggu klik sebelum bergerak.

items.key: A few minutes of the drill will steady them.
items.source: A few minutes of the drill will steady them.

items.key: A few minutes of the drill will steady it.
items.source: A few minutes of the drill will steady it.

items.key: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but chords are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.source: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but chords are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.translation: Anda menguasai %@ (%lld%%), tetapi kord ialah kelemahan anda (%lld%%).

items.key: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but single notes are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.source: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but single notes are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.translation: Anda menguasai %@ (%lld%%), tetapi not tunggal ialah kelemahan anda (%lld%%).

items.key: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but rhythm is your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.source: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but rhythm is your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.translation: Anda menguasai %@ (%lld%%), tetapi irama ialah kelemahan anda (%lld%%).

items.key: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but ear questions are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.source: You nail %@ (%lld%%), but ear questions are your weak spot (%lld%%).
items.translation: Anda menguasai %@ (%lld%%), tetapi soalan pendengaran ialah kelemahan anda (%lld%%).

items.key: Each string’s drift, in cents a day.
items.source: Each string’s drift, in cents a day.
items.context: The coach card already says it, with its tune-up: here the chart speaks for itself.
items.translation: Perubahan pic setiap tali, dalam sen sehari.

items.key: Your %@ string drifts %@ about %lld¢ a day.
items.source: Your %@ string drifts %@ about %lld¢ a day.
items.context: ¢, as the coach above it says it ("drifts 7¢ flat a day").
items.translation: Pic tali %@ anda menyimpang %@ sebanyak kira-kira %lld¢ sehari.

items.context: ¢, as the coach above it says it ("drifts 7¢ flat a day").
¢, as the coach above it says it ("drifts 7¢ flat a day").

items.key: Your strings are holding their pitch well.
items.source: Your strings are holding their pitch well.
items.translation: Tali anda mengekalkan pic dengan baik.

items.key: Tune on a few different days and Timbre learns how each string drifts.
items.source: Tune on a few different days and Timbre learns how each string drifts.
items.translation: Tala pada beberapa hari berbeza dan Timbre mempelajari perubahan pic setiap tali.

items.context: The one placeholder for a value not measured yet, as everywhere in the app.

items.key: Tune a few times to see how close you land.
items.source: Tune a few times to see how close you land.
items.translation: Tala beberapa kali untuk melihat sejauh mana ketepatan anda.

items.key: Lower is closer. Measured on stable readings only.
items.source: Lower is closer. Measured on stable readings only.
items.translation: Lebih rendah, lebih tepat. Diukur daripada bacaan stabil sahaja.

items.key: See how close you land, session after session, with Timbre Pro.
items.source: See how close you land, session after session, with Timbre Pro.
items.translation: Lihat sejauh mana ketepatan anda, sesi demi sesi, dengan Timbre Pro.

items.key: Your sessions appear here after your first tune-up.
items.source: Your sessions appear here after your first tune-up.
items.translation: Sesi anda muncul di sini selepas penalaan pertama.

items.key: Move each string in semitones, up to an octave either way. Tap a string to hear it.
items.source: Move each string in semitones, up to an octave either way. Tap a string to hear it.
items.translation: Ubah pic setiap tali mengikut semiton, sehingga satu oktaf ke atas atau ke bawah. Ketik tali untuk mendengarnya.

items.key: %lld instruments, each on its own live stage
items.source: %lld instruments, each on its own live stage
items.translation: %lld alat muzik, setiap satu di pentas langsung sendiri

items.context: The every-song shelf reads "All", as the Songs tab's first chip.
"Chromatic / reference pitch" in every locale: the header keeps the first half.

items.key: A strobe tuner for any note: voice, piano, winds or anything else.
items.source: A strobe tuner for any note: voice, piano, winds or anything else.
items.translation: Penala strob untuk apa-apa not: suara, piano, alat tiup atau apa-apa yang lain.

items.key: Apple Music isn't available in this version of Timbre.
items.source: Apple Music isn't available in this version of Timbre.
items.translation: Apple Music tidak tersedia dalam versi Timbre ini.

items.key: Open the Music app once to accept Apple Music's privacy terms, then try again.
items.source: Open the Music app once to accept Apple Music's privacy terms, then try again.
items.translation: Buka app Muzik sekali untuk menerima terma privasi Apple Music, kemudian cuba lagi.

items.key: Sign in to Apple Music in Settings, then try again.
items.source: Sign in to Apple Music in Settings, then try again.
items.translation: Daftar masuk ke Apple Music dalam Seting, kemudian cuba lagi.

items.key: Timbre isn't allowed to use Apple Music. You can allow it in Settings.
items.source: Timbre isn't allowed to use Apple Music. You can allow it in Settings.
items.translation: Timbre tidak dibenarkan menggunakan Apple Music. Anda boleh membenarkannya dalam Seting.

items.key: Apple Music couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.
items.source: Apple Music couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.
items.translation: Apple Music tidak dapat dihubungi. Cuba lagi sebentar nanti.

items.context: Apple Music's name as Apple writes it (never in capitals).

items.key: Find this song on Apple Music
items.source: Find this song on Apple Music
items.translation: Cari lagu ini di Apple Music

items.key: Plays in Apple Music for subscribers, separate from the chart.
items.source: Plays in Apple Music for subscribers, separate from the chart.
items.translation: Dimainkan dalam Apple Music untuk pelanggan, berasingan daripada carta.

items.key: Listening needs an Apple Music subscription.
items.source: Listening needs an Apple Music subscription.
items.translation: Untuk mendengar, langganan Apple Music diperlukan.
Timbre tidak dapat memainkan rakaman ini.

items.key: An audio file of your own. Timbre plays it, and once you sync it the chart follows along.
items.source: An audio file of your own. Timbre plays it, and once you sync it the chart follows along.
items.translation: Fail audio milik anda sendiri. Timbre memainkannya, dan selepas anda menyegerakkannya, carta akan mengikut rakaman.

items.key: Tap Sync, then tap along once: from then on the chart follows this recording.
items.source: Tap Sync, then tap along once: from then on the chart follows this recording.
items.translation: Ketik Segerakkan, kemudian ketik mengikut lagu sekali: selepas itu carta mengikut rakaman ini.

items.key: Tap as each chord comes in
items.source: Tap as each chord comes in

items.key: Type or paste the words under Text, then come back to put chords on them.
items.source: Type or paste the words under Text, then come back to put chords on them.
items.translation: Taip atau tampal lirik di bawah Teks, kemudian kembali untuk meletakkan kord padanya.

items.key: Tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.source: Tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.translation: Ketik perkataan untuk meletakkan kord padanya.

items.key: Chords go in brackets just before their word: [G]Amazing [C]grace. {start_of_chorus} and {end_of_chorus} mark a chorus.
items.source: Chords go in brackets just before their word: [G]Amazing [C]grace. {start_of_chorus} and {end_of_chorus} mark a chorus.
items.translation: Letakkan kord dalam kurungan siku tepat sebelum perkataannya: [G]Amazing [C]grace. {start_of_chorus} dan {end_of_chorus} menandakan korus.

items.key: The chart and the recording you added go from this iPhone.
items.source: The chart and the recording you added go from this iPhone.
items.translation: Carta dan rakaman yang anda tambah akan dialih keluar daripada iPhone ini.

items.key: Edit it to add the words and chords.
items.source: Edit it to add the words and chords.
items.translation: Edit untuk menambah lirik dan kord.

items.key: Your charts and recordings stay on this iPhone.
items.source: Your charts and recordings stay on this iPhone.
items.translation: Carta dan rakaman anda kekal pada iPhone ini.

items.key: Your recording plays in the new key too.
items.source: Your recording plays in the new key too.
items.translation: Rakaman anda turut dimainkan dalam nada dasar baharu.

items.key: A ChordPro file, or a text file with the chords over the words.
items.source: A ChordPro file, or a text file with the chords over the words.
items.translation: Fail ChordPro, atau fail teks dengan kord di atas lirik.

items.key: Type the words, then tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.source: Type the words, then tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.translation: Taip lirik, kemudian ketik perkataan untuk meletakkan kord padanya.

items.key: Timbre listens to an audio file of yours, finds the beat and drafts the chords bar by bar.
items.source: Timbre listens to an audio file of yours, finds the beat and drafts the chords bar by bar.
items.translation: Timbre mendengar fail audio anda, mencari detik dan mendraf kord bar demi bar.

items.key: Add only charts and recordings you have the right to use. They stay on this iPhone; Timbre never uploads or shares them.
items.source: Add only charts and recordings you have the right to use. They stay on this iPhone; Timbre never uploads or shares them.
items.translation: Tambah hanya carta dan rakaman yang anda berhak gunakan. Semuanya kekal pada iPhone ini; Timbre tidak pernah memuat naik atau berkongsinya.

items.key: The free plan keeps %lld songs. Timbre Pro keeps as many as you like.
items.source: The free plan keeps %lld songs. Timbre Pro keeps as many as you like.
items.translation: Pelan percuma menyimpan %lld lagu. Timbre Pro menyimpan seberapa banyak yang anda mahu.

items.key: Copied from a chord sheet you own, in ChordPro or with chords over the words.
items.source: Copied from a chord sheet you own, in ChordPro or with chords over the words.
items.translation: Disalin daripada helaian kord milik anda, dalam ChordPro atau dengan kord di atas lirik.

items.key: Copied from a chord sheet you own.
items.source: Copied from a chord sheet you own.
items.translation: Disalin daripada helaian kord milik anda.

items.key: Timbre couldn't find a beat and chords in this recording. Try one with the band or a strummed instrument playing in time.
items.source: Timbre couldn't find a beat and chords in this recording. Try one with the band or a strummed instrument playing in time.
items.translation: Timbre tidak dapat mencari detik dan kord dalam rakaman ini. Cuba rakaman dengan kumpulan muzik atau alat muzik yang distrum mengikut detik.

items.key: A draft from what Timbre heard. Play along and fix any chord that sounds wrong in the editor.
items.source: A draft from what Timbre heard. Play along and fix any chord that sounds wrong in the editor.
items.translation: Draf berdasarkan apa yang Timbre dengar. Main bersama dan betulkan kord yang kedengaran salah dalam editor.

items.key: Your songs can't be saved on this device right now.
items.source: Your songs can't be saved on this device right now.
items.translation: Lagu anda tidak dapat disimpan pada peranti ini sekarang.

items.key: That file has no chart in it.
items.source: That file has no chart in it.

items.key: There's no text on the clipboard.
items.source: There's no text on the clipboard.

items.key: That file is too big to be a chord chart.
items.source: That file is too big to be a chord chart.
items.translation: Fail itu terlalu besar untuk menjadi carta kord.

items.key: That file isn't a text chord chart.
items.source: That file isn't a text chord chart.
items.translation: Fail itu bukan carta kord teks.

items.key: Timbre can't play that file. Use an audio file of your own that isn't copy-protected.
items.source: Timbre can't play that file. Use an audio file of your own that isn't copy-protected.
items.translation: Timbre tidak dapat memainkan fail itu. Gunakan fail audio milik anda sendiri yang tidak dilindungi daripada penyalinan.

items.key: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.source: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.translation: Ini mengalih keluar sesi, rentetan dan kemajuan suara yang disimpan daripada peranti ini.

items.key: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.source: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.translation: Setiap pelajaran dan lagu, setiap penalaan dan alat.

items.key: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.source: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.translation: Tala melalui getaran berdenyut mengikut perbezaan antara tali dan notnya, semakin perlahan apabila sepadan, lalu berhenti apabila tala disahkan.

items.key: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.source: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.translation: Kapo dan transposisi mengubah nama yang anda lihat, bukan pic yang diukur oleh Timbre.

items.key: Enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.source: Enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.

items.context: "Expert", not "Pro": the level is a Timbre Pro feature, so "Pro" read as the plan, not the precision.

items.key: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.source: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.translation: Penala ringkas menunjukkan penala sahaja. Mod tenang tidak memaparkan XP, tahap, misi dan rentetan; bintang dan lencana anda kekal.

items.key: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.source: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.translation: Satu peringatan lembut sehari, pada waktu pilihan anda.

items.context: Note names follow the language until the player picks a system (German reads B natural as H).

items.key: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.translation: Audio mikrofon dianalisis pada peranti ini. Rakaman tidak pernah disimpan atau dimuat naik.

items.key: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.source: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.translation: Ciri yang digunakan, bukan audio atau apa-apa yang dikaitkan dengan anda.

items.key: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.source: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.translation: Keyakinan ketat memerlukan not yang lebih jelas sebelum memaparkan bacaan. Tetingkap lebih besar membaca not lebih rendah dengan sedikit tambahan kelewatan.

items.key: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.source: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.translation: Latihan lagu menggunakan frasa daripada Ode to Joy karya Beethoven dalam domain awam.

items.key: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.source: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.translation: Alat muzik tanpa kredit dimodelkan dan dirender daripada kod untuk Timbre.

items.key: Recorded instruments, shared under CC0 by their makers.
items.source: Recorded instruments, shared under CC0 by their makers.
items.translation: Rakaman alat muzik, dikongsi di bawah CC0 oleh penciptanya.

items.source: Instrument artwork was supplied for this app. Space Grotesk, Inter and IBM Plex Mono are bundled under the SIL Open Font License. License notices are included with the app.
items.translation: Karya seni alat muzik dibekalkan untuk app ini. Space Grotesk, Inter dan IBM Plex Mono disertakan di bawah SIL Open Font License. Notis lesen disertakan dengan app.

items.source: Session dates, selected instruments and measured practice summaries are stored locally. They help you return to an instrument and review your practice. Clearing this app's storage in Android Settings removes local history and preferences.
items.translation: Tarikh sesi, alat muzik pilihan dan ringkasan latihan yang diukur disimpan secara setempat. Maklumat ini membantu anda kembali kepada alat muzik dan menilai latihan anda. Mengosongkan storan app ini dalam Seting Android mengalih keluar sejarah dan keutamaan setempat.

items.source: Microphone sound is analysed on your device to estimate pitch. Audio is not saved or uploaded. Microphone access stops when you leave an active tuning or practice screen. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
items.translation: Bunyi mikrofon dianalisis pada peranti anda untuk menganggarkan pic. Audio tidak disimpan atau dimuat naik. Akses mikrofon berhenti apabila anda meninggalkan skrin penalaan atau latihan yang aktif. Anda boleh membatalkan akses dalam Seting Android.

items.source: The full instrument collection, singing practice and Studio are available through one permanent purchase, with no recurring charge. Google Play handles payment and purchase restoration. Open Purchase and restore in Settings to restore your access. If you already own an older subscription, its management remains available through Google Play.
items.translation: Koleksi alat muzik penuh, latihan nyanyian dan Studio tersedia melalui satu pembelian kekal, tanpa caj berulang. Google Play mengendalikan bayaran dan pemulihan pembelian. Buka Pembelian dan pemulihan dalam Seting untuk memulihkan akses anda. Jika anda sudah memiliki langganan lama, pengurusannya kekal tersedia melalui Google Play.

items.source: Review access is active on this device.
items.translation: Akses semakan aktif pada peranti ini.

items.source: Enter the code provided in Google Play's reviewer instructions.
items.translation: Masukkan kod yang diberikan dalam arahan penyemak Google Play.

items.source: Instrument tuning, voice practice and rhythm tools.
items.translation: Penalaan alat muzik, latihan suara dan alat irama.

items.source: Pitch readings depend on your microphone, room noise and instrument. Wait for a stable reading and tune gently. Singing feedback measures pitch and steadiness; it is not a medical assessment or a measurement of breath support.
items.translation: Bacaan pic bergantung pada mikrofon, bunyi bilik dan alat muzik anda. Tunggu bacaan stabil dan tala dengan perlahan. Maklum balas nyanyian mengukur pic dan kestabilan; ini bukan penilaian perubatan atau ukuran sokongan pernafasan.

items.source: The free instruments remain available. Restore purchases if you expected access on this account.
items.translation: Alat muzik percuma kekal tersedia. Pulihkan pembelian jika anda menjangkakan akses pada akaun ini.

items.source: Restore purchases to check this Google account.
items.translation: Pulihkan pembelian untuk menyemak akaun Google ini.

items.source: Ad privacy choices could not load. Please try again.
items.translation: Pilihan privasi iklan tidak dapat dimuatkan. Sila cuba lagi.

items.source: Listening… Hold a steady note near the microphone.
items.translation: Mendengar… Kekalkan not stabil berhampiran mikrofon.

items.source: Your session could not be saved.
Microphone access is needed to hear your instrument. Tap Allow to tune. Without it you can still browse instruments and set up tunings.
items.translation: Akses mikrofon diperlukan untuk mendengar alat muzik anda. Ketik Benarkan untuk menala. Tanpanya, anda masih boleh melihat alat muzik dan menyediakan penalaan.

items.source: No signal. Play or sing a note and hold it.
items.translation: Tiada isyarat. Mainkan atau nyanyikan not dan kekalkannya.

items.source: The microphone measures pitch in real time. Your audio stays on this device and is never recorded or uploaded.
items.translation: Mikrofon mengukur pic dalam masa nyata. Audio anda kekal pada peranti ini dan tidak pernah dirakam atau dimuat naik.

items.source: Check that your oud and strings are made for Turkish tuning. Do not raise an Arabic string set to these notes.
items.translation: Pastikan oud dan tali anda dibuat untuk penalaan Turki. Jangan naikkan set tali Arab kepada not ini.

items.source: Paused. The microphone is off and your last reading is kept.
items.translation: Dijeda. Mikrofon tidak aktif dan bacaan terakhir anda dikekalkan.

items.source: Listen to the reference, then play your note.
items.translation: Dengar nada rujukan, kemudian mainkan not anda.

items.source: Microphone access is off. Enable it in Android Settings to tune. You can still browse instruments and set up tunings.
items.translation: Akses mikrofon dimatikan. Dayakannya dalam Seting Android untuk menala. Anda masih boleh melihat alat muzik dan menyediakan penalaan.

items.source: We could not load a tuning preset.
Listening is stopped. You can tune again whenever you are ready.
items.translation: Pendengaran dihentikan. Anda boleh menala semula apabila bersedia.

items.source: Almost there. Hold steady to confirm.
items.translation: Hampir tepat. Kekalkan kestabilan untuk mengesahkan.

items.source: The instrument, target notes and reference tones change together.
items.translation: Alat muzik, not sasaran dan nada rujukan berubah bersama-sama.

items.source: Can't hear it clearly — move closer or reduce noise
items.translation: Tidak dapat mendengar dengan jelas — dekatkan atau kurangkan bunyi bising

items.source: One purchase unlocks all instruments and tunings, singing practice and Studio. No subscription.
items.translation: Satu pembelian membuka semua alat muzik dan penalaan, latihan nyanyian dan Studio. Tiada langganan.

items.source: Ads are removed after the full unlock.
items.translation: Iklan dialih keluar selepas akses penuh dibuka.

items.source: The full collection and alternate tunings.
Interactive practice and your complete toolkit.
items.translation: Latihan interaktif dan set alat lengkap anda.

items.source: Purchases are not available on this device or Google account.
items.translation: Pembelian tidak tersedia pada peranti atau akaun Google ini.

items.source: Google Play confirmation is taking longer than expected. Restore purchases to check again.
items.translation: Pengesahan Google Play mengambil masa lebih lama daripada jangkaan. Pulihkan pembelian untuk menyemak semula.

items.source: We could not confirm your purchase yet. Restore purchases to check again.
items.translation: Pembelian anda belum dapat disahkan. Pulihkan pembelian untuk menyemak semula.

items.source: Finish your current session to view purchases.
items.translation: Selesaikan sesi semasa untuk melihat pembelian.

items.source: You already own the full unlock on this Google account. Restore purchases if access has not appeared.
items.translation: Anda sudah memiliki akses penuh pada akaun Google ini. Pulihkan pembelian jika akses belum muncul.

items.source: The permanent unlock is unavailable from Google Play. Refresh to check its availability.
items.translation: Akses kekal tidak tersedia daripada Google Play. Muat semula untuk menyemak ketersediaannya.

items.source: Open Google Play, then Payments & subscriptions, to manage your existing subscription.
items.translation: Buka Google Play, kemudian Pembayaran & langganan, untuk mengurus langganan sedia ada anda.

items.source: Check Google Play and try again.
items.translation: Semak Google Play dan cuba lagi.

items.source: This purchase is not available on this Google account.
items.translation: Pembelian ini tidak tersedia pada akaun Google ini.

items.source: Google Play declined the payment. Check your payment method in Google Play.
items.translation: Google Play menolak bayaran. Semak kaedah pembayaran anda dalam Google Play.

items.source: Payment is pending. Access starts when Google Play confirms it.
items.translation: Bayaran belum selesai. Akses bermula apabila Google Play mengesahkannya.

items.source: Google Play could not complete this purchase. Check Google Play before trying again.
items.translation: Google Play tidak dapat melengkapkan pembelian ini. Semak Google Play sebelum mencuba lagi.

items.source: Purchase received. Checking your access with Google Play.
items.translation: Pembelian diterima. Menyemak akses anda dengan Google Play.

items.source: Google Play took too long to respond. Restore purchases to check your access before trying again.
items.translation: Google Play mengambil masa terlalu lama untuk memberi respons. Pulihkan pembelian untuk menyemak akses anda sebelum mencuba lagi.

items.source: Google Play is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
items.translation: Google Play tidak tersedia. Semak sambungan anda dan cuba lagi.

items.source: This screen does not erase your saved progress.
items.translation: Skrin ini tidak memadam kemajuan yang anda simpan.

items.source: A crash report was saved on this device for support.
items.translation: Laporan ranap disimpan pada peranti ini untuk sokongan.

items.source: Using your previously confirmed purchase. Google Play will be checked again when you reconnect.
items.translation: Menggunakan pembelian anda yang telah disahkan sebelum ini. Google Play akan disemak semula apabila anda bersambung kembali.

items.source: Google Play is processing your payment. All features become available when it is confirmed. Please do not purchase again.
items.translation: Google Play sedang memproses bayaran anda. Semua ciri tersedia apabila bayaran disahkan. Jangan buat pembelian semula.

items.source: Google Play refunded this purchase. The free instruments remain available.
items.translation: Google Play membayar balik pembelian ini. Alat muzik percuma kekal tersedia.

items.source: Your existing purchase still includes all features. Google Play manages its renewal and cancellation.
items.translation: Pembelian sedia ada anda masih merangkumi semua ciri. Google Play mengurus pembaharuan dan pembatalannya.

items.source: The instrument collection could not be loaded.
items.translation: Koleksi alat muzik tidak dapat dimuatkan.

items.source: All instruments, singing practice and Studio are unlocked. Advertising is off.
items.translation: Semua alat muzik, latihan nyanyian dan Studio telah dibuka. Iklan dimatikan.

items.source: One purchase opens every instrument, singing practice and Studio and removes ads.
items.translation: Satu pembelian membuka setiap alat muzik, latihan nyanyian dan Studio serta mengalih keluar iklan.

items.source: Guitar, four-string bass and ukulele stay free. Ads appear after completed tuning sessions.
items.translation: Gitar, bes empat tali dan ukulele kekal percuma. Iklan muncul selepas sesi penalaan selesai.

items.source: Connecting to Google Play for your local price.
items.translation: Menyambung ke Google Play untuk harga setempat anda.

items.source: One payment. No subscription. Google Play shows the price before you pay.
items.translation: Satu bayaran. Tiada langganan. Google Play menunjukkan harga sebelum anda membayar.

items.source: Google Play has not provided a purchase price. You can still restore an existing purchase.
items.translation: Google Play belum memberikan harga pembelian. Anda masih boleh memulihkan pembelian sedia ada.

items.translation: Purata %1$@ sen lebih dekat dengan sasaran.

items.source: %1$@ cents farther from the target on average.
items.translation: Purata %1$@ sen lebih jauh daripada sasaran.

items.translation: Belum cukup latihan yang diukur untuk perbandingan.

items.translation: Berbanding dua minggu sebelumnya pada alat muzik ini.

items.source: No recent sessions for this instrument. Your next practice will appear here.
items.translation: Tiada sesi terkini untuk alat muzik ini. Latihan seterusnya akan muncul di sini.

items.translation: Tiada ukuran pic stabil dalam sesi ini.

items.source: Sessions in the last two weeks: %1$d
Purchase restored. Full access is ready.
items.translation: Pembelian dipulihkan. Akses penuh sedia digunakan.

items.source: No purchase found for this Google account. If you paid with a different account, switch accounts in Google Play and try again.
items.translation: Tiada pembelian ditemui untuk akaun Google ini. Jika anda membayar dengan akaun lain, tukar akaun dalam Google Play dan cuba lagi.

items.source: Your purchase was found. Google Play is still confirming the payment.
items.translation: Pembelian anda ditemui. Google Play masih mengesahkan bayaran.

items.source: Google Play could not be reached. Your access is unchanged. Try restoring again when you are online.
items.translation: Google Play tidak dapat dihubungi. Akses anda tidak berubah. Cuba pulihkan semula apabila anda dalam talian.

items.source: All features are available for review on this device.
items.translation: Semua ciri tersedia untuk semakan pada peranti ini.

items.source: Enter a number from 415 to 466 Hz.
Use your device language, or choose one for this app.
items.translation: Gunakan bahasa peranti anda, atau pilih bahasa untuk app ini.

items.source: A higher threshold asks for a clearer note before showing a reading.
items.translation: Ambang lebih tinggi memerlukan not lebih jelas sebelum memaparkan bacaan.

items.source: Three instruments are available without a purchase. One purchase opens the full collection, singing practice and Studio.
items.translation: Tiga alat muzik tersedia tanpa pembelian. Satu pembelian membuka koleksi penuh, latihan nyanyian dan Studio.

items.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are not saved or uploaded.
items.translation: Audio mikrofon dianalisis pada peranti ini. Rakaman tidak disimpan atau dimuat naik.

items.source: Choose a concert pitch or enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.translation: Pilih pic konsert atau masukkan nilai dari 415 hingga 466 Hz.

items.source: Change displayed names for transposing instruments or capo shapes. Measured pitch and tuning frequency stay unchanged.
items.translation: Ubah nama yang dipaparkan untuk alat muzik transpos atau bentuk kapo. Pic yang diukur dan frekuensi penalaan kekal sama.

items.source: Review your sessions and measured progress with full access.
items.translation: Semak sesi dan kemajuan yang diukur dengan akses penuh.

items.source: We could not load this instrument.
items.translation: Alat muzik ini tidak dapat dimuatkan.

items.source: The first beat is accented. Playback stops when you leave Studio.
items.translation: Detik pertama diberi aksen. Main balik berhenti apabila anda meninggalkan Studio.

items.source: No tuning presets are available for this instrument.
items.translation: Tiada pratetap penalaan tersedia untuk alat muzik ini.

items.source: Metronome playback is unavailable. Try again.
items.translation: Main balik metronom tidak tersedia. Cuba lagi.

items.source: Preview your rhythm setup. Playback and tap tempo are part of the one-time unlock.
items.translation: Pratonton tetapan irama anda. Main balik dan tempo ketikan disertakan dalam pembelian akses sekali bayar.

items.source: Practice summaries stay on this device.
items.translation: Ringkasan latihan kekal pada peranti ini.

items.source: Tap again to set the tempo
An easy note, without a score

items.translation: Graf pic. Sasaran %1$@, toleransi tambah atau tolak %2$d sen. Belum ada pic yang diukur.

items.source: Measured pitch relative to each target. Current target %1$@; shaded band is plus or minus %2$d cents.
items.translation: Pic yang diukur berbanding setiap sasaran. Sasaran semasa %1$@; jalur berlorek ialah tambah atau tolak %2$d sen.

items.source: One clear note. Reduce background sound.
items.translation: Satu not yang jelas. Kurangkan bunyi latar.

items.source: Sing a little closer to the microphone.
items.translation: Nyanyi sedikit lebih dekat dengan mikrofon.
Nyanyi lebih tinggi ke arah sasaran.

items.source: Inside the band. Keep it steady.
A little higher. Follow the line.
A little lower. Follow the line.

items.translation: Nyanyi lebih rendah ke arah sasaran.

items.source: Allow microphone access to practise, then try again.
items.translation: Benarkan akses mikrofon untuk berlatih, kemudian cuba lagi.

items.source: Microphone capture stopped. Check access and try again.
items.translation: Tangkapan mikrofon terhenti. Semak akses dan cuba lagi.

items.source: Confirm full access to begin singing practice.
items.translation: Sahkan akses penuh untuk memulakan latihan nyanyian.

items.source: Singing practice is included in the one-time full unlock.
items.translation: Latihan nyanyian disertakan dalam pembelian akses penuh sekali bayar.

items.source: Hear the target, then sing a comfortable, steady note.
items.translation: Dengar sasaran, kemudian nyanyikan not yang selesa dan stabil.

items.source: Listen first. Start when you are ready.
Try a longer, continuous note for a measured result.
items.translation: Cuba not berterusan yang lebih panjang untuk keputusan yang boleh diukur.

items.source: No clear voice detected. Move closer and try again.
items.translation: Tiada suara jelas dikesan. Dekatkan diri dan cuba lagi.

items.source: Pattern complete. Ready for the next step.
items.translation: Pola selesai. Sedia untuk langkah seterusnya.

items.source: Hear the pattern, then sing each note in turn.
items.translation: Dengar pola, kemudian nyanyikan setiap not mengikut giliran.

items.source: Payment is pending. Practice opens after Google Play confirms it.
items.translation: Bayaran belum selesai. Latihan dibuka selepas Google Play mengesahkannya.

items.source: Saved progress is unavailable. You can still start a fresh practice.
items.translation: Kemajuan yang disimpan tidak tersedia. Anda masih boleh memulakan latihan baharu.

items.source: Your result is ready, but it could not be saved. Retry save to keep it.
items.translation: Keputusan anda sedia, tetapi tidak dapat disimpan. Cuba simpan semula untuk mengekalkannya.

items.source: Sing each highlighted note. Follow your pitch line.
items.translation: Nyanyikan setiap not yang diserlahkan. Ikut garisan pic anda.

items.source: Sing the target. Follow your pitch line.
items.translation: Nyanyikan sasaran. Ikut garisan pic anda.

items.source: Practice stopped. Start again when you are ready.
items.translation: Latihan dihentikan. Mula semula apabila bersedia.

items.source: Target held. Ready for the next step.
items.translation: Sasaran dikekalkan. Sedia untuk langkah seterusnya.

items.translation: Sasaran tidak dapat dimainkan. Semak output audio anda dan cuba lagi.

items.source: Try again. Keep your pitch inside the shaded band.
items.translation: Cuba lagi. Kekalkan pic anda dalam jalur berlorek.

items.source: Warm-up complete. Keep your voice relaxed.
items.translation: Pemanasan selesai. Pastikan suara anda santai.

items.source: Preview any exercise. Singing practice is included in the one-time full unlock.
items.translation: Pratonton mana-mana latihan. Latihan nyanyian disertakan dalam pembelian akses penuh sekali bayar.

items.source: Notes you reached in this walk.
items.translation: Not yang anda capai dalam latihan langkah ini.

items.source: Start on an easy note. Follow the notes down and up. Skip any note that strains.
items.translation: Mulakan dengan not yang mudah. Ikut not ke bawah dan ke atas. Langkau not yang menegangkan suara.

items.source: The melody went the same direction as the target throughout.
items.translation: Melodi bergerak dalam arah yang sama dengan sasaran sepanjang masa.

items.source: The melody went the same direction as the target %1$d%% of the time.
items.translation: Melodi bergerak dalam arah yang sama dengan sasaran sebanyak %1$d%% masa.

items.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.

items.translation: Tali paling tebal mempunyai pic paling rendah. Tali ini paling dekat dengan muka anda semasa bermain. Kita menamakannya tali 6.

items.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap tali mempunyai pasak tala pada kepala leher. Memutarnya mengubah pic. Timbre mendengar dan memberitahu arah putarannya.

items.translation: Sapu keenam-enam tali dari tebal ke nipis dalam satu gerakan lancar. Pastikan pergelangan tangan santai.

items.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3, fret 2, jari kedua. Itulah A.

items.source: A note that lasts two beats

items.translation: Not yang berbunyi selama dua detik

items.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minim berbunyi selama dua detik. Petik sekali, kira satu, dua, dan biarkan bunyi berterusan hingga not seterusnya.

items.source: How long does a half note last?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Separuh daripada bar empat detik ialah dua detik. Krocet berlangsung satu detik.

items.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beralih dari tali 2 ke tali 1 hanya memerlukan gerakan kecil. Dekatkan tangan pemetik dengan tali supaya sedia untuk not seterusnya.

items.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Fret 3 pada tali 2, kemudian tali 1 terbuka. Angkat jari semasa memetik.

items.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C dan D pada tali 2, kemudian E, F dan G pada tali 1.

Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini berasal daripada Simfoni Kesembilan Beethoven. Ia menggunakan C, D, E, F dan G, dan kebanyakannya bergerak satu langkah pada satu masa.

items.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris pertama, perlahan-lahan: E E F G G F E D.

items.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kemudian: C C D E E D D.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap baris berakhir dengan ayunan: not lebih panjang, not singkat, kemudian not yang dikekalkan. Kira satu-dan-dua, dan selitkan not singkat pada “dan”.

items.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu kanak-kanak ini melangkah pada C, D dan E, kemudian melompat ke G. Lompatan itu dari tali 1 terbuka ke fret 3.

items.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E D C D E E E: tali 1 terbuka, turun ke tali 2 dan kembali.

items.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D D D pada tali 2, kemudian E dan G pada tali 1.

items.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · title
items.translation: Sorotan lagu: Letters in a Shoebox

items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letters in a Shoebox ialah Timbre Original, balada perlahan dalam C. Korusnya dimainkan pada tali 1 dan 2, dan frasa utamanya bermula dengan ayunan panjang-pendek seperti dalam Ode to Joy. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Frasa utama: C dan D pada tali 2, kemudian E, F dan G pada tali 1, dan kembali ke D.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Does the chorus end at home?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: No, it wants to go on

items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: E, F dan G pada tali 1, B, C dan D pada tali 2. Mulakan perlahan, kemudian kekalkan tempo stabil.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · title

items.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · unit summary
items.translation: E minor, E, A minor dan A, dimainkan dengan bersih, serta pertukaran kord pertama anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tekan dengan hujung jari yang melengkung seperti jambatan supaya tiada jari menyentuh tali di bawahnya. Kuku pendek memudahkannya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik tali satu demi satu, dari tebal ke nipis. Bunyi teredam bermakna ada jari menyentuh tali itu. Laraskan dan petik semula.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Satu tali berbunyi teredam. Apakah punca yang mungkin?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Hujung jari yang menyentuh tali bersebelahan menghalangnya daripada berbunyi. Lengkungkan jari lagi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kekalkan bentuk E minor dan tambah jari pertama pada tali 3, fret 1. Satu not itu menukar minor kepada major.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord major cenderung berbunyi cerah dan tenang. Kord minor lebih suram. E dan E minor hanya berbeza satu not.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A minor ialah bentuk E yang dialih ke tali lebih nipis: jari 2 dan 3 pada fret 2, jari 1 pada tali 2, fret 1.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not akar ialah not yang memberikan nama kepada kord. Dalam A minor, ia tali 5 terbuka, jadi mulakan strum di situ dan langkau tali 6.

items.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah dilangkau dalam A minor?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar A minor ialah tali 5 terbuka. Mulakan strum di situ.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A meletakkan jari 1, 2 dan 3 bersebelahan pada fret 2, pada tali 4, 3 dan 2. Strum dari tali 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jika jari terasa sempit, condongkannya sedikit supaya setiap jari terletak betul-betul di belakang fret. Pastikan tali 1 bebas untuk berbunyi.

items.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Fret manakah menempatkan ketiga-tiga jari dalam A?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: From E minor to A minor
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · title
items.translation: Daripada E minor kepada A minor

items.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Daripada E minor kepada A minor, jari 2 dan 3 bergerak bersama ke tali 4 dan 3. Kemudian jari 1 diletakkan pada tali 2. Tangan anda hampir tidak bergerak.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum sekali, kemudian gunakan baki bar untuk bertukar. Sasarkan kord baharu tepat pada detik pertama. Kelajuan akan datang sendiri kemudian.

items.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah jari harus bergerak antara kord?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Menggerakkan jari sebagai satu unit lebih pantas dan bersih. Kekalkannya rendah, betul-betul di atas tali.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap jari bergerak daripada A kepada E. Bayangkan bentuk E sebelum mengangkat jari, kemudian gerakkan ketiga-tiganya bersama. Sasarkan jari 2 ke tali 5.

items.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · title
items.translation: Sorotan lagu: Dust on the Dashboard

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dust on the Dashboard ialah Timbre Original: country dalam A. Setiap rangkap berakhir dengan dua bar E dan dua bar A, pertukaran yang baru dipelajari. Bayangkan bentuk, bergerak awal dan tiba pada detik pertama. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah ini berakhir pada nada asal?

items.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dengan E: B terbuka, E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, C syap pada fret 2, kemudian G syap pada fret 1 tali 3.

items.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: E minor, E, A minor dan A. Letakkan setiap bentuk dengan bersih, kemudian kekalkan pertukaran stabil.

items.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah menukar E minor kepada E?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Jari 1 pada tali 3, fret 1 ialah satu not yang menghasilkan E major.

items.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · unit summary
items.translation: Petikan ke bawah, kuaver bawah-atas, aksen dan tangan strum yang tidak berhenti.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet berlangsung satu detik. Strum ke bawah pada setiap detik dan kira dengan kuat: satu, dua, tiga, empat.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gerakkan pergelangan tangan dan lengan bawah dengan santai, seperti mengibas air daripada tangan. Lengan tegang menghasilkan bunyi kasar.

items.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa strum krocet mengisi bar empat detik?
