Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bahagikan setiap detik kepada dua. Strum ke bawah pada nombor dan ke atas pada “dan”: satu dan dua dan. Itulah lapan strum setiap bar.

items.source: Where does the up strum fall?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ke bawah pada nombor, ke atas pada “dan”. Tangan anda bergerak ke bawah dan ke atas sekali setiap detik.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum ke atas biasanya lebih lembut. Sapu hanya tiga atau empat tali paling nipis ketika naik. Ini memberikan ayunan pada irama.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Aksen ialah not yang dimainkan sedikit lebih kuat. Strum detik pertama lebih kuat daripada yang lain. Ini menandakan permulaan bar kepada semua.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik pertama memulakan bar. Strum pertama yang sedikit lebih kuat membantu anda dan pendengar mengikut detik.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebut nombor bar pada detik pertama: satu, dua, tiga, empat; dua, dua, tiga, empat. Anda sentiasa tahu kedudukan anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tangan strum sentiasa berayun ke bawah dan ke atas seperti bandul. Untuk melangkau strum, teruskan ayunan tanpa menyentuh tali.

items.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tangan yang tidak berhenti mengekalkan detik stabil. Strum yang dilangkau ialah ayunan yang tidak menyentuh tali.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pola ini mengiringi banyak lagu. Pada detik ketiga, tangan berayun ke bawah tanpa menyentuh tali, kemudian menyentuhnya pada strum ke atas.

items.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam pola ini, detik manakah tiada strum pada nombornya?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pada tiga, tangan berayun ke bawah tanpa menyentuh tali, kemudian strum ke atas pada “dan”.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Low Tide Radio ialah Timbre Original: reggae santai dengan E minor dan A. Gitar hanya bermain pada “dan”. Terus ayunkan tangan ke bawah dan ke atas, elakkan tali pada setiap nombor dan sentuh pada setiap “dan”. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bilakah gitar bermain dalam Low Tide Radio?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bes dan dram memainkan nombor. Gitar menjawab di antaranya, pada “dan”.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: krocet, kuaver dan strum folk pada kord yang anda tahu. Terus ayunkan tangan dan tekankan detik pertama.

items.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kuaver bawah-atas: bilakah strum ke atas?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · title

items.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · unit summary
items.translation: C, G, D dan D minor, dua progresi klasik serta pertukaran seminit.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C menaik seperti tangga: jari 3 pada tali 5, fret 3; jari 2 pada tali 4, fret 2; jari 1 pada tali 2, fret 1.

items.source: Which string do you skip in C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar C pada tali 5, fret 3. Mulakan strum di situ.

items.source: A minor to C: one finger
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: A minor kepada C: satu jari

items.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari 1 dan 2 kekal di tempatnya. Hanya jari 3 bergerak, dari tali 3 ke tali 5, fret 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G terbentang luas: jari 2 pada tali 6, fret 3; jari 1 pada tali 5, fret 2; jari 3 pada tali 1, fret 3. Keenam-enam tali berbunyi.

items.source: In G, which strings ring open?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam G, tali manakah berbunyi terbuka?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semasa bertukar, letakkan jari untuk tali paling rendah dahulu. Itulah not pertama yang disentuh strum, memberikan sedikit masa untuk jari lain.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D menggunakan tiga tali paling nipis: jari 1 pada tali 3, fret 2; jari 3 pada tali 2, fret 3; jari 2 pada tali 1, fret 2.

items.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah strum kord D bermula?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar D ialah tali 4 terbuka. Tali 5 dan 6 kekal senyap.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: D minor: satu not lebih rendah

items.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk D minor, not pada tali 1 turun ke fret 1. Susun semula: jari 1 pada tali 1, jari 2 pada tali 3, jari 3 kekal pada tali 2.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nada dasar ialah pusat sesebuah lagu. Dalam nada dasar G, kord G, C dan D memainkan peranan utama. Banyak lagu folk dan rock hanya menggunakan tiga kord ini.

items.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda sentiasa lewat ketika bertukar. Apakah yang paling membantu?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pertukaran perlahan dan awal membina kebiasaan. Kelajuan akan menyusul sendiri.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Progresi ialah urutan kord yang berulang. A minor, C, G, D bermula suram dan menjadi lebih cerah apabila menaik.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tanpa app, pilih dua kord dan bertukar selama seminit, satu strum setiap kord. Kira pertukaran bersih dan atasi skor itu esok. Mulakan dengan D dan D minor.

items.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam pertukaran seminit, apakah yang dikira?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kite Weather ialah Timbre Original: pop ceria untuk unggun api dengan G, D, E minor dan C yang berulang. Tukar awal, dan letakkan jari untuk tali paling rendah dahulu. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah dalam Kite Weather melangkau tali 5 dan 6?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar D ialah tali 4 terbuka, jadi tali 5 dan 6 kekal senyap.

items.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Rangkap menambah A pada tali 3, fret 2: not yang ditekan jari 1 dalam D. G terbuka, A, kemudian B terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: C, G, D dan D minor bergabung dengan E minor, E, A minor dan A. Tukar awal, strum stabil dan biarkan setiap kord berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 6 “Melodies on strings 3 and 4” · title

items.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 “Melodies on strings 3 and 4” · unit summary
items.translation: G dan A pada tali 3, D, E dan F pada tali 4, skala C major serta dua melodi tradisional.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tali 3 terbuka ialah G. Letakkan jari 2 pada fret 2 untuk A. Peraturan sama digunakan: jari sepadan dengan fret.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G dan A pada tali 3, kemudian B, C dan D pada tali 2.

items.source: G up to D and back
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: G naik ke D dan kembali

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tali 4 terbuka ialah D. Fret 2 ialah E dan fret 3 ialah F. Rendahkan ibu jari di belakang leher supaya jari boleh mencapai fret.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Fret 2, kemudian fret 3: E, kemudian F.

items.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali 4 terbuka dan tali 2, fret 3 berkongsi nama not apa?

items.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kedua-duanya D, berbeza satu oktaf: nama not sama, satu lebih tinggi daripada yang lain.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E dan F pada tali 4, kemudian G dan A pada tali 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 3 pada tali 5, fret 3. Itulah C, not permulaan skala C major.

items.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5, fret 3, jari ketiga. Itulah C.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Skala menaik not demi not dari satu huruf ke huruf sama satu oktaf lebih tinggi. C major hanya menggunakan nama huruf tanpa tanda: C D E F G A B C.

items.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5 fret 3, kemudian tali 4, 3 dan 2. Main perlahan.

items.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu rohani tradisional ini menjadi lagu standard jazz. Ia menggunakan C, D, E, F dan G pada tali 5, 4 dan 3.

items.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: C, E, F, kemudian G terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Anakrusis ialah beberapa not yang menuju ke detik kuat. Di sini detik pertama senyap, dan C, E serta F menuju ke G panjang.

items.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korus: E E D C, kemudian C E G G G F.

Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Amazing Grace mempunyai tiga detik: kira satu, dua, tiga, dengan tekanan pada satu. Notnya pada tali 4, 3 dan 2.

items.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa detik dalam setiap bar di sini?

items.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar tiga detik terasa seperti ayunan lembut: kuat, lemah, lemah.

items.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: D, G, B G, B, A. Tali 4, 3 dan 2 terbuka, ditambah A.

items.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kemudian turun: G, E, D, D.

items.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian tinggi: B terbuka naik ke D pada fret 3, kemudian turun melalui B, G dan A.

Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Halogen ialah Timbre Original: desert rock dalam D minor. Rifnya menggunakan not yang baru dipelajari: D terbuka, F pada fret 3, G terbuka, dan C pada tali 5, fret 3. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 4 terbuka, F pada fret 3, tali 3 terbuka, kemudian C pada fret 3 tali 5.

items.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · challenge gtr-6-6 “Lower-strings challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: setiap not dari C pada tali 5 hingga G pada tali 1, serta kedua-dua melodi. Kekalkan ibu jari rendah dan jari melengkung.

items.translation: C major dari tali 5, naik ke G pada tali 1.

items.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 “Songs with chords” · unit summary
items.translation: F kecil, D7 dan dua lagu tradisional dengan kord serta melodi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F kecil ini menggunakan empat tali. Jari 1 rata merentasi tali 1 dan 2 pada fret 1, jari 2 pada tali 3, fret 2, dan jari 3 pada tali 4, fret 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Condongkan jari 1 sedikit ke sisi ibu jari. Sisi yang lebih keras menekan dua tali dengan lebih mudah. Semak bahawa tali 2 berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Progresi ini menaik langkah demi langkah dari A minor dan berakhir pada F baharu anda. Strum dua kali setiap kord dan tukar awal.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Inggeris ini berusia lebih 400 tahun. Semua kordnya sudah anda kenali: A minor, C, G, E minor, F dan E. Ia mempunyai tiga detik: strum sekali setiap bar, kemudian pada setiap detik.

items.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah dibiarkan senyap oleh F kecil?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F kecil bermula pada tali 4. Mulakan strum di situ dan langkau tali 5 dan 6.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Syap menaikkan not satu fret. Greensleeves menggunakan G syap pada tali 3, fret 1, dan F syap pada tali 4, fret 4. Capai not itu dengan jari kelingking.

items.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G syap, A, B: tali 3 pada fret 1 dan 2, kemudian tali 2 terbuka.

items.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: A, C D, E F E, D B.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Syap bermaksud satu fret lebih tinggi. G syap terletak antara G dan A.

items.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korus bermula tinggi: G pada tali 1, fret 3, kemudian F syap pada fret 2.

Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord ketujuh menambah not yang menarik ke nada asal. D7 mahu bergerak ke G. Jari: 2 pada tali 3, fret 2; 1 pada tali 2, fret 1; 3 pada tali 1, fret 2.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Balada Amerika dari 1880-an ini hanya memerlukan G dan D7. Ia mempunyai tiga detik, seperti Amazing Grace. Strum sekali setiap bar, kemudian pada setiap detik.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Clementine pada tali 4, 3 dan 2. Baris terakhir menggunakan F syap lagi: tali 4, fret 4, jari kelingking.

items.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: G G G, turun ke D terbuka, naik ke B terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not tambahan D7 menuju ke G. Apabila G tiba, ketegangan terurai.

items.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris terakhir: A, D terbuka, F syap pada fret 4, A, kemudian kembali ke G.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ghost Light ialah Timbre Original: balada perlahan dan suram. Rangkapnya melalui A minor, F, C dan E, jadi F kecil anda digunakan dalam lagu, dan G syap dalam E menarik melodi kembali ke nada asal. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengar kord terakhir rangkap. Major atau minor?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum balada: satu strum kuat pada detik pertama dan biarkan berbunyi, satu lagi pada tiga, kemudian bawah-atas pada empat. Ruang selepas setiap strum ialah sebahagian daripada lagu.

items.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris terakhir rangkap: B terbuka, C pada fret 1, B, G syap pada fret 1 tali 3, B, kemudian E terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Dua lagu, dari awal hingga akhir

items.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: F kecil, D7 dan kedua-dua lagu unit ini. Tukar kord awal dan biarkan melodi menyanyi.

items.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah menarik paling kuat ke G?

items.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 “Seventh and sus chords” · unit summary
items.translation: E7, A7, G7 dan B7, kord sus, shuffle dan blues 12 bar pertama anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan E, kemudian angkat jari 3 daripada tali 4. D terbuka yang berbunyi ialah not ketujuh, yang menambah ketegangan blues.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan A, kemudian angkat jari 2 daripada tali 3. G terbuka berbunyi, dan A menjadi A7.

items.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah anda menukar E kepada E7 di sini?

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 mengekalkan G rendah tetapi meletakkan F di atas: jari 3 pada tali 6, fret 3; jari 2 pada tali 5, fret 2; jari 1 pada tali 1, fret 1.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bina B7 dari tali 5: jari 2 pada fret 2, jari 1 pada tali 4, fret 1, jari 3 pada tali 3, fret 2, kelingking pada tali 1, fret 2. Tali 2 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: B7 paling semula jadi menuju ke kord mana?

items.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B7 menarik ke E. Ketegangannya terurai dalam E minor atau E.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Shuffle membahagikan setiap detik secara tidak sama: strum panjang ke bawah, pendek ke atas. Inilah denyutan blues. Bayangkan hum-pty, dum-pty.

items.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam shuffle, setiap detik terbahagi kepada…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak lagu blues mengikut susunan 12 bar. Dalam E: empat bar E7, dua A7, dua E7, kemudian satu bar setiap B7, A7, E7 dan B7.

items.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa bar E7 membuka blues 12 bar?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat bar terakhir bergerak lebih cepat: B7, A7, E7, kemudian B7, yang membawa anda kembali ke awal. Tukar awal dan teruskan shuffle.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord sus menggantikan not yang menjadikannya major atau minor dengan not bersebelahan. Bunyinya terbuka dan belum selesai sehingga kembali ke nada asal.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Angkat jari 2 daripada tali 1 untuk Dsus2. Untuk Asus4, mainkan A dan tambah kelingking pada tali 2, fret 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ialah Timbre Original: blues 12 bar dalam E, susunan yang baru anda strum, dengan melodi berayun di atasnya. Kekalkan rasa panjang-pendek pada kedua-dua tangan. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, kemudian G syap pada fret 1 tali 3, kemudian B terbuka: gelongsoran blues pada bar kedua.

items.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bar kedua meluncur dari G ke G syap. Yang manakah tergolong dalam E7?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E7 ialah E, G syap, B dan D. G ialah not blues: ia bergesel dengan kord, kemudian meluncur masuk ke dalamnya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bar kesembilan, dengan B7: F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, E terbuka, D syap pada fret 4 tali 2 dengan kelingking, kemudian B.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: kord ketujuh, kord sus dan shuffle 12 bar. Kekalkan ayunan panjang-pendek stabil sepanjang setiap pertukaran.

items.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · title

items.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · unit summary
items.translation: Kord kuasa terbuka dan boleh alih, redaman tapak tangan dan rif anda sendiri.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord kuasa hanya memainkan not akar dan kelima, not lima huruf ke atas. Bukan major atau minor, bunyinya tetap padat walaupun kuat. E5 ialah bahagian rendah E minor.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gerakkan dua jari yang sama ke tali 4 dan 3. Dengan tali 5 terbuka, itulah A5. Sasarkan strum pada tali 5, 4 dan 3 sahaja.

items.source: Which notes make a power chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · title

items.source: Rest the edge of your hand
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan sisi luar tangan pemetik pada tali, tepat di tempat tali bertemu kekuda. Strum, dan not menjadi pendek serta padat.

items.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah tapak tangan diletakkan untuk redaman?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pada kekuda, tali masih berbunyi, cuma lebih pendek. Gerak ke hadapan dan bunyinya mati.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rock sering membina tenaga dengan kuaver teredam, kemudian tiba pada kord terbuka. Angkat tapak tangan untuk strum kuat dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari 1 pada tali 6, fret 3, kemudian jari 3 dan 4 dua fret lebih tinggi pada tali 5 dan 4. Itulah G5. Gelongsorkannya dan namanya mengikut fret.

items.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not akar pada tali 6, fret 5. Kord kuasa apakah ini?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik pada tali 6: E terbuka, F pada 1, G pada 3, A pada 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bentuk sama berfungsi dari tali 5. Jari 1 pada tali 5, fret 3 menghasilkan C5. Biarkan hujung jari 1 menyentuh tali 6 supaya senyap.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rif ialah frasa pendek yang mudah diingati dan berulang. Rif ini bertolak daripada E rendah terbuka. Letakkan tapak tangan pada kekuda supaya bunyinya kemas.

items.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, tali 6 pada fret 3, kemudian A terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bar kedua menaiki tali 5: fret 2, kemudian fret 5 dengan kelingking, lalu kembali ke fret 2. Kekalkan jari 1 berhampiran fret 2.

items.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5: fret 2, fret 5 dengan kelingking, fret 2 semula.

items.source: What makes a riff a riff?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu sering menjawab rif dengan kord kuasa. Mainkan rif, kemudian mainkan kord pada satu, “dan” selepas dua, dan empat.

items.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Gelongsorkan G5 dua fret ke atas. Apakah hasilnya?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua fret di atas G ialah A. Nama kord bergerak bersama not akarnya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Basement Weather ialah Timbre Original: garage rock dalam A. Rif pada tali rendah membukanya, kemudian kord kuasa menjawab pada satu, “dan” selepas dua, dan empat. Kekalkan tapak tangan pada kekuda. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A terbuka, C pada fret 3 tali 5, D terbuka, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 6 dan E rendah terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Anda tahu C5, dengan jari 1 pada tali 5, fret 3. Gelongsorkan seluruh bentuk dua fret ke atas untuk D5. G5 juga pada fret 3, satu tali lebih rendah daripada C5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: kord kuasa terbuka dan boleh alih, redaman tapak tangan serta rif anda. Selaraskan dengan klik dan pastikan redaman kemas.

items.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not akar pada tali 5, fret 3. Kord kuasa apakah ini?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 5 dikira menaik dari A: B pada 2, C pada 3.

items.source: Which one is a power chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · title

items.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · unit summary
items.translation: F barre dan B minor, skala pentatonik A minor serta solo pertama anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord barre penuh mengambil masa berminggu-minggu, jadi bina secara beransur. Anda tahu F kecil. Seterusnya F lima tali, kemudian barre penuh.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gerakkan jari 3 ke tali 5, fret 3, dan letakkan kelingking pada tali 4, fret 3. Lima tali berbunyi dan F kedengaran lebih penuh.

items.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord barre terasa sukar pada awalnya. Apakah paling membantu?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kekuatan dan rasa dibina perlahan-lahan. Latihan singkat setiap hari lebih baik daripada satu sesi panjang yang menyakitkan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 1 rata merentasi keenam-enam tali pada fret 1. Jari 2, 3 dan 4 membentuk E di hadapannya. F ialah E yang dinaikkan satu fret.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Biarkan berat lengan menarik barre ke dalam, seolah-olah menarik leher perlahan ke arah anda. Ibu jari hanya menstabilkan. Condongkan jari 1 ke sisinya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F barre ialah bentuk terbuka mana yang dinaikkan satu fret?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari 1 menekan barre pada tali 1 hingga 5 di fret 2. Jari 2, 3 dan 4 membina bentuk A minor dua fret lebih tinggi. Langkau tali 6.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Belum sedia untuk barre? Mainkan empat tali paling tinggi sahaja: fret 4 pada tali 4 dan 3, fret 3 pada tali 2, fret 2 pada tali 1.

items.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah ialah E dinaikkan satu fret dengan barre?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Skala pentatonik minor mempunyai lima not. Dalam A minor, notnya A, C, D, E dan G. Inilah bunyi banyak solo blues dan rock.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari 1 meliputi fret 5 pada setiap tali. Jari 3 dan 4 memainkan fret 7 dan 8. Dua not setiap tali, satu jari setiap fret.

items.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.

items.translation: Petikan jari bermaksud memetik dengan jari, bukan plektrum. Ibu jari mengendalikan tali bes, 6, 5 dan 4, dan bermain pada detik seperti dram bes.

items.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Ibu jari sahaja: tolak ke bawah melalui tali 6, 5 dan 4, satu demi satu.

items.translation: Ibu jari memainkan tali bes. Jari lain memainkan tali lebih nipis.

items.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.

items.translation: Pegang A minor. Ibu jari memainkan not akar pada tali 5, kemudian beralih ke tali 4, not kelima kord. Akar, kelima, akar, kelima: itulah bes berselang.

items.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petikan jari meminjam nama Sepanyol: p untuk ibu jari, i telunjuk, m jari tengah, a jari manis. Letakkan i pada tali 3, m pada tali 2 dan a pada tali 1, sedia memetik.

items.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: i, m, a: telunjuk pada tali 3, jari tengah pada 2, jari manis pada 1.

items.translation: p ibu jari, i telunjuk, m jari tengah, a jari manis. Kelingking biasanya berehat.

items.translation: Setiap jari memetik ke atas dan sedikit ke arah tapak tangan, kemudian berehat. Kekalkan tangan di atas tali dan biarkan jari bergerak.

items.translation: Petikan Travis, dinamakan sempena Merle Travis, mengekalkan ibu jari berselang pada setiap detik sementara jari lain memetik di antaranya, pada “dan”.

items.translation: Ibu jari ialah denyutan stabil: not bes pada setiap detik, beralih antara dua tali.

items.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.

items.translation: Teruskan ibu jari. Antara not ibu jari, m memetik tali 2 dan i tali 3: ibu jari, m, ibu jari, i. Main perlahan hingga lancar dengan sendiri.

items.translation: Apabila kord berubah, ibu jari tiba pada not akar baharu tepat pada detik pertama. Jari lain terus memetik tali 2 dan 3 seperti sebelumnya.

items.translation: Arpeggio memainkan kord satu not pada satu masa. Pola ini mengalir p, i, m, a, kemudian turun m, i. Enam not mengisi bar tiga detik, dua setiap detik.

items.translation: Pola berbalik di atas: p, i, m, a, kemudian m dan i ketika kembali.

items.translation: Satu bar setiap kord: A minor, F, C, G, kemudian A minor, F, E, A minor. Ibu jari mencari setiap not akar baharu: tali 5, 4, 5 dan 6.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Porchlight ialah Timbre Original: balada perlahan dalam D. Petik dengan jari: ibu jari pada not akar setiap kord, kemudian i, m dan a menaiki tali 3, 2 dan 1. Biarkan setiap not bersambung ke not seterusnya. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.translation: Not akar D ialah tali 4 terbuka. Tali 5 dan 6 kekal senyap dalam kord ini.

items.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary
items.translation: Blues 12 bar dalam A, pertukaran pantas, garisan bes boogie, pusingan kembali dan frasa blues pertama anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord blues berasaskan not pertama, keempat dan kelima nada dasar. Dalam E, kordnya E7, A7 dan B7. Beralih ke nada dasar A dan kordnya menjadi A7, D7 dan E7.

items.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar A, kord manakah mengambil peranan B7 dalam E?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B7 ialah lima huruf menaik dari E. Lima huruf menaik dari A ialah E, jadi E7 menggantikannya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat bar A7, dua D7, dua A7, kemudian satu bar setiap E7, D7, A7 dan E7. E7 terakhir membawa anda kembali ke awal.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam pertukaran pantas, bar 2 melompat ke kord keempat lalu terus kembali. Dalam A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Ini menambah gerakan sejak awal.

items.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam pertukaran pantas dalam A, apakah kord bar 2?

items.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kord keempat dalam A ialah D7. Pertukaran pantas mengunjunginya pada bar 2, kemudian kembali ke A7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pertukaran pantas berfungsi dalam apa-apa nada dasar. Dalam E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Bersedia untuk B7 hampir di akhir, kord empat jari anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Garisan boogie menaiki kord dan kembali, setiap not dua kali, panjang-pendek seperti shuffle. Dengan A7, ia menaik A, C syap, E, F syap, G, kemudian turun semula.

items.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A terbuka, fret 4 pada tali 5, fret 2 dan 4 pada tali 4, kemudian G terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah rasa dua not setiap pasangan?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Inilah shuffle lagi: not panjang pada detik, not pendek tepat sebelum detik seterusnya.

items.source: Move it to D and E
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Langkah yang sama bermula dari D pada tali 4 dan E pada tali 6. Dengan D7: D, F syap, A, B, C. Dengan E7: E, G syap, B, C syap, D.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: Boogie, A to D and back
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title
items.translation: Boogie, A ke D dan kembali

items.source: A lick that turns you around
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bar 11 dan 12 sering mempunyai pusingan kembali, frasa pendek yang menuju ke awal. Frasa ini menurun dari A ke E, satu fret pada satu masa.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 4: fret 4, kemudian 3, kemudian 2. Biarkan E berbunyi.

items.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah pusingan kembali biasanya dimainkan?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua bar terakhir. Ia membawa telinga kembali ke bar 1 untuk pusingan seterusnya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum sepuluh bar pertama dengan pertukaran pantas, kemudian beralih ke frasa pada bar 11 dan 12. Begitulah kumpulan blues mengakhiri setiap pusingan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title
