items.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pola pentatonik A minor anda sesuai dengan blues dalam A. Not C bergesel dengan C syap dalam A7, dan geseran itu ialah bunyi blues.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam blues A, not manakah paling terasa seperti nada asal?

items.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A ialah not akar nada dasar. Frasa yang berakhir pada A terasa selesai; G dan C meninggalkan rasa tergantung.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Frasa blues saling berbual. Mainkan frasa 1 sebagai soalan, kemudian jawab dengan frasa 2, yang berakhir pada A rendah.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Neon Laundromat ialah Timbre Original: funk berasaskan satu kord, A7. Frasa utamanya meluncur dari C ke C syap, geseran sama seperti frasa blues anda, dan korusnya beralih ke E7. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, kemudian C dan C syap pada fret 1 dan 2 tali 2, kemudian E terbuka.

items.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan A7, not manakah bergesel dengan kord?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A7 ialah A, C syap, E dan G. C daripada pola pentatonik anda bergesel dengan C syap, dan frasa utama meluncur dari satu ke yang lain.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Neon Laundromat tidak menggunakan shuffle. Mainkan langkah boogie dalam kuaver sekata dan ia menjadi garisan bes di bawah A7: A, C syap, E, F syap, G, dan turun semula.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: blues 12 bar dalam A dan E, pertukaran pantas, garisan boogie, pusingan kembali dan frasa anda. Kekalkan ayunan shuffle.

items.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam pertukaran pantas dalam E, apakah kord bar 2?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

items.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary
items.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, gelongsoran, lenturan dan vibrato, serta pola pentatonik kedua.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Hammer-on membunyikan not kedua dengan tangan penekan sahaja. Petik not, kemudian hentakkan jari lain dengan tegas tepat di belakang fret lebih tinggi. Tali terus berbunyi.

items.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik tali 3 terbuka, kemudian hentakkan jari 2 pada fret 2. Jangan petik not kedua.

items.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3: tekan fret 5 dengan jari 1 dan petik tali, kemudian hentakkan jari 3 pada fret 7.

items.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang menjadikan hammer-on berbunyi jelas?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Mendarat pantas dan tegas tepat di belakang fret

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kelajuan dan ketepatan lebih penting daripada daya. Letakkan hujung jari tepat di belakang fret, dan tali terus berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pull-off menurunkan pic ke not lebih rendah. Dengan kedua-dua jari menekan, petik not lebih tinggi, kemudian sentap jari atas ke sisi supaya memetik tali ketika dilepaskan.

items.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Fret 2 pada tali 3, kemudian sentap jari 2 keluar untuk membunyikan G terbuka.

items.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari 1 dan 3 pada fret 5 dan 7. Petik, kemudian lepaskan jari 3 dengan pull-off.

items.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Disentap ke sisi sambil memetik tali

items.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mengangkat terus ke atas mematikan not. Sentapan kecil ke sisi memetik not lebih rendah supaya berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk menggelongsor, petik not dan terus tekan sambil jari yang sama meluncur ke fret baharu. Tekanan mengekalkan bunyi; hanya not pertama dipetik.

items.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari 3 pada tali 3, fret 7. Petik, kemudian gelongsor ke fret 9 tanpa mengangkat jari.

items.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Semasa gelongsoran, apakah yang mengekalkan bunyi not?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kurangkan tekanan dan not mati. Kekalkan tekanan yang sama sehingga fret baharu.

items.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang kembali: petik fret 9 dan gelongsor turun ke fret 7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lenturan menolak tali merentasi fret untuk menaikkan pic. Lenturan satu ton, bersamaan dua fret, dari fret 7 mesti berbunyi sama seperti fret 9.

items.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3, fret 9: inilah sasaran lenturan anda. Biarkan berbunyi dan ingat bunyinya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 3 pada fret 7 dengan jari 1 dan 2 di belakangnya pada tali sama. Tolak ketiga-tiganya ke arah siling sambil memutar pergelangan tangan seperti memutar tombol pintu.

items.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lenturan dari fret 7 berbunyi lebih rendah daripada fret 9. Apa seterusnya?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lenturan yang tidak cukup tinggi kedengaran sumbang. Tolak sehingga sepadan dengan sasaran yang didengar.

items.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Sasaran, kemudian lenturan yang kurang tinggi. Not sama atau berbeza?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Vibrato ialah lenturan dan pelepasan kecil yang diulang pantas pada not yang dikekalkan. Pastikan sempit dan sekata supaya not kekal tepat tala.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lima not yang sama berulang sepanjang leher. Pola 2 bermula di penghujung pola 1: jari 1 pada fret 7 tali 5, 4 dan 3, jari 2 pada fret 8 tali 6, 2 dan 1.

items.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 6: fret 8 dan 10. Tali 5: fret 7 dan 10.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lima not yang sama seperti pola 1, A C D E G, di tempat baharu pada leher.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk bergerak dari pola 1 ke pola 2, gelongsorkan jari 3 dari fret 7 ke fret 9 pada tali 3. Anda tiba dalam pola 2 dengan tangan sudah di tempatnya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Saltwater Sunday ialah Timbre Original: reggae santai dalam A minor, dengan Am7 dan D7 berselang bar. Kedua-dua pola pentatonik sesuai. Gunakan hammer-on, pull-off dan gelongsoran, lalu tiba pada not kord di awal setiap bar. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan D7, not pola manakah tergolong dalam kord?

items.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D7 ialah D, F syap, A dan C. C, not ketujuhnya, terasa selesai; E dan G hanya melaluinya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 5 (along) · title
items.translation: Solo anda di atas Am7 dan D7

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: hammer-on, pull-off, gelongsoran, sasaran lenturan, vibrato dan kedua-dua pola. Mainkan setiap frasa dengan bersih, kemudian jadikannya bernyanyi.

items.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lenturan satu ton dari fret 7 harus sepadan dengan…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Sasaran, kemudian lenturan. Not sama atau berbeza?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · title

items.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary
items.translation: Bentuk E dan A sepanjang leher, major dan minor, bentuk terdekat serta progresi dalam A.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F barre anda ialah bentuk E dengan barre pada fret 1. Gelongsorkan semuanya ke atas dan namanya mengikut not akar tali 6: fret 3 ialah G, fret 5 ialah A.

items.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Barre bentuk E pada fret 5. Kord apa?

items.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 6 dikira menaik dari E: F pada 1, G pada 3, A pada 5. Fret barre menentukan nama kord.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Angkat jari 2 dan biarkan barre menekan tali 3. Itulah bentuk E minor, yang bergerak dengan cara sama: F syap minor pada fret 2, A minor pada fret 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Bentuk A, not akar pada tali 5

items.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B minor ialah bentuk A minor dengan barre. Bentuk A major juga bergerak: barre tali 1 hingga 5, kemudian letakkan jari 3 rata merentasi tali 4, 3 dan 2, dua fret lebih tinggi.

items.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Barre bentuk A pada fret 3. Kord apa?

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 5 dikira menaik dari A: B pada 2, C pada 3, D pada 5.

items.source: The minor A shape moves too
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk minor, gunakan jari B minor anda: 2, 3 dan 4 membina pola A minor di hadapan barre. Pada fret 3, itulah C minor.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan kord boleh menggunakan bentuk E, not akar pada tali 6, atau bentuk A, not akar pada tali 5. Pilih bentuk paling dekat dengan kedudukan tangan anda.

items.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda memainkan G pada fret 3. Di manakah C terdekat?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar C pada tali 5, fret 3. Kekal pada fret 3 dan tukar kepada bentuk A.

items.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Daripada G kepada C pada fret 3, jari 1 kekal pada barre. Hanya jari di hadapannya berubah. Inilah pertukaran barre paling lancar.

items.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D sebagai bentuk A berada pada fret mana?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 5: A terbuka, B pada 2, C pada 3, D pada 5.

items.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · title
items.translation: F syap minor, D, A, E

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F syap minor, D, A dan E semuanya dalam nada dasar A. Mulakan dengan F syap minor sebagai barre dan tiga kord lain terbuka.

items.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F syap minor sebagai barre bentuk E berada pada…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 6: F pada fret 1, F syap pada fret 2.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan sepanjang leher: F syap minor pada fret 2, D sebagai bentuk A pada fret 5, A sebagai bentuk E pada fret 5, dan E sebagai bentuk A pada fret 7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Longgarkan barre seketika semasa bergerak, kemudian tekan apabila tiba. Genggaman kuat sepanjang masa meletihkan tangan dan melambatkan pertukaran.

items.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bilakah tangan penekan harus memberi tekanan?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tekan apabila tiba, rehatkan ketika bergerak. Daya berterusan meletihkan tangan dalam beberapa minit.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada strum ke atas terakhir sebelum bertukar, angkat barre dan terus strum. Tali terbuka berbunyi seketika, irama tidak berhenti, dan anda tiba tepat pada masanya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ialah Timbre Original: indie pop dalam E dengan E, B, C syap minor dan A. B serta C syap minor ialah barre bentuk A, berjarak dua fret, jadi satu bentuk tangan melakukan kebanyakan kerja. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C syap minor sebagai barre bentuk A minor berada pada…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali 5 dikira menaik dari A: B pada 2, C pada 3, C syap pada 4.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: bentuk E dan A, major dan minor, memilih bentuk terdekat serta pertukaran lancar. Rehatkan tekanan antara kord dan tiba pada detik pertama.

items.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Barre bentuk E pada fret 3 ialah…

items.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not akar pada tali 5 bermaksud bentuk mana?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · title

items.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
items.translation: Semikuaver funk dan petikan geser, chop reggae, boom-chick country serta strum pop bersinkopasi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semikuaver membahagikan setiap detik kepada empat: satu-e-dan-a, dua-e-dan-a. Tangan strum bergerak dua kali lebih laju, bawah-atas-bawah-atas dalam setiap detik.

items.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Satu-e-dan-a: empat bahagian sama panjang setiap detik.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Funk gemar kord kesembilan. Jari 2 pada tali 5, fret 7, jari 1 pada tali 4, fret 6, dan jari 3 rata merentasi tali 3, 2 dan 1 pada fret 7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Terus gerakkan tangan dalam semikuaver, tetapi rehatkan jari penekan supaya kebanyakan strum menjadi klik geseran teredam. Tekan hanya untuk hentakan berbunyi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Jari penekan menyentuh tali dengan ringan

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Menyentuh tanpa menekan menghalang tali daripada berdering. Strum menjadi klik perkusi yang jelas.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tekan untuk setiap hentakan, kemudian segera rehatkan supaya pendek. Gelongsorkan seluruh bentuk E9 turun dua fret untuk D9.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gitar reggae menjawab dram dengan kord pendek dan cerah pada detik dua dan empat. Strum hanya tali nipis dan hentikan setiap kord serta-merta.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gunakan empat tali paling tinggi sahaja. A minor ini ialah bahagian atas barre A minor pada fret 5: jari 3 pada tali 4, fret 7, jari 1 menekan barre pada yang lain.

items.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa lama chop reggae harus berbunyi?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tekan, strum, lepaskan. Chop ialah bunyi pendek, dan ruang selepasnya membentuk irama.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang bahagian atas barre D: jari 3 rata merentasi tali 4, 3 dan 2 pada fret 7, jari 1 pada tali 1 di fret 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Irama country membahagikan bar: satu not bes pada detik satu dan tiga, strum pantas tali nipis pada dua dan empat. Boom, chick, boom, chick.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam boom-chick, apakah berlaku pada detik dua dan empat?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A short strum of the thin strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Alihkan boom kedua ke tali lain: dalam G, tali 6 kemudian tali 4. Dalam C, tali 5 kemudian 4. Dalam D, tali 4 kemudian tali 5 terbuka.

items.source: Booms in G, C and D
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: Bunyi boom dalam G, C dan D

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sinkopasi meletakkan strum di tempat yang tidak dijangka. Ke bawah pada satu, ke atas pada “dan” selepas dua, ke atas pada “dan” selepas tiga, kemudian bawah-atas pada empat.

items.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam pola ini, apakah gerakan tangan pada detik kedua?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Berayun ke bawah tanpa menyentuh tali

items.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bandul tidak berhenti. Pada dua, tangan berayun ke bawah tanpa menyentuh, sedia untuk strum ke atas.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain pop sering menukar kord pada strum ke atas terakhir, “dan” selepas empat, supaya kord baharu tiba sedikit awal. Ini mendorong lagu ke hadapan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

items.source: The pop strum on four chords
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sparkler Season ialah Timbre Original: lagu semangat musim panas dalam C dengan C, G, A minor dan F. Gunakan strum pop bersinkopasi, dan tukar sedikit awal, pada “dan” selepas empat. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka dan D pada fret 3 tali 2, dua kali, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 1, dan turun kembali ke D.

items.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapa tukar kord pada “dan” selepas empat?

items.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Supaya kord baharu berbunyi pada detik pertama

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bergerak pada strum ke atas terakhir membawa tangan sedikit awal, jadi kord baharu sedia pada detik pertama.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: semikuaver funk, chop reggae, boom-chick dan strum pop bersinkopasi. Terus ayunkan tangan dan ubah hanya apa yang disentuh.

items.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Chop reggae dimainkan pada detik mana?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

items.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary
items.translation: Kapo, bentuk G dan D pada kapo 2, serta Oh! Susanna dengan rangkap dan korus.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kapo mengapit setiap tali pada satu fret. Pada fret 2, setiap tali terbuka berbunyi dua fret lebih tinggi, dan semua bentuk kord terbuka turut naik.

items.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sebelum kapo: petik tali 1 dan 2 terbuka. Itulah E dan B.

items.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang apit kapo betul-betul di belakang fret 2 dan petik semula: F syap dan C syap.

items.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kapo pada fret 2. Anda mainkan bentuk G. Kord apakah berbunyi?

items.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua fret di atas G ialah A. Bentuk kekal G; bunyi naik bersama kapo.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dengan kapo, anda masih memikirkan G, C dan D, bentuk yang diketahui. Rajah di sini menamakan kord yang didengar, jadi bentuk G pada kapo 2 dibaca A.

items.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title
items.translation: Bentuk G dan D pada kapo 2

items.source: The G family, two frets up
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Keluarga G, dua fret lebih tinggi

items.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada kapo 2, bentuk G, C, D dan E minor berbunyi A, D, E dan F syap minor. Jari sama, nada dasar baharu: A major.

items.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kapo pada fret 2. Bentuk D berbunyi sebagai…

items.source: Two frets above D is E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua fret di atas D ialah E.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bentuk D berfungsi dengan cara sama. Pada kapo 2, bentuk D, G dan A berbunyi E, A dan B: nada dasar E dengan penjarian terbuka mudah.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan lagu berselang dua bahagian. Rangkap bercerita; korus mengulang frasa utama. Oh! Susanna karya Stephen Foster (1848) mempunyai kedua-duanya. Tanggalkan kapo: lagu ini dalam G.

items.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Anakrusis dan bar pertama: G terbuka, A pada fret 2, kemudian B terbuka, D pada fret 3 dua kali, dan E terbuka.

items.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bahagian manakah biasanya berulang dengan lirik sama?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lirik rangkap berubah mengikut cerita. Korus kembali tanpa berubah, dan itulah bahagian yang orang nyanyikan bersama.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Iringi rangkap dengan G dan D7, gaya boom-chick: bes pada satu, strum pada dua. Tiga bar G, satu D7, dua G, kemudian D7 dan G.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 9 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Korus bermula pada C, tali 2, fret 1, kemudian melompat ke E terbuka. Kordnya C, G dan D7, dan separuh keduanya sepadan dengan penghujung rangkap.

items.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: C dua kali pada tali 2, fret 1, kemudian E terbuka tiga kali.

items.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kemudian turun: D dua kali, B terbuka, G terbuka, dan A pada fret 2.

items.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tiga E dimainkan pendek, panjang, pendek. Di manakah not panjang bermula?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia bermula pada “dan” dan berbunyi merentasi detik seterusnya. Dorongan itu ialah sinkopasi, seperti strum pop anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Susunan menentukan apa yang dimainkan dan bila. Susunan anda: intro petikan Travis, rangkap sebagai melodi, korus strum boom-chick, kemudian melodi korus sebagai penutup.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Menetapkan nada dasar dan tempo sebelum melodi

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Beberapa bar kord memberitahu semua nada asal dan kelajuan lagu.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Akhiri dengan melodi korus dan biarkan G terakhir berbunyi. Berakhir pada melodi yang baru didengar semua terasa lengkap.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ialah Timbre Original: country dewan tarian dalam A, dengan A, D dan E. Apit kapo pada fret 2 dan mainkan dengan bentuk G, C dan D yang paling anda kenali. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kapo pada fret 2. Bentuk manakah berbunyi E?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua fret di atas D ialah E. Pada kapo 2, bentuk G menghasilkan A, dan bentuk C menghasilkan D.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik not akar kord pada detik satu dan tiga, dan strum pada dua dan empat, setiap satu diikuti petikan ke atas pantas. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: langkah penari.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: kapo, bentuk G dan D, serta susunan Oh! Susanna anda. Mainkan seolah-olah ada yang mendengar. Mungkin memang ada.

items.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kapo pada fret 2. Bentuk C berbunyi sebagai…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 17 “The CAGED system” · title

items.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 “The CAGED system” · unit summary
items.translation: Lima bentuk terbuka menjadi lima tempat memainkan G, dan kord yang kekal dekat dengan tangan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap kord major boleh meminjam bentuk C, A, G, E atau D terbuka yang dialih sepanjang leher. Menaik dari mana-mana bentuk, urutannya C A G E D, dan setiap bentuk bersambung dengan yang berikut.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C, A, G, E dan D: lima bentuk terbuka yang boleh dipinjam setiap kord major, di mana-mana pada leher.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Naik dari G terbuka dan bentuk berikut ialah E: G barre anda pada fret 3. Not akarnya pada tali 6 ialah G yang sama seperti dalam kord terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D terbuka yang dinaikkan lima fret ialah G. Jari 1 menekan tali 4 pada fret 5, menggantikan nat. Jari 2, 4 dan 3 membina semula segi tiga D di atasnya.

items.source: The D shape, string by string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Where is the D shape's root?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah not akar bentuk D?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar D terbuka ialah tali 4 terbuka. Selepas dialih, jari 1 menekannya: G pada fret 5. Tali 2, fret 8 juga G.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bentuk E pada fret 3 dan bentuk D pada fret 5 berkongsi satu not: G pada tali 4, fret 5. Perhatikannya semasa bergerak antara bentuk.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C terbuka yang dinaikkan tujuh fret ialah G. Jari 1 merentasi tali 3, 2 dan 1 pada fret 7, jari 2 pada tali 2 di fret 8, dan jari 3 serta 4 mencapai tali 4 dan 5.

items.source: The C shape, string by string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Seperti C terbuka, not akar bentuk C pada…

items.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar C terbuka ialah tali 5, fret 3. Di sini kelingking menekannya: G pada fret 10.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gelongsorkan bentuk C turun ke fret 2 untuk D, dengan not akar pada tali 5, fret 5. Nama sentiasa mengikut not akar.

items.source: The A shape, and around again
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Barre tali 5 hingga 1 pada fret 10 dan letakkan jari 3 merentasi tali 4, 3 dan 2 pada fret 12. Inilah barre bentuk A anda, dan G sekali lagi.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selepas bentuk A, bentuk G kembali pada fret 12: G terbuka, satu oktaf lebih tinggi. Dari situ lima bentuk berulang dalam urutan sama.

items.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Menaiki leher, bentuk manakah selepas A?

items.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Urutan berulang: C, A, G, E, D, kemudian C semula. Selepas A ialah G.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dengan CAGED, anda jarang perlu melompat. Sekitar fret 5, G ialah bentuk D, C bentuk G dan D bentuk A. Tiga kord, satu tempat.

items.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bentuk manakah memainkan C di sebelah G bentuk D?

items.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bentuk G untuk C menggunakan fret 5 dan 8, tepat di kedudukan tangan anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Idea sama berfungsi lebih rendah: G sebagai bentuk E pada fret 3, C sebagai bentuk A pada fret 3, dan D sebagai bentuk C pada fret 2.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lantern Hill ialah Timbre Original: lagu nyanyian unggun api dengan G, C dan D. Mainkan korus terbuka, kemudian dekat fret 5, kemudian dekat fret 3, dan lagu sama bergerak sepanjang leher. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dekat fret 5, bentuk manakah memainkan C?

items.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bentuk G untuk C menggunakan fret 5 dan 8, di sebelah G bentuk D dan D bentuk A.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: G dalam kelima-lima bentuk, serta G, C dan D dekat fret 3 dan fret 5. Namakan setiap bentuk apabila dimainkan.

items.source: G with the D shape sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G dengan bentuk D berada pada…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

items.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary
items.translation: Kord tiga not pada tali tinggi: major dan minor, setiap balikan serta progresi yang hampir tidak bergerak.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triad ialah kord penuh terkecil: not akar, ketiga dan kelima. Pada tali 3, 2 dan 1, triad berbunyi jelas dan cerah, dan berfungsi di mana-mana pada leher.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not apakah membentuk triad C major?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Akar, ketiga, kelima: dari C, langkau satu huruf ke E, kemudian satu lagi ke G.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Alihkan not terendah ke atas untuk menghasilkan balikan. Dengan E di bawah, C berada pada fret 9, 8 dan 8. Dengan G di bawah, ia bahagian atas C terbuka anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap triad major pada tali ini menggunakan satu daripada tiga bentuk, satu setiap balikan. Pelajarinya pada G dan D untuk mencari apa-apa kord major.

items.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G pada fret 4, 3 dan 3 mempunyai bentuk sama seperti…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kedua-duanya meletakkan not ketiga di bawah: satu fret lebih tinggi pada tali 3, dua lagi sama paras. Bentuk sama, berjarak lima fret.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D pada fret 7, 7 dan 5 mempunyai bentuk kedudukan akar C anda pada fret 5. Lebih rendah, fret 2, 3 dan 2 ialah bahagian atas D terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triad minor ialah triad major dengan not ketiga satu fret lebih rendah. Pada tali ini, A minor di fret 2, 1 dan 0 ialah bahagian atas A minor terbuka.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Barre fret 5 merentasi tali 3, 2 dan 1 untuk A minor dengan C di bawah. Satu jari, tiga not.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
