items.translation: E minor pada fret 4, 5 dan 3 meletakkan B di bawah. Ia di sebelah A minor pada fret 5, jadi pertukarannya kecil.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pilih balikan paling dekat dengan tangan dan progresi hampir tidak bergerak. G, E minor, C dan D semuanya antara fret 2 dan 5.

items.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari G pada fret 4, 3, 3 ke E minor pada 4, 5, 3, not manakah kekal?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B pada tali 3 dan G pada tali 1 kekal. Hanya tali 2 bergerak, dari D naik ke E.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat kord sama juga boleh dimainkan lebih tinggi: G pada fret 7, 8 dan 7, E minor pada 9, 8 dan 7, C pada 9, 8 dan 8, dan D pada 7, 7 dan 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan not triad satu demi satu untuk arpeggio. Melalui progresi, not itu membentuk melodinya sendiri.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A chord played one note at a time
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Kord dimainkan satu not pada satu masa

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not paling tinggi di sini ialah G, G, G, F syap: hampir tidak bergerak sementara kord berubah di bawahnya. Not yang dikongsi dua kord ialah nada bersama, sebab triad kedengaran lancar.

items.source: Did the top note go up or down?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah not paling tinggi naik atau turun?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Roller Rink ialah Timbre Original: pop tarian retro dengan G, E minor, C dan D, empat triad anda antara fret 2 dan 5. Bentuk kecil pada tali tinggi berbunyi cerah dan kemas seperti gitar kedua. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Gelung Roller Rink ialah satu, enam, empat dan lima dalam G. Kord manakah enam?

items.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Kord pada 6 ialah minor: E minor.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: triad major dan minor, balikannya, G, E minor, C dan D di dua tempat serta arpeggio. Pastikan setiap gerakan kecil.

items.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Triad minor ialah triad major dengan…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Not akar satu fret lebih tinggi

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Not ketiga satu fret lebih rendah

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · title

items.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary
items.translation: Ketujuh major, minor dan dominan, terbuka dan barre, ii–V–I serta iringan swing.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord ketujuh major menambah not satu fret di bawah oktaf not akar. Ia melembutkan kord major biasa menjadi berkhayal. Cmaj7 terbuka ialah C dengan jari 1 diangkat.

items.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Cmaj7 ialah C ditambah not apa?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ketujuh major berada satu fret di bawah oktaf not akar: B, tepat di bawah C.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan F kecil, tetapi biarkan jari 1 menekan tali 2 sahaja. Tali 1 terbuka, E, ialah ketujuh major F.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord ketujuh minor menambah not dua fret di bawah oktaf not akar. Bunyinya lembut, antara suram dan cerah. Am7 ialah A minor dengan jari 3 diangkat.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dm7: jari 2 pada tali 3, fret 2, dan jari 1 rata merentasi tali 2 dan 1 pada fret 1. Em7: hanya jari 2 pada tali 5, fret 2.

items.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Am7 ialah A minor ditambah not apa?

items.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ketujuh minor berada dua fret di bawah oktaf not akar: G, dua fret di bawah A.

items.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari 1 menekan tali 5 pada fret 3 dan merentasi hingga tali 1. Jari 3 pada tali 4, jari 2 pada tali 3 dan jari 4 pada tali 2.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dm7 ialah barre A minor dengan kelingking diangkat. D7 ialah barre bentuk A dengan jari 3 dan 4 pada tali 4 dan 2. Kedua-duanya dinamakan mengikut tali 5.

items.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dm7 pada fret 5. Di manakah not akarnya?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Seperti setiap kord bentuk A, namanya mengikut not pada tali 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gerakan kegemaran jazz: kord pada not kedua nada dasar, kemudian kelima, lalu kembali ke asal. Dalam C, kordnya Dm7, G7 dan Cmaj7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan bentuk E7 sebagai barre pada fret 3: jari 1 merentasi keenam-enam tali, jari 3 pada tali 5 dan jari 2 pada tali 3. Not akar pada tali 6.

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar C, kord manakah ii?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik dari C: C ialah satu, D ialah dua. Kord ketujuh yang dibina pada D ialah D minor tujuh.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain jazz sering membiarkan setiap kord berbunyi seketika sahaja. Tekan ketika strum, rehatkan selepas itu, dan kord mula berayun.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain gitar swing mengiringi dengan kord pendek yang menjawab kumpulan muzik. Irama Charleston pada detik pertama dan “dan” berayun selepas dua, kemudian memberi ruang.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam G, dua, lima, satu ialah Am7, D7 dan Gmaj7. Am7 ialah barre E minor tujuh pada fret 5; Gmaj7 melangkau tali 5, dengan akar pada tali 6, fret 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Late Checkout ialah Timbre Original: lo-fi dalam C dengan Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 dan Am7. Itulah ii–V–I, ditambah kord keenam untuk mengulangnya. Iringi dengan kord ketujuh barre dan Charleston. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam Late Checkout, kord manakah V?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Kord ketujuh pada G ialah G7.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: ketujuh major, minor dan dominan, terbuka dan barre, serta ii–V–I dalam C dan G. Pastikan kord pendek dan swing stabil.

items.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Ketujuh manakah satu fret di bawah oktaf not akar?

Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

items.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary
items.translation: G major dua oktaf pada fret 2, darjah skala dan kord, serta mod Dorian dan Mixolydian.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semiton ialah satu fret, ton dua fret. Setiap skala major menaik ton, ton, semiton, ton, ton, ton, semiton. Pola itu memberikan bunyi major.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 1 pada fret 2 dan beri setiap jari satu fret hingga fret 5. Dari G pada tali 6, fret 3, skala menaik merentasi tali 6, 5 dan 4.

items.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 6: fret 3 dan 5, jari 2 dan 4. Tali 5: fret 2 dan 3, jari 1 dan 2.

items.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5, fret 5, kemudian tali 4: fret 2, 4 dan 5. Kembali ke G.

items.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah semiton dalam skala major?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ton, ton, semiton: semiton pertama dari 3 ke 4. Ton, ton, ton, semiton: yang kedua dari 7 ke 8.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kedudukan sama diteruskan: A, B dan C pada tali 3, D dan E pada tali 2, F syap dan G pada tali 1. Tangan anda tidak bergerak.

items.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3: fret 2, 4, 5. Tali 2: fret 3, 5. Tali 1: fret 2, 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan ini, jari manakah memainkan fret 5?

items.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Jari 1 pada fret 2, jadi fret 5 untuk jari 4, kelingking anda.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: A carol built on the scale
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Joy to the World, susunan Lowell Mason pada 1839, bermula dengan skala G major terus menurun dari atas. Anda sudah tahu setiap not.

items.source: Joy to the World, in position
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: Joy to the World dalam kedudukan

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nomborkan skala dari G: G ialah 1, A ialah 2, dan seterusnya hingga F syap, 7. Pemuzik menggunakan nombor ini untuk membincangkan melodi dan kord dalam apa-apa nada dasar.

items.source: In G major, which note is 5?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik dari G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tindihkan not skala berselang pada setiap darjah untuk kord nada dasar. Kord pada 1, 4 dan 5 ialah major; pada 2, 3 dan 6 ialah minor. Dalam G: G, C dan D, kemudian A minor, B minor dan E minor.

items.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam G major, kord manakah dibina pada 6?

items.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not keenam ialah E, dan kord pada 2, 3 dan 6 ialah minor. Tindihkan E, G dan B: E minor.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan not G major tetapi jadikan A sebagai pusat, dan skala menjadi minor. Bunyinya A Dorian, mod G major: kedudukan sama, not permulaan baharu.

items.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mulakan pada A, tali 6, fret 5, dengan jari 4, dan naik melalui fret sama ke A pada tali 3.

items.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah menjadikan A Dorian lebih cerah daripada A minor biasa?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A minor biasa mempunyai F. Dorian mengekalkan F syap G major: titik cerah dalam skala minor.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang jadikan D sebagai pusat. Not G major dari D ke D membentuk D Mixolydian: skala major dengan not ketujuh satu fret lebih rendah. Ia lazim dalam folk, rock dan melodi fiddle.

items.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dari D pada tali 5, fret 5, naik dalam kedudukan sama ke D pada tali 2, fret 3.

items.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D major mempunyai C syap. D Mixolydian mempunyai…

items.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mixolydian merendahkan not ketujuh satu fret, jadi C dalam G major memberikan warna khasnya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mana-mana not skala major boleh menjadi pusat. Dari G ialah major, dari A Dorian, dari D Mixolydian, dari E minor biasa. Fret sama, suasana berbeza.

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Market Day ialah Timbre Original: pop ceria dalam G dengan rentak highlife, muzik gitar cerah Afrika Barat. Frasa utamanya hanya menggunakan not G major, jadi sesuai dalam skala kedudukan kedua anda. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord Market Day ialah G, B minor, C dan D. Apakah darjah skalanya?

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G ialah 1, B ialah 3, C ialah 4 dan D ialah 5. Kord pada 3 adalah minor dalam setiap nada dasar major: B minor.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, B pada fret 4 tali 3, D semula, E pada fret 5 dengan jari 4, kemudian D dan B.

Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: G major dua oktaf, skala dalam selang ketiga, A Dorian dan D Mixolydian. Kekalkan satu jari setiap fret.

items.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…

items.translation: Ton, ton, semiton, ton, ton, ton, semiton membentuk…

items.translation: Mod manakah bermula pada not kedua G major?

items.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · unit summary
items.translation: Pentatonik major, hammer-on dan gelongsoran country, tril, pembentukan frasa serta bunyi manis dan tajam dalam blues.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Alihkan pola pentatonik minor dari fret 5 turun ke fret 2 dan jadikan A sebagai pusat: bunyinya menjadi manis dan major. Itulah pentatonik A major: A, B, C syap, E dan F syap.

items.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dari A pada tali 6, fret 5, kemudian fret 2 dan 4 pada tali 5 dan 4, dan A pada fret 2 tali 3.

items.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not apakah dalam pentatonik A major?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: A, B, C syap, E, F syap

items.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lima not skala A major tanpa dua semitonnya. Pola minor pada fret 5 mempunyai A, C, D, E dan G.

items.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title
items.translation: Pentatonik A major, naik dan turun

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pola pada fret 2 ini juga pentatonik F syap minor, bermula dari F syap. Not yang dijadikan pusat menentukan yang mana anda mainkan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain country gemar hammer-on dalam pola ini: E ke F syap pada tali 4, A ke B pada tali 3. Petik not pertama, kemudian hammer-on not kedua.

items.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 4: petik fret 2, kemudian hentakkan jari 3 pada fret 4.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang gelongsorkan jari 3 pada tali 3 dari fret 4 ke fret 6, B naik ke C syap, kemudian kembali ke pola.

items.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari 3 pada tali 3, fret 4. Petik, kemudian gelongsor ke fret 6 tanpa mengangkat jari.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 8 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tril berselang pantas antara dua not: satu petikan, kemudian hammer-on, pull-off, berulang-ulang. Pastikan sekata sebelum mempercepatkannya.

items.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3: fret 2 dan 4. Petik sekali, kemudian hammer-on dan pull-off dengan jari 3.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mulakan satu fret di bawah not sasaran dan gelongsor naik sambil memetik. Sasaran yang penting: tiba tepat pada detik.

items.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apabila menggelongsor masuk ke not, not manakah tiba pada detik?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Gelongsoran bermula tepat sebelum detik supaya not sasaran tiba tepat padanya.

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam blues A, kedua-dua pola sesuai. Pentatonik major pada fret 2 berbunyi manis; minor pada fret 5 berbunyi tegas. Pemain mahir bergerak antara keduanya.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pola manakah lebih manis dengan A7?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pentatonik major mempunyai C syap, not ketiga A7. C dalam pola minor bergesel dengannya, dan geseran itu ialah blues.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tanya soalan tegas pada fret 5, kemudian jawab dengan manis pada fret 2. Alihkan tangan pada not panjang, dan akhiri kedua-dua frasa pada A.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Solo hebat bernafas. Mainkan frasa pendek, berehat kira-kira selama frasa itu, kemudian jawab. Kesenyapan menjadikan not berikut lebih bermakna.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Selepas frasa dua detik, berapa lama anda boleh berehat?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan frasa dua kali dengan cara sama, kemudian ubah penghujungnya sahaja. Pendengar mengenali ulangan dan menantikan kelainan.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kekalkan setiap not panjang dan ayunkannya dengan tolakan serta pelepasan kecil yang sekata. Pastikan sempit: pic beralun, bukan tersasar.

items.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ialah Timbre Original: synth-pop dalam A dengan F syap minor, D, A dan E. Pola fret 2 sesuai sepanjang gelung: pentatonik A major, yang juga pentatonik F syap minor. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengar kord pertama. Major atau minor?

items.source: Over F sharp minor and D
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: Dengan F syap minor dan D

items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?

items.translation: Not pola manakah tergolong dalam kord E?

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E ialah E, G syap dan B. Pola mempunyai E dan B tetapi tiada G syap, jadi tekankan dua not itu dengan E.

items.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada konsep baharu: pentatonik major, hammer-on, gelongsoran, tril dan kedua-dua pola dalam blues. Beri ruang dan akhiri pada A.

items.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…

items.translation: Alihkan pola minor dari fret 5 ke fret 2 dan ia memainkan…

items.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 “Song form and arranging” · unit summary
items.translation: Rangkap, korus dan AABA, intro dan penutup, tekstur dan isian, serta susunan Down by the Riverside anda sendiri.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · title
Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan lagu dibina daripada beberapa bahagian: rangkap yang bercerita, korus yang mengulang frasa utama, dan kadangkala bridge untuk kontras. Mengetahui susunan membantu anda kekal di landasan.

items.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Korus kembali dengan lirik dan melodi sama. Itulah bahagian yang diingati dan dinyanyikan bersama.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak lagu lama menggunakan AABA: melodi, melodi sama sekali lagi, bridge yang berbeza, kemudian melodi semula. Setiap bahagian biasanya lapan bar; di sini empat.

items.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam bentuk AABA, bahagian manakah bridge?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Intro paling mudah ialah baris terakhir lagu, dimainkan sebelum rangkap pertama. Ia menetapkan nada dasar, tempo dan suasana, dan penyanyi tahu tepat bila harus masuk.

items.source: An intro from the last line
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Why start with the song's last line?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapa bermula dengan baris terakhir lagu?

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It sets the key and tempo
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ia menetapkan nada dasar dan tempo

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk mengakhiri, ulang baris terakhir, biasanya dua kali lagi, dan biarkan kord akhir berbunyi. Penutup memberitahu semua bahawa lagu hampir tamat.

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 7 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Penyusun mengangkat korus dengan mengubah permainan gitar. Petik rangkap lembut dengan jari, kemudian strum korus, dan kord sama tiba-tiba kedengaran lebih besar.

items.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 2 (along) · title
items.translation: Rangkap: Travis pada G dan D7

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang mengangkat korus di sini?

Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap bahagian boleh menambah sedikit: rangkap dipetik, korus distrum, kemudian triad sepanjang leher untuk korus terakhir. Simpan bunyi paling besar untuk akhir.

items.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-4 “Fill the long notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Apabila melodi mengekalkan not panjang, pemain gitar solo mengisi ruang: satu atau dua not bes daripada kord, kemudian kembali ke melodi tepat pada masa.

items.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jukebox Moon ialah Timbre Original: tarian perlahan gaya lima puluhan dalam AABA, rangkap, rangkap semula, bridge pada F, kemudian rangkap sekali lagi. Strum setiap detik, dengan petikan ke atas berayun pantas menuju bar baharu. Lagu penuh ada dalam Lagu, di bawah Lagu asli.

items.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada kebanyakan alat muzik, pic tali semakin rendah apabila bergerak ke atas. Pada ukulele, tali 4 (G) lebih tinggi daripada tali 3 (C). Ini dipanggil penalaan re-entrant.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G tinggi menjadikan setiap kord rapat dan cerah. Inilah bunyi manis dan berdering yang dikenali sebagai ukulele.

items.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3, kemudian tali 4. Dengar lompatan ke atas?

items.translation: Strum ke atas di antara detik

items.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira 1 dan 2 dan 3 dan 4 dan. Strum ke bawah pada nombor, ke atas pada setiap “dan”. Tangan tidak berhenti bergerak.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum ke atas kebanyakannya menyentuh tali 1 dan 2. Sapu dengan bahagian lembut jari, sedikit lebih lembut daripada strum ke bawah.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Only at the end of a bar
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ke bawah pada 1, bawah-atas pada 2, ke bawah pada 3, bawah-atas pada 4. Tangan masih berayun ke atas selepas 1 dan 3; cuma tidak menyentuh tali.

items.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ayunan ke atas yang senyap memastikan tangan tepat masa untuk strum ke bawah berikutnya.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ke bawah pada 1, bawah-atas pada 2, langkau strum ke bawah pada 3, kemudian atas, bawah-atas. Strum yang dilangkau memberikan ayunan.

items.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Strum manakah dilangkau dalam strum pulau?

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tangan masih bergerak ke bawah pada 3, cuma tidak menyentuh tali. Ini memastikan strum ke atas berikutnya tepat masa.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Tukar pada strum ke atas terakhir

items.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum ke atas terakhir dalam bar boleh ringan atau terbuka. Gunakannya untuk bergerak ke kord seterusnya supaya detik 1 tiba dengan bersih.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ke bawah, bawah-atas dan strum pulau. Terus gerakkan tangan dan biarkan kord menyusul.

items.source: Which pattern is the island strum?

Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · title

items.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · unit summary
items.translation: Mainkan melodi not demi not pada tali 1 hingga 3.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C D E F G A B C. Mulakan pada tali 3 terbuka dan naik merentasi tali 2 dan 1. Setiap not dalam tiga fret pertama.

items.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 terbuka dan fret 2, kemudian tali 2 terbuka dan fret 1.

items.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 2 fret 3, kemudian tali 1: terbuka, fret 2, fret 3.

items.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa nama not berbeza dalam skala?

items.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C ke C ialah lapan not, tetapi C atas mengulang yang pertama. Tujuh nama, kemudian bermula semula.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beethoven menulis melodi ini pada 1824. Ia kebanyakannya bergerak berlangkah, dari satu not ke not berikut, pada tali 2 dan 3.

items.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: E E F G, G F E D.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Baris pertama berakhir pada D. Di manakah baris kedua berakhir?

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Permulaan sama, pengakhiran berbeza. Baris kedua kembali ke C.

Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi tradisional ini melompat dari C naik ke G, kemudian turun satu not pada satu masa. Setiap baris berakhir pada not lebih panjang.

items.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 terbuka, tali 2 fret 3, tali 1 terbuka.

items.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah frasa ini naik atau turun?

Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet berlangsung satu detik, minim dua, semibrif empat. Kekalkan setiap not sehingga not berikut bermula.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Titik menambah separuh tempoh not. Minim bertitik berlangsung tiga detik; krocet bertitik satu setengah.

items.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: “Aura Lee” diterbitkan pada 1861, dengan muzik oleh George R. Poulton. Main perlahan dan biarkan setiap not bersambung ke not seterusnya.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fret 2 pada tali 2 ialah F syap, satu fret di atas F. Syap menaikkan not satu fret.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tanda syap menaikkan not sebanyak apa?

Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Perhatikan laluan not dan kekalkan kedudukan walaupun terlepas not. Detik terus berjalan, jadi anda juga teruskan.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · challenge uke-4-6 “Challenge: three tunes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah F syap pada tali 2?

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 “More chords” · title

items.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 “More chords” · unit summary
items.translation: D minor, E minor, D, A dan E7, kemudian lagu empat kord.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · title
Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari kedua pada fret 2 tali 4, ketiga pada fret 2 tali 3, pertama pada fret 1 tali 2. Tali 1 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D minor paling hampir dengan kord mana?

items.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-1 “D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D minor ialah F dengan satu jari tambahan pada fret 2 tali 3.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 2 tali 1, kedua pada fret 3 tali 2, ketiga pada fret 4 tali 3. Tali 4 berbunyi terbuka.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E minor dan G membiarkan tali manakah terbuka?

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · title
Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 1, 2 dan 3 bersebelahan pada fret 2 tali 4, 3 dan 2. Tali 1 berbunyi terbuka.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari kedua pada fret 2 tali 4, pertama pada fret 1 tali 3. Tali 2 dan 1 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah mempunyai tiga jari pada fret sama?

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 1 tali 4, kedua pada fret 2 tali 3, ketiga pada fret 2 tali 1. Tali 2 berbunyi terbuka.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 menarik ke C. Begitu juga, E7 menarik ke A minor. Mainkan berturut-turut dan dengar ketegangan terurai.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · title
Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nomborkan not skala C untuk menamakan kord mengikut nombor: C ialah I, G ialah V, A minor ialah vi, F ialah IV. Urutan ini digunakan dalam banyak lagu.

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar C, kord manakah IV?

items.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira menaik skala dari C: C, D, E, F. F ialah not keempat, jadi F ialah kord IV.

items.source: Which chord is vi in C?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Angka huruf kecil bermaksud kord minor. Not keenam C major ialah A.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · title
Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A dan E7. Bentuk bersih dahulu, kemudian strum stabil.

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar C, kord manakah V?
