items.context: Bass · Unit 5 “Walking bass” · unit summary
items.translation: Blues 12 bar, garisan berjalan dan not pendekatan kromatik.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Blues mengulang gelung 12 bar: empat bar A, dua D, dua A, kemudian E, D, A, E. Kira bar supaya sentiasa tahu kedudukan anda.

items.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa bar A membuka blues 12 bar?

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar 9 hingga 12 ialah E, D, A, E. E pada bar 12 membawa gelung kembali.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · title

items.source: A new note on every beat
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Garisan bes berjalan memainkan not baharu pada setiap detik. Mulakan dengan akar, ketiga, kelima, keenam: dengan A, notnya A, C syap, E, F syap.

items.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 terbuka, fret 4; kemudian tali 2, fret 2 dan 4.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: What makes a bass line walk?
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 2 terbuka, fret 4; kemudian tali 1, fret 2 dan 4.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada detik 4, mainkan not satu fret daripada akar seterusnya. Ia menarik telinga ke hadapan supaya pertukaran terasa tiba.

items.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 fret 4, kemudian tali 2 terbuka: satu fret naik ke D.

items.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda menuju D pada bar berikut. Not detik 4 manakah menarik paling baik?

items.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C syap satu fret di bawah D. Semiton meluncur terus ke akar baharu.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 4 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · title

items.source: Put the walk on the form
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 12 bar sama, kini dengan garisan berjalan. Bar yang menuju kord baharu berakhir pada not pendekatan.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 2 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 3 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapa bar 12 berakhir pada G syap?

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It leads back to A at the top
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ia menuju kembali ke A di awal

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar 12 membawa bentuk kembali. G syap satu fret di bawah A, kord permulaan pusingan berikut.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · title
Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Blues 12 bar berfungsi dalam apa-apa nada dasar. Dalam E, kordnya E, A dan B. Berjalan dengan akar, ketiga, kelima dan keenam, dan dekati setiap pertukaran.

items.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar E, kord manakah pada bar 9?

items.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 fret 2; tali 2 fret 1 dan 4; tali 1 fret 1.

items.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 4 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 5 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · title

items.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary
items.translation: Rock kuaver, irama bertitik, ruang dan garisan gaya Motown.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira 1 dan 2 dan 3 dan 4 dan. Mainkan not pada setiap kiraan dengan jari bergilir. Sasarkan kelantangan sekata.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kuaver anda mula tergesa-gesa. Apakah membantu?

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Selaraskan dengan klik dan rehatkan tangan

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 5 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · title

items.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet bertitik berlangsung satu setengah detik. Main pada 1, kekalkan hingga 2, kemudian main pada “dan” selepas 2, lalu pada 3 dan 4.

items.source: Long-short on A, D and E
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: Panjang-pendek pada A, D dan E

items.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · title

items.source: Silence is part of the groove
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not pendek dengan rehat bersih menjadikan garisan melantun. Longgarkan jari penekan sambil terus menyentuh tali untuk menghentikan setiap not tepat masa.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah menghentikan not ditekan dengan bersih?

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Ease off but keep touching it
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lepaskan tekanan sementara jari kekal pada tali. Not berhenti tanpa dengungan.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · title

items.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Garisan bes era Motown banyak bergerak: not kord, not menuju kord berikut dan dorongan di luar detik. Garisan ini baharu, ditulis dengan semangat itu.

items.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bar pertama: C, E, G, kemudian B flet menuju A.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah fungsi B flet di akhir bar 1?

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Leads down a fret into A
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Itulah not pendekatan, satu fret di atas A, akar kord berikut. Ia membawa anda meluncur ke bar seterusnya.

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 8 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · title
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kuaver, irama bertitik dan garisan bergerak. Ikut klik, terus gilirkan jari dan nikmati irama.

items.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam irama kuaver, kiraan manakah mendapat not?

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin course · title

items.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
items.context: Violin course · course subtitle
items.translation: Gesek, tekan dan main tepat tala, dari tali terbuka hingga melodi fiddle

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

items.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary
items.translation: Pegang, gesek, tala, mainkan tali terbuka dan lagu pertama anda.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dengan violin di bawah dagu, tali ialah G, D, A, E dari kiri ke kanan. G paling tebal dan rendah. E paling nipis dan tinggi, dan dinamakan tali 1.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kekuda ialah lengkungan kayu nipis yang menyokong tali. Hanya tekanan tali mengekalkannya berdiri. Jika mula condong, minta guru atau kedai meluruskannya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E ialah tali paling nipis dan tinggi. Tali dikira dari E (1) hingga G (4).

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum menggunakan bow, petik dahulu. Letakkan ibu jari kanan pada sisi papan jari dan tarik tali dengan jari pertama. Pemain menamakannya pizzicato.

items.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Letakkan violin di atas riba seperti gitar kecil. Petik tali 2, A, dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan tepi bawah violin pada tulang selangka kiri dan pusingkan kepala untuk meletakkan rahang pada penyangga dagu. Berat kepala memegangnya. Jangan kepit kuat.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Halakan kepala skrol ke hadapan dan kiri, kira-kira mendatar selari lantai. Tangan kiri menyokong leher, ibu jari bertentangan jari pertama. Kekalkan pergelangan tangan lurus dan santai.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Biarkan kepala berehat pada penyangga dagu. Tangan yang memicit atau bahu diangkat menyebabkan ketegangan, yang menarik not keluar daripada tala.

items.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pegang violin di tempatnya dan petik tali D, tali 3.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Batang kayu memanjang dari pangkal pegangan hingga hujung. Bulu kuda terbentang di antaranya. Ketatkan skru sehingga pensel muat di antara bulu dan batang.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bengkokkan ibu jari dan letakkan hujungnya di pertemuan pangkal pegangan dengan batang. Letakkan jari lain di atas batang, dengan kelingking melengkung di atas. Pastikan seluruh tangan santai.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Bengkok, di pertemuan pangkal dengan batang

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flat on top of the stick
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari bengkok di pangkal membolehkan tangan santai dan mengimbangkan bow.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bulu tanpa rosin meluncur pada tali tanpa bunyi. Gosok blok rosin sepanjang bulu beberapa kali sebelum bermain. Lapisan nipis sudah cukup.

items.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Letakkan bow pada tali A, di tengah antara kekuda dan papan jari. Tarik perlahan ke kanan.

items.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang tali D. Angkat siku sedikit, kemudian tarik perlahan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari rendah ke tinggi: G, D, A, E. Setiap tali lima nama huruf di atas yang sebelumnya, selang yang dipanggil kelima. Cuba ingat: Good Dogs Always Eat.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Siku kanan menentukan tali yang digesek. Angkat untuk G, rendahkan untuk E. Setiap tali mempunyai aras sendiri, seperti anak tangga.

items.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Gesek tali G, kemudian D. Siku paling tinggi untuk G.

items.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang A, kemudian E. Rendahkan siku satu aras setiap kali.

items.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah memerlukan siku paling tinggi?

items.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali G paling jauh di kiri, jadi lengan diangkat untuk mencapainya. E memerlukan lengan paling rendah.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Orkestra menala kepada A. Timbre menunjukkan jarak setiap tali daripada notnya dalam sen; 100 sen ialah semiton, langkah terkecil pada piano. Tala A, kemudian D, G dan E.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Skru kecil pada pemegang tali ialah penala halus. Putar mengikut arah jam untuk menaikkan pic, lawan jam untuk merendahkannya. Suku pusingan sudah memadai.

items.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pic tali sedikit rendah. Apakah tindakan anda?

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Putar penala halus mengikut arah jam

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Putar penala halus melawan arah jam

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Rendah bermaksud pic terlalu rendah. Arah jam mengetatkan tali dan menaikkan pic.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jika penala halus mencapai hadnya, gunakan pasak. Putar sedikit sambil menolak ke dalam supaya kukuh. Jika tali jauh tersasar, minta bantuan guru; pasak boleh tergelincir.

items.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tala tali A, kemudian gesek dan kekalkan stabil.

items.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang D, G dan E. Tala setiap satu, kemudian gesek dan kekalkan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Violin pada tulang selangka, pegangan bow santai, bow di tengah antara kekuda dan papan jari. Sekarang mainkan semuanya daripada unit ini.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Gesek setiap tali terbuka dari tinggi ke rendah. Kekalkan setiap satu stabil.

items.source: Which string do you tune first?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Orkestra menala kepada A, jadi mulakan di situ dan tala yang lain selepasnya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb pada tali A: A terbuka, jari pertama satu ton ke atas untuk B, jari kedua satu ton lagi untuk C syap. Petik dahulu, kemudian gesek.

items.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari pertama pada tali A, satu ton ke atas. Itulah B.

items.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari kedua satu ton di atas jari pertama. Itulah C syap.

items.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C syap, B, A, B, kemudian C syap tiga kali.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

items.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary
items.translation: Gesekan panjang dan sekata, pertukaran tali bersih serta irama pertama anda.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gesekan turun menarik bow ke kanan, dari pangkal ke hujung. Gesekan naik menolaknya kembali ke kiri. Dalam notasi, tanda turun seperti meja kecil dan tanda naik seperti V.

items.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Main di tengah antara kekuda dan hujung papan jari. Kekalkan bow selari kekuda, seperti kereta api di landasannya.

items.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Satu gesekan turun perlahan, kemudian satu gesekan naik perlahan pada A. Kekalkan bunyi sekata hingga akhir.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet berlangsung satu detik. Not pantas memerlukan kurang bow, jadi gunakan separuh tengah bow dan kekalkan setiap gesekan sama panjang.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minim berlangsung dua detik. Gunakan gesekan lebih panjang dan perlahan supaya bunyi tidak pudar pada detik kedua.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah memerlukan lebih banyak bow?

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Minim berlangsung dua kali lebih lama, jadi memerlukan gesekan lebih panjang dan perlahan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk bertukar tali, ubah aras dengan siku, bukan pergelangan tangan. Tiba pada aras baharu tepat sebelum bow menukar arah.

items.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, E, A, E. Biarkan siku berayun antara dua aras.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah menggerakkan bow ke tali baharu?

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beralih dari G ke A melangkau tali D, jadi siku bergerak lebih jauh. Bergerak lancar dan jangan bunyikan tali di tengah.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kuaver berlangsung setengah detik, jadi dua muat dalam setiap detik. Gunakan gesekan kecil dan pantas dekat tengah bow.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa kuaver muat dalam satu detik?

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang campurkan: krocet, dua kuaver, kemudian dua krocet. Pemain fiddle menggunakan irama ini. Sebut dahulu: panjang, pendek-pendek, panjang, panjang.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gesekan lurus pada titik sentuhan, pertukaran dipimpin siku dan irama stabil. Inilah gabungan ketiga-tiganya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Di tengah antara kekuda dan papan jari

items.source: Right on top of the bridge
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 4 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title

items.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary
items.translation: Letakkan jari 1, 2 dan 3, mainkan skala A major dan lagu pertama anda.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Alat muzik anda tiada fret, jadi telinga menentukan setiap not. Ramai pemain menampal pita nipis pada papan jari sebagai panduan semasa belajar.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan hujung jari pertama pada tali A di pita pertama. Itulah B, satu ton di atas A; satu ton ialah dua semiton. Tekan sehingga tali menyentuh papan jari.

items.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A terbuka, kemudian B dengan jari pertama. Kekalkan B sehingga tepat tala.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Timbre menerima not dalam lingkungan 30 sen, kira-kira sepertiga semiton. Jika terlalu tinggi, gerakkan jari sedikit ke arah skrol. Jika terlalu rendah, gerakkan ke arah kekuda.

items.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, A terbuka, B. Angkat jari dan letakkan semula pada tempat sama.

items.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: A terbuka, kemudian B. Berapa jaraknya?

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari kedua memainkan C syap, satu ton di atas B, jadi tinggalkan jarak selepas jari pertama. Kedudukan ini dipanggil 2 tinggi kerana dekat tempat jari ketiga akan diletakkan.

items.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, B, C syap. Kekalkan jari pertama menekan semasa jari kedua bermain.

items.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari B ke not seterusnya: langkah jenis apa?

items.source: How far is C sharp above B?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa jarak C syap di atas B?

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B ke C syap ialah dua semiton, jadi jari kedua berjarak daripada jari pertama.

items.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, C syap, B, A. Pastikan setiap not tepat tala sebelum meneruskan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari ketiga memainkan D, semiton di atas C syap, jadi rapat dengan jari kedua. Pada tali A, polanya 1, kemudian 2 dan 3 bersama.

items.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, B, C syap, D. Kekalkan setiap jari menekan apabila menambah yang berikut.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Apabila D tepat tala, tali D terbuka turut bergetar. Kedua-duanya berkongsi nama huruf, berjarak lapan not: satu oktaf. Dengar violin berbunyi lebih penuh.

items.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D jari ketiga, D terbuka, kemudian D jari ketiga semula. Dengar deringannya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah bersentuhan pada tali A?

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B ke C syap ialah satu ton, jadi 1 dan 2 berjarak. C syap ke D ialah semiton, jadi 2 dan 3 bersentuhan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · title

items.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada tali E, jari pertama memainkan F syap, jari kedua tinggi G syap, dan ketiga A. Inilah bentuk tali A, satu tali lebih tinggi. Rendahkan lengan bow ke aras E.

items.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E, F syap, G syap, A. Bentuk sama seperti tali A.

items.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari ketiga pada E memainkan A. Dengan apa anda boleh menyemaknya?

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali A terbuka satu oktaf lebih rendah, jadi turut berdering apabila A anda tepat tala.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gabungkan dua bahagian: A, B, C syap, D pada tali A, kemudian E, F syap, G syap, A pada tali E. Lapan not, A ke A, satu bentuk dimainkan dua kali.

items.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik skala A major perlahan-lahan. Beralih ke E untuk empat not teratas.

items.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Perancis dari 1700-an ini hanya menggunakan not yang sudah dipelajari: A, B, C syap, D pada tali A, serta E dan F syap pada tali E.

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah memainkan F syap pada tali E?

items.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ton, ton, semiton: itulah pola pada A dan E. Pastikan setiap not tepat tala dan biarkan tali terbuka turut berdering.

items.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari kedua ke ketiga: langkah jenis apa?

items.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, C syap, D, kemudian D terbuka. Dengar deringannya.

items.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not apakah dimainkan 2 tinggi pada tali E?

items.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap, G syap, A pada tali E, kemudian A terbuka satu oktaf lebih rendah.

Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · title

items.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · unit summary
items.translation: Pola jari sama pada dua tali lebih rendah, D major dan tiga melodi.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · title
Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada tali D, jari pertama memainkan E, kedua tinggi F syap, dan ketiga G. Inilah pola tali A, satu tali lebih rendah. Angkat lengan bow satu aras.

items.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E, F syap, G. Jari kedua dan ketiga bersentuhan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G jari ketiga pada tali D satu oktaf di atas tali G terbuka. Apabila tepat tala, tali G turut bergetar.

items.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G jari ketiga, G terbuka, G jari ketiga. Dengar deringannya.

items.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada tali D, jari manakah bersentuhan?

items.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pola tali A sekali lagi: ton, ton, semiton. Semiton ialah antara 2 dan 3.

Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan D, E, F syap, G pada tali D, kemudian A, B, C syap, D pada tali A. Skala D major ialah satu bentuk jari dimainkan dua kali.

items.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik skala D major. Beralih ke tali A pada not kelima.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.translation: Not manakah syap dalam D major?

Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D major mempunyai dua syap, F syap dan C syap. Kedua-duanya 2 tinggi.

items.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lightly Row ialah lagu kanak-kanak Jerman lama. Ia berjalan naik dan turun skala D major pada tali D dan A.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?

Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada tali G, jari pertama memainkan A, kedua tinggi B, dan ketiga C. Bentuk sama sekali lagi. Angkat lengan bow ke aras tertinggi.

items.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G, A, B, C. Ayunkan siku kiri sedikit ke bawah violin untuk mencapai.

items.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A jari pertama pada tali G, kemudian tali A terbuka. Huruf sama, berbeza satu oktaf.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G, A, B, C pada tali G ditambah D, E, F syap, G pada tali D membentuk G major. Inilah oktaf pertama skala dua oktaf yang akan dilengkapkan dalam unit berikut.

items.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik skala G major. Bentuk sama pada kedua-dua tali.

Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beethoven menulis melodi ini untuk Simfoni Kesembilannya pada 1824. Ia kebanyakannya bergerak berlangkah, jadi jari anda berjalan.

items.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap baris berakhir panjang, pendek, panjang: krocet bertitik, kuaver dan minim. Titik selepas not menambah separuh tempohnya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · title
Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi fiddle Amerika lama ini mengikut irama yang anda gesek pada tali terbuka: panjang, pendek-pendek, panjang, panjang. Pemain fiddle memainkannya dalam sesi bersama di mana-mana.

items.source: Which string does this tune never use?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah tidak pernah digunakan melodi ini?

items.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia menggunakan tali D, A dan E.

items.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ton, ton, semiton berfungsi pada setiap tali setakat ini. Angkat lengan bow untuk tali rendah dan biarkan oktaf berdering.

items.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dua semakan oktaf: G dengan G terbuka, kemudian A dengan A terbuka.

items.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam D major, jari manakah memainkan C syap?

Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · title

items.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · unit summary
items.translation: Gerakkan jari kedua untuk menukar nada dasar: G major dua oktaf, A minor dan melodi fiddle.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gelongsorkan jari kedua ke belakang sehingga menyentuh jari pertama. Pada tali A, itulah C natural, semiton di bawah C syap. Pemain menamakannya 2 rendah.

items.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, B, C, D. Jari kedua menyentuh pertama; tinggalkan jarak sebelum ketiga.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 2 tinggi, 2 rendah, 2 tinggi, 2 rendah. Gerakkan jari kedua sahaja.

Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G major memerlukan C natural pada tali A dan G natural pada tali E, jadi jari kedua rendah di situ. Pada tali G dan D ia kekal tinggi.

items.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali A dalam G major: jari kedua rendah, menyentuh pertama.

items.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang E, F syap, G pada tali E. 2 rendah lagi.

items.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah jari kedua pada tali E dalam G major?

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G natural semiton di atas F syap, jadi jari kedua rapat dengan pertama.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mulakan pada G terbuka dan naik ke G pada tali E: lima belas not, dua oktaf. 2 tinggi pada tali rendah, 2 rendah pada tali tinggi.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A minor bermula dengan A jari pertama pada tali G. Jari kedua tinggi pada tali G untuk B, kemudian rendah pada tali D untuk F natural.

items.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A minor menaik. 2 tinggi pada tali G, 2 rendah pada tali D.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Its third note is a half step lower
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It starts on a lower string
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ia bermula pada tali lebih rendah

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A ke C berbunyi suram; A ke C syap cerah. Satu semiton mengubah seluruh suasana.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title

Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minuet ini daripada buku nota yang Bach berikan kepada isterinya Anna Magdalena pada 1725. Kini ia dikreditkan kepada Christian Petzold. Kira tiga detik setiap bar.

items.source: Which C does the minuet use?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Minuet dalam G major, jadi C natural dan jari kedua rendah pada tali A.

items.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap ialah 2 tinggi pada tali D: rendah pada A, tinggi pada D.

items.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Separuh kedua bermula tinggi: jari keempat mencapai B pada tali E. Kemudian ketiga, kemudian 2 rendah.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Old Joe Clark ialah melodi fiddle Appalachian. Dalam A tetapi menggunakan G natural: 2 tinggi untuk C syap pada tali A, 2 rendah untuk G pada tali E.

items.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E, F syap, G, F syap. Kekalkan jari kedua rendah, menyentuh pertama.

items.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G manakah digunakan melodi ini pada tali E?

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G natural menggantikan G syap memberikan bunyi old-time kepada Old Joe Clark.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Soldier's Joy dicetak di Scotland pada 1700-an dan masih dimainkan dalam tarian di seluruh Amerika. Bahagian pertamanya berayun pada A, F syap dan D, not kord D major.

items.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A terbuka, F syap 2 tinggi pada D, D terbuka, F syap. Ayunkan siku antara tali.

items.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah memainkan G pada tali E?

items.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Soldier's Joy dalam D major, jadi G natural: 2 tinggi untuk F syap pada D, 2 rendah untuk G pada E.

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap nada dasar menentukan jari kedua. Sebelum bermain, tanya: 2 tinggi atau 2 rendah, dan pada tali mana?

items.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: F syap, kemudian 2 tinggi atau 2 rendah?

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 2 rendah dan 2 tinggi pada tali A, kemudian 2 rendah dan 2 tinggi pada tali E.

items.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam A major, di manakah jari kedua pada tali A dan E?

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Low on A, high on E
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Rendah pada A, tinggi pada E

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · title

items.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · unit summary
items.translation: Kuat dan lembut, slur, jari keempat, langkah pertama ke vibrato serta Ode to Joy lengkap.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tambah berat lengan, lajukan bow dan dekatkan titik sentuhan ke kekuda. Gunakan ketiga-tiganya bersama. Untuk lembut, buat sebaliknya.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Muzik menandakan kuat dengan f, forte, dan lembut dengan p, piano. Semakin kuat ialah crescendo; semakin lembut ialah diminuendo.

items.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Untuk bermain forte, ke manakah bow bergerak?

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dekat kekuda, tali menerima lebih berat dan kelajuan, jadi bunyi lebih kuat tanpa geseran kasar.

items.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Setiap not dua kali: forte, kemudian piano. Kekalkan tepat tala ketika kelantangan berubah.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Garisan melengkung di atas not ialah slur: mainkan semuanya dalam satu gesekan. Tangan kiri menukar not sementara bow terus bergerak.

items.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Slur A ke B dalam satu gesekan turun, kemudian B ke A dalam satu gesekan naik.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dua not dalam satu gesekan bermakna setiap satu mendapat separuh bow. Rancang dahulu dan mulakan slur dengan bow mencukupi untuk kedua-dua not.

items.source: What does a slur tell you?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Play the notes in one bow
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
