Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Satu ton di atas jari ketiga

items.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari keempat mencapai satu ton di atas ketiga. Pada tali D, itulah A, not sama seperti tali A terbuka. Lengkungkan jari dan biarkan tangan condong ke arahnya.

items.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A jari keempat pada tali D, A terbuka, kemudian jari keempat semula. Padankan dengan tepat.

items.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapa gunakan jari keempat, bukan tali terbuka?

items.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Tidak perlu tukar tali, bunyi lebih hangat

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Open strings are out of tune
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not berjari mengekalkan frasa pada satu tali dan sebati dengan not sekeliling. Tali terbuka berdering lebih cerah.

items.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D jari ketiga, E jari keempat pada tali A, kemudian E terbuka. Dengar padanannya.

items.source: D to A on one string
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 5 (along) · title
items.translation: D ke A pada satu tali

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Amazing Grace dinyanyikan dengan melodi Amerika awal bernama New Britain. Pasangan not pantasnya berslur. Biarkan not panjang bernyanyi dengan gesekan penuh dan perlahan.

items.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G ke B dan kembali melintasi tali. Ayunkan dengan lancar dari siku.

items.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah menggesek pasangan pantas seperti B ke G?

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not itu berslur, jadi berkongsi satu gesekan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Vibrato ialah alunan pic kecil dan sekata yang menghidupkan not panjang. Hujung jari bergolek sedikit ke belakang dari not dan kembali, berulang-ulang, digerakkan tangan dan lengan.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Vibrato tidak boleh menyelamatkan not sumbang; ia hanya mewarnai not yang tepat. Kebanyakan pemain menambahnya setelah jari dapat mencari tala tepat tanpa tercari-cari.

items.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari kedua pada tali A. Kekalkan hujung jari, rehatkan sendi, dan ayunkan tangan perlahan ke arah skrol lalu kembali. Kecil dan sekata. Pemerhatian guru membantu di sini.

items.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang gesek tanpa vibrato dan tepatkan setiap not. Titik tepat itulah permulaan vibrato.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Arkansas Traveler telah dicetak menjelang 1847. Pemain fiddle menslur not terpantasnya berpasangan, memberikan lantunan. Mulakan perlahan dan kekalkan pasangan sekata.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapa pemain fiddle menslur pasangan pantas?

items.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It keeps the strings in tune
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, G, F syap, A pada tali E: jari ketiga, 2 rendah, pertama, ketiga.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gabungkan semuanya: jari tepat tala, bow lurus, slur dan dinamik. Mulakan piano, kuatkan di tengah, dan akhiri forte.

items.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pemanasan: jari keempat berbanding tali terbuka, A kemudian E.

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello course · title

items.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
items.context: Cello course · course subtitle
items.translation: Duduk, gesek dan main tepat tala, dari tali terbuka hingga The Swan

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

items.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary
items.translation: Duduk, laraskan pasak hujung, pegang bow, mainkan tali terbuka dan lagu pertama.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

items.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari rendah ke tinggi, tali ialah C, G, D dan A. C paling tebal dan rendah. A paling nipis dan tinggi, dan dinamakan tali 1.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C ialah tali paling tebal dan rendah. Tali dikira dari A (1) hingga C (4).

items.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik tali 1, A, dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang tali paling tebal, C. Biarkan bergema rendah.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Duduk dekat tepi hadapan kerusi, tapak kaki rata dan lutut terpisah, seolah-olah mudah berdiri. Selo terletak antara lutut.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tarik pasak hujung sehingga tepi atas selo menyentuh dada pada tulang dada dan pasak C dekat telinga kiri. Ketatkan skru. Alas atau tali penahan menghalangnya daripada tergelincir.

items.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah tepi atas selo menyentuh anda?

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selo bersandar ke dada, dan lutut menstabilkannya dengan ringan dari sisi.

items.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Duduk tegak, petik D, kemudian G. Pastikan bahu santai.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bengkokkan ibu jari dan letakkan hujungnya di pertemuan pangkal bow dengan batang, bertentangan jari tengah. Letakkan keempat-empat jari di atas batang dan biarkan tangan tergantung berat.

items.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Letakkan bow pada tali D, di tengah antara kekuda dan papan jari. Tarik perlahan ke kanan.

items.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang tali A. Gerakkan seluruh lengan ke arasnya, kemudian tarik perlahan.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari rendah ke tinggi: C, G, D, A. Setiap tali lima nama huruf di atas yang sebelumnya, selang yang dipanggil kelima. Cuba ingat: Cats Go Dancing Around.

items.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lengan kanan menentukan tali yang digesek. Setiap tali mempunyai aras lengan sendiri, seperti anak tangga. Gerakkan seluruh lengan, bukan tangan sahaja.

items.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Gesek tali C, kemudian G. Biarkan lengan menetap pada setiap aras.

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

items.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Orkestra menala kepada A. Timbre menunjukkan jarak setiap tali daripada notnya dalam sen; 100 sen ialah semiton, langkah terkecil pada piano. Tala A, kemudian D, G dan C.

items.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang D, G dan C. Tala setiap satu, kemudian gesek dan kekalkan.

items.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Duduk tegak dengan pasak hujung dilaras, pegangan bow santai, bow di tengah antara kekuda dan papan jari. Sekarang mainkan semuanya daripada unit ini.

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb pada tali D: D terbuka, jari pertama satu ton ke atas untuk E, jari ketiga dua ton ke atas untuk F syap. Petik dahulu, kemudian gesek.

items.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari pertama pada tali D, satu ton ke atas. Itulah E.

items.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari ketiga, satu ton di atas jari pertama. Itulah F syap.

items.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap, E, D, E, kemudian F syap tiga kali.

items.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Satu gesekan turun perlahan, kemudian satu gesekan naik perlahan pada D. Kekalkan bunyi sekata hingga akhir.

items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, A, D, A. Biarkan lengan berayun antara dua aras.

items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beralih dari C ke D melangkau tali G, jadi lengan bergerak lebih jauh. Bergerak lancar dan jangan bunyikan tali di tengah.

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title

items.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary
items.translation: Satu jari setiap semiton: mainkan D major dan melodi pertama.

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semiton ialah jarak nada terkecil dalam muzik. Dalam kedudukan pertama, jari-jari anda berjarak semiton antara satu sama lain, bermula satu ton (dua semiton) di atas tali terbuka. Ibu jari di belakang leher, bertentangan dengan jari kedua.

items.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, kemudian E dengan jari pertama. Tahan E sehingga tepat tala.

items.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari yang sama pada tali A: A terbuka, kemudian B.

items.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: D terbuka, kemudian E. Berapa jaraknya?

items.source: First finger on D and A
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: Jari pertama pada D dan A

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari ketiga memainkan F syap, satu ton di atas E. Biarkan jari kedua berada di atas tempatnya antara 1 dan 3 supaya tangan anda mengekalkan bentuknya.

items.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E, F syap. Kekalkan jari pertama pada tali semasa jari ketiga bermain.

items.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari E ke not seterusnya: jarak apakah ini?

items.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapakah jari kedua kekal di atas tempatnya?

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Setiap jari mempunyai ruang semiton. Mengekalkan keempat-empat jari pada tempatnya memastikan setiap not dimainkan di tempat yang sama setiap kali.

items.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jari yang sama pada tali A: A terbuka, B, C syap.

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari keempat memainkan G, semiton di atas F syap. D, E, F syap, G ialah separuh pertama skala D major: terbuka, 1, 3, 4.

items.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E, F syap, G: terbuka, 1, 3, 4.

items.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G dengan jari keempat pada tali D ialah satu oktaf di atas tali G terbuka: huruf yang sama, lapan not lebih tinggi. Apabila tepat tala, tali G turut bergetar.

items.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G dengan jari keempat, G terbuka, kemudian G dengan jari keempat sekali lagi. Dengarkan resonansnya.

items.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan D, E, F syap, G pada tali D, kemudian A, B, C syap, D pada tali A. Jari yang sama dua kali: terbuka, 1, 3, 4.

items.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah yang memainkan D major pada setiap tali?

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Perancis dari abad 1700-an ini hanya menggunakan not yang telah anda pelajari: D, E, F syap, G pada tali D, serta A dan B pada tali A.

items.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah yang memainkan B pada tali A?

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Terbuka, 1, 3, 4 pada tali D dan A. Kekalkan bentuk tangan, pastikan setiap not tepat tala dan biarkan oktaf beresonans.

items.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari jari ketiga ke jari keempat: jarak apakah ini?

items.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dua semakan oktaf: G dengan G terbuka, kemudian D dengan jari keempat dengan D terbuka.

items.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah yang memainkan C syap pada tali A?

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

items.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary
items.translation: Dua tali rendah, skala C major dan G major, serta tiga melodi klasik.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Jari yang sama, tali lebih rendah

items.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada tali G, jari pertama memainkan A, jari ketiga B dan jari keempat C. Jarak yang sama seperti pada D. Letakkan lengan anda pada aras tali G.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G, A, B, C pada tali G ditambah D, E, F syap, G pada tali D membentuk skala G major. Jari yang sama pada kedua-dua tali.

items.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah yang memainkan C pada tali G?

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada tali C, jari pertama memainkan D, jari ketiga E dan jari keempat F. Tali yang tebal memerlukan gesekan bow yang perlahan dan lebih berat untuk berbunyi.

items.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C, D, E, F: terbuka, 1, 3, 4. Beri setiap not masa untuk berbunyi.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C, D, E, F pada tali C ditambah G, A, B, C pada tali G ialah skala C major. Tiada not syap langsung.

items.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik mengikut skala C major. Di puncak, dengarkan C beresonans dengan tali C terbuka.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari kedua memainkan F natural pada tali D, semiton di bawah F syap, dan C natural pada tali A. C major memerlukan kedua-duanya.

items.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E, F, G: terbuka, 1, 2, 4. Jari kedua terletak betul-betul di sebelah jari pertama.

items.source: E, then second finger or third?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: E, kemudian jari kedua atau ketiga?

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain selo memperuntukkan satu semiton untuk setiap jari, jadi F menggunakan jari kedua dan F syap menggunakan jari ketiga. Not di luar jangkauan tangan, seperti F syap pada tali C, memerlukan regangan, iaitu bukaan tangan yang lebih luas. Kursus ini memilih nada dasar yang tidak memerlukannya.

items.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C major, oktaf kedua: jari kedua untuk F dan C paling tinggi.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: Ode to Joy, satu oktaf lebih tinggi

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Brahms menulis lagu dodoi ini pada 1868. Iramanya berayun dalam tiga detik pada tali G dan D. Gunakan gesekan bow yang panjang dan perlahan, serta beri setiap frasa ruang untuk bernafas.

items.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G, F syap, E: jari 4, 3, 1. Inilah bahagian paling tinggi dalam lagu dodoi ini.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Au clair de la lune ialah lagu rakyat Perancis dari abad 1700-an. Ia dimainkan pada tali G dan D, dengan C di bawah jari keempat anda.

items.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, C, B, A, G: D terbuka, kemudian jari 4, 3, 1 dan G terbuka.

items.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah dalam lagu ini dimainkan pada tali terbuka?

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Terbuka, 1, 3, 4 pada setiap tali, dengan jari kedua untuk F dan C natural. Gesek bow perlahan dan lebih berat pada tali rendah.

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dua semakan oktaf: C dengan C terbuka, kemudian G dengan G terbuka.

items.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Nada dasar manakah ini yang tiada syap?

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · title

items.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · unit summary
items.translation: Gelongsor ke kedudukan keempat, semak dengan pendengaran dan mainkan The Swan serta Amazing Grace.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Peralihan kedudukan menggerakkan seluruh tangan anda ke tempat baharu pada tali. Ringankan tekanan jari, gelongsorkannya di sepanjang tali tanpa mengangkatnya, dan biarkan ibu jari bergerak bersama tangan.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan keempat, jari pertama memainkan D pada tali A, iaitu not yang dimainkan oleh jari keempat dalam kedudukan pertama. Ibu jari anda terletak pada bahagian leher yang melengkung ke badan selo.

items.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B dengan jari pertama, kemudian gelongsorkan jari itu ke atas hingga D. Kekalkan tekanan ringan semasa bergerak.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang bergerak semasa peralihan kedudukan?

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Menggerakkan tangan sebagai satu unit mengekalkan jarak antara jari supaya not seterusnya juga tepat tala.

items.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Beralih ke atas, kembali dan ke atas semula dengan jari pertama. Pastikan setiap not tepat tala.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan keempat pada tali A, jari pertama memainkan D, jari ketiga E dan jari keempat F. Bentuk tangan sama seperti kedudukan pertama: satu jari bagi setiap semiton.

items.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D, E, F: jari 1, 3, 4. Di sini, jarak antara not sedikit lebih rapat.

items.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A terbuka, B, beralih dengan jari pertama ke D, kemudian E dengan jari ketiga.

items.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan keempat pada tali A, jari manakah yang memainkan E?

items.source: Up to fourth position and back
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: Naik ke kedudukan keempat dan kembali

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · title

items.source: Check it with the open A
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan keempat pada tali D, jari pertama memainkan G dan jari ketiga memainkan A, not yang sama dengan tali A terbuka. Mainkan kedua-duanya satu demi satu dan padankan bunyinya.

items.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G dengan jari pertama, kemudian A dengan jari ketiga, kedua-duanya pada tali D.

items.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A dalam kedudukan keempat, A terbuka, A dalam kedudukan keempat. Samakan bunyinya.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan E dengan jari pertama dalam kedudukan pertama, kemudian gelongsorkan jari itu ke atas hingga G. Jaraknya tiga semiton, sama seperti B ke D pada tali A.

items.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E dengan jari pertama, kemudian gelongsor ke G dengan jari pertama. Biarkan ibu jari turut bergerak.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: The Swan berasal daripada The Carnival of the Animals, yang ditulis oleh Camille Saint-Saëns pada 1886. Ini ialah frasa pembukaannya, satu oktaf lebih rendah dan dipermudah.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not panjang memerlukan gesekan bow yang perlahan. Kekalkan bow dekat dengan kekuda dan gunakan panjang bow secara sekata supaya setiap not bertahan hingga akhir tanpa semakin lemah.

items.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G, F syap, B: jari keempat dan ketiga pada D, kemudian jari ketiga pada G.

items.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah anda mengelakkan not panjang daripada semakin lemah?

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Tekan lebih kuat pada akhir not

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam Amazing Grace, D tinggi hadir sejurus selepas A terbuka. Semasa A berbunyi, gelongsorkan tangan anda ke kedudukan keempat dan mainkan D dengan jari pertama.

items.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, A terbuka, kemudian D dengan jari pertama dalam kedudukan keempat. Bergerak semasa A berbunyi.

items.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bilakah waktu paling mudah untuk beralih kedudukan?

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: In the middle of a long note
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Semasa tali terbuka berbunyi, tangan kiri anda bebas, jadi peralihan kedudukan tidak kedengaran.

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ringankan tekanan jari, gerakkan tangan dan ibu jari bersama-sama, dan semak tempat anda mendarat. Tali terbuka akan membantu anda memastikan ketepatannya.

items.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A dalam kedudukan keempat pada tali D, kemudian A terbuka. Padankan bunyinya.

items.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan keempat, not manakah yang dimainkan oleh jari pertama pada tali A?

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Mandolin course · title

items.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
items.context: Mandolin course · course subtitle
items.translation: Daripada tali berpasangan hingga lagu fiddle dan chop bluegrass

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · title

items.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · unit summary
items.translation: Kenali tali berpasangan, talakannya dan mainkan keempat-empat not terbuka.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mandolin mempunyai lapan tali dalam empat pasangan, yang dipanggil kursus tali. Kedua-dua tali dalam setiap pasangan ditala kepada not yang sama dan dimainkan bersama, jadi setiap pasangan dianggap sebagai satu tali.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pasangan paling dekat dengan muka anda ialah yang paling rendah, pasangan 4. Pasangan paling dekat dengan lantai ialah yang paling tinggi, pasangan 1. Apabila pelajaran menyebut tali 3, maksudnya ialah pasangan ketiga.

items.source: How do you play a pair?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Both strings at once, as one note
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Kedua-dua tali serentak, sebagai satu not

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Satu tali, kemudian tali yang satu lagi

items.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kedua-dua tali terletak rapat, jadi satu petikan menyentuh kedua-duanya. Bersama-sama, bunyinya menjadi satu not yang lebih penuh.

items.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik pasangan paling rendah, pasangan 4, dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap pasangan perlu sepadan dengan penala dan antara kedua-dua talinya. Jika dua tali itu tidak sepadan, anda akan mendengar denyutan perlahan. Tala satu tali, kemudian tala pasangannya kepada not yang sama.

items.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 3, pasangan D. Tala kedua-dua tali sehingga denyutan berhenti.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Satu pasangan mempunyai denyutan perlahan. Apakah masalahnya?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Denyutan itu berlaku kerana pic kedua-dua tali sedikit berbeza. Tala kedua-duanya sehingga bunyinya sekata.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Longgarkan sedikit hingga di bawah not sasaran, kemudian ketatkan hingga mencapainya. Menala dari bawah mengelakkan tali daripada tergelincir menjadi terlalu rendah kemudian.

items.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 4, kemudian pasangan 1. Tala setiap tali naik ke not sasaran dari bawah.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pegang plektrum antara bahagian lembut ibu jari dan sisi jari telunjuk yang dibengkokkan. Biarkan hujungnya sahaja terkeluar. Longgarkan pergelangan tangan, seolah-olah anda mengibas air dari tangan.

items.source: How much of the pick should show?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa banyak bahagian plektrum patut terkeluar?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Hujung yang pendek memberi kawalan dan bunyi yang jelas. Jika terlalu banyak plektrum terkeluar, ia mudah tersangkut pada tali berpasangan.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gerakkan plektrum ke bawah merentasi kedua-dua tali dalam satu pasangan dengan satu gerakan kecil, dan berhenti sejurus selepasnya. Letakkan pangkal tapak tangan dengan ringan dekat kekuda.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 5 (along) · title
items.translation: Empat ke bawah, empat ke bawah

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari rendah ke tinggi, pasangannya ialah G, D, A dan E. Cuba ingat: Good Dogs Always Eat. Biola ditala dengan cara yang sama, jadi lagu fiddle sesuai dimainkan pada mandolin.

items.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Rendah ke tinggi: G, D, A, E.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pasangan manakah yang berbunyi lebih rendah?

items.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang tinggi ke rendah: E, A, D, G.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pasangan yang tepat tala, pegangan plektrum yang santai dan empat not terbuka. Mainkan setiap not dengan jelas, dengan kedua-dua tali dalam pasangan berbunyi.

items.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pasangan manakah yang mempunyai pic paling tinggi?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pasangan dikira daripada yang paling tinggi, pasangan 1, hingga yang paling rendah, pasangan 4.

items.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, G, E, D. Cari setiap pasangan berdasarkan namanya.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb dimainkan pada pasangan D: D terbuka, E pada fret 2 dengan jari pertama, dan F syap pada fret 4 dengan jari kedua.

items.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 3, fret 2, jari pertama. Itulah E.

items.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 3, fret 4, jari kedua. Itulah F syap.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · title

items.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · unit summary
items.translation: Tekan not pada fret dengan jelas, pelajari dua fret bagi setiap jari dan mainkan skala D major.

items.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tekan kedua-dua tali dalam satu pasangan dengan satu hujung jari, betul-betul di belakang fret logam. Tali mandolin tegang, jadi gunakan hujung jari dan tekan sekadar yang perlu untuk menghasilkan not yang jelas.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah hujung jari anda diletakkan?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Betul-betul di belakang fret memerlukan tekanan paling sedikit dan menghasilkan not paling jelas.

items.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Terbuka, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fret mandolin rapat, jadi setiap jari meliputi dua fret. Jari pertama memainkan fret 1 dan 2, jari kedua 3 dan 4, jari ketiga 5 dan 6, dan jari kelingking 7.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Setiap jari meliputi dua fret pada mandolin, jadi jari kedua memainkan fret 3 dan 4.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pasangan A menggunakan cara yang sama: terbuka ialah A, fret 2 ialah B, fret 4 ialah C♯ dan fret 5 ialah D. Tangan anda kekal di tempatnya.

items.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Terbuka, kemudian jari pertama, kedua dan ketiga pada pasangan 2.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gabungkan dua bentuk itu untuk mendapatkan skala D major: D, E, F♯, G pada pasangan 3, kemudian A, B, C♯, D pada pasangan 2. Banyak lagu fiddle menggunakan nada dasar ini.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang hadir selepas G dalam skala D major?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selepas G pada pasangan 3 hadir A. Mainkannya pada pasangan A terbuka, bukan dengan menjangkau fret 7.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Beethoven hanya menggunakan lima not pertama D major, pada pasangan 3 dan 2. Kekalkan jari-jari anda dekat di atas tali antara not.

items.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F♯ dan G pada pasangan 3, kemudian pasangan A terbuka.

items.source: Where does the second phrase land?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada not manakah frasa kedua berakhir?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Frasa pertama berhenti pada E dan kedengaran belum selesai. Frasa kedua berakhir pada D dan terasa seperti pulang ke asal.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada pasangan E, fret 2 ialah F♯, fret 3 ialah G dan fret 5 ialah A. Jari pertama, kedua dan ketiga, seperti sebelumnya.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Fret 3 berada dalam kawasan jari kedua, iaitu fret 3 dan 4.

items.source: A to A over two pairs
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 4 (along) · title
items.translation: A ke A merentasi dua pasangan

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · title

items.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama, kedua dan ketiga pada fret 2, 4 dan 5, dengan pasangan terbuka di antaranya. Mainkan dengan lancar dan biarkan setiap not berbunyi hingga not seterusnya.

items.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Selang-seli not skala: D, F♯, A, D.

items.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda memerlukan C♯ pada pasangan 2. Fret mana?

items.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pada pasangan 2, fret 2 ialah B, fret 3 ialah C dan fret 4 ialah C♯.

items.source: Does the tune go up or down?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: D all the way up to A
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Ode to Joy, up to speed
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: Ode to Joy, pada tempo penuh

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · title

items.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · unit summary
items.translation: Petik berselang-seli dalam not kuaver dan buat not panjang terus bernyanyi dengan tremolo.

items.source: Down on the beat, up between
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Ke bawah pada detik, ke atas di antaranya

items.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik ke bawah pada setiap detik dan ke atas pada kiraan “dan” di antaranya. Tangan anda berayun seperti bandul, bawah, atas, bawah, atas, walaupun not seterusnya belum dimainkan.

items.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Petikan manakah yang jatuh pada detik?

items.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ke bawah pada detik dan ke atas di antaranya mengekalkan tangan anda mengikut masa, seperti kayu dram pemain dram.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 4 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Apabila anda beralih ke pasangan lain, tangan anda terus berayun bawah-atas. Lengan bawah membawa tangan merentasi pasangan; pergelangan tangan mengekalkan detik.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda beralih ke pasangan baharu pada kiraan “dan”. Petikan mana?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Setiap “dan” menggunakan petikan ke atas. Biar ayunan bandul menentukan arah, bukan tali.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not mandolin cepat pudar. Tremolo mengekalkan bunyinya: petik ke bawah dan ke atas dengan cepat dan sekata pada satu pasangan supaya not kedengaran tanpa putus.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 3 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang menghasilkan tremolo yang baik?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kekalkan plektrum dekat dengan tali dan petikan sekata. Kelajuan menyusul kemudian, setelah gerakan menjadi santai.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mulakan dengan mengira empat petikan bagi setiap detik. Apabila semakin mudah, berhenti mengira dan kekalkan gerakan cepat serta sekata. Detik terletak pada kaki anda, bukan pada plektrum.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Amazing Grace bergerak dengan tiga detik setiap bar. Gunakan tremolo sepanjang setiap not panjang dan tukar not tepat pada detik. Dua not baharu ialah A dan B pada pasangan G.

items.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 4, fret 2 dengan jari pertama, kemudian fret 4 dengan jari kedua.

items.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah anda mengekalkan A panjang pada akhir lagu?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Satu petikan akan pudar jauh sebelum tiga detik tamat. Tremolo mengekalkan bunyinya hingga akhir bar.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ke bawah pada detik, ke atas di antaranya, dan tremolo apabila not perlu dipanjangkan. Kekalkan setiap petikan kecil.
