items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Petikan manakah yang memainkan “dan” selepas detik 2?

items.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Setiap “dan” menggunakan petikan ke atas, tidak kira di mana not itu berada.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · title

items.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · unit summary
items.translation: G, D, C, E minor dan A, kemudian kord pendek yang diredam segera untuk menggerakkan irama bluegrass.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 2 pasangan 2, jari kedua pada fret 3 pasangan 1. Pasangan 4 dan 3 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sapukan plektrum ke bawah merentasi keempat-empat pasangan dalam satu gerakan lancar, dari rendah ke tinggi. Gerakan kecil dan ringan sudah memadai; kord mandolin berbunyi terang.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 2 pasangan 4, jari kedua pada fret 2 pasangan 1. Pasangan 3 dan 2 berbunyi terbuka.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 2 pasangan 3, jari kedua pada fret 3 pasangan 2. Pasangan 4 dan 1 berbunyi terbuka.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari C, gelongsorkan jari kedua ke belakang hingga fret 2. Kord menjadi lebih suram, walaupun hanya satu jari bergerak.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fret 2 pada pasangan 4 dan 3, fret 4 pada pasangan 2, fret 5 pada pasangan 1: jari pertama, kedua, ketiga dan keempat. Tiada pasangan berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapakah penting bahawa tiada pasangan berbunyi terbuka?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: You can silence it by easing off
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It keeps the chord in tune
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Apabila setiap pasangan ditekan, merehatkan jari menghentikan bunyi serta-merta. Itulah rahsia chop.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Chop ialah kord pendek pada detik 2 dan 4. Strum ke bawah, kemudian kurangkan tekanan jari pada tali tanpa mengangkatnya supaya bunyi berhenti serta-merta.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bes dan gitar memainkan detik 1 dan 3. Mandolin menjawab pada 2 dan 4, seperti dram snare.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Biarkan kord berbunyi seketika sahaja. Jika berlarutan, rehatkan jari lebih awal. Hujung jari anda terus menyentuh tali sepanjang masa.

items.source: Chops in G, C and D
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · title
items.translation: Chop dalam G, C dan D

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bentuk A anda boleh digunakan di mana-mana pada leher. Gelongsorkannya naik tiga fret untuk C dan lima fret untuk D. Kekalkan kedudukan keempat-empat jari semasa bergerak.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G memerlukan regangan baharu: jari pertama fret 2 pada pasangan 2, jari kedua fret 3 pada pasangan 1, jari ketiga fret 5 pada pasangan 3, jari kelingking fret 7 pada pasangan 4.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum kord terbuka untuk mengenali bunyinya, kemudian mainkan chop pada 2 dan 4 untuk menggerakkan irama kumpulan. Kekalkan detik stabil sepanjang setiap pertukaran.

items.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Chop anda terus berbunyi. Bagaimanakah membaikinya?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Kurangkan tekanan jari pada fret lebih awal

items.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Chop diredam oleh tangan pada fret. Kurangkan tekanan tetapi kekalkan hujung jari pada tali.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · title

items.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · unit summary
items.translation: Lima lagu tradisional untuk sesi muzik bersama, dipermudah, daripada Boil Them Cabbage Down hingga Old Joe Clark.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Lagu pertama untuk sesi muzik bersama

items.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu ini dimainkan pada pasangan E dan A dan kerap kembali ke F♯. Petik ke bawah pada detik dan ke atas di antaranya, sama seperti latihan kuaver anda.

items.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F♯, G dan A pada pasangan 1 di fret 2, 3 dan 5, kemudian D pada pasangan 2, fret 5.

items.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada not manakah lagu ini berakhir?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Seperti kebanyakan lagu dalam D, ia berakhir pada D, not asal.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bahagian rendah Angeline the Baker hanya menggunakan D, E, F♯, A dan B. Kedua-dua bahagian berakhir pada A dan bukannya D, lalu membawa lagu kembali ke awal.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which note do both parts end on?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada not manakah kedua-dua bahagian berakhir?

items.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Berakhir pada A dan bukannya D membiarkan lagu terasa tergantung, lalu terus mengalir ke ulangan seterusnya.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Soldier's Joy telah dicetak di Scotland menjelang 1780 dan sejak itu sering dimainkan dalam sesi muzik bersama di Amerika. Bahagian pertamanya melompat antara D, F♯ dan A.

items.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan A terbuka, pasangan 3 fret 4, D terbuka, kemudian fret 4 sekali lagi.

items.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D, F♯ dan A bersama-sama membentuk kord apa?

items.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D, F♯ dan A ialah tiga not D major. Lagu fiddle sering mengikut not kordnya seperti ini.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Arkansas Traveler bermula rendah pada pasangan G, kemudian melompat ke pasangan E untuk bahagian yang menuruni skala. Lagu ini telah dicetak menjelang tahun 1840-an.

items.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pasangan 4, fret 2 dan 4, kemudian pasangan D terbuka.

items.source: Where does the high part begin?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia bermula pada A di fret 5 pasangan 1, kemudian menurun melalui G, F♯ dan E.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: A new key and a twist
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Old Joe Clark dalam nada dasar A, jadi anda menggunakan C♯ dan G♯. Dalam bahagian kedua, G♯ turun ke G biasa pada fret 3 pasangan E. Satu not itu memberikan bunyi old-time kepada lagu ini.

items.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G♯ pada pasangan 3, fret 6; pasangan A terbuka; kemudian G pada pasangan 1, fret 3.

items.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah yang memberikan bunyi old-time kepada bahagian kedua?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A major menggunakan G♯. Menurunkannya ke G menghasilkan bunyi Mixolydian yang banyak terdapat dalam muzik old-time dan bluegrass.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan setiap lagu hingga tamat pada tempo yang stabil. Jika tersilap satu not, terus gerakkan tangan pemetik dan sambung pada detik seterusnya. Begitulah sesi muzik bersama yang sebenar.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lagu manakah yang menggantikan G♯ dengan G?

items.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Old Joe Clark dalam nada dasar A tetapi menggunakan G dalam bahagian kedua. Not yang direndahkan itu ialah ciri khasnya.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · title

items.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary
items.translation: Tambahkan gerakan tangan kiri dan petikan bergulung tangan kanan yang memberi lagu bunyi bluegrass.

items.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik satu not, kemudian kekalkan tekanan sambil menggelongsorkan jari yang sama naik ke fret lebih tinggi. Not baharu berbunyi tanpa petikan kedua. Rahsianya ialah tekanan ringan dan stabil.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang membunyikan not kedua dalam gelongsoran?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Jari yang terus menekan semasa bergerak

items.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Hanya not pertama dipetik. Kekalkan tekanan pada tali semasa menggelongsor, atau bunyi not akan terhenti dalam perjalanan.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik satu pasangan terbuka, kemudian hentakkan hujung jari betul-betul di belakang fret 2. Not baharu berbunyi daripada hentakan itu sahaja, tanpa petikan kedua.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebaliknya: dengan jari pada fret 2, petik, kemudian tarik jari sedikit ke sisi sambil mengangkatnya. Gerakan itu memetik not terbuka yang lebih rendah.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Gerakan manakah yang membunyikan not tanpa plektrum?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ketiga-tiganya membunyikan not kedua dengan tangan pada fret. Plektrum hanya memainkan not pertama.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu fiddle menjadi hidup dengan hiasan kecil. Di sini, dua not A biasa pada pembukaan Old Joe Clark menjadi A, B, A: satu hammer-on dan satu pull-off.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam A, B, A, berapa kali anda memetik?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Petik A pertama, hammer-on ke B dan pull-off kembali ke A. Satu petikan, tiga not.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 4 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Crosspicking memetik not tunggal merentasi tiga pasangan dalam corak berulang, supaya kord berbunyi seperti riak. Lapan not dibahagikan kepada tiga, tiga dan dua.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah lapan not dalam satu bar crosspicking dikumpulkan?

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Corak tiga not yang diulang sepanjang bar dengan lapan not membuat aksen beralih setiap kali. Itulah rasa bergulungnya.

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Ripple through G, C and D
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: Riak melalui G, C dan D

items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gelongsoran, hammer-on, chop dan crosspicking. Latih setiap satunya mengikut kemampuan anda, dan yang paling penting, kekalkan detik stabil.

items.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
items.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo course · title

items.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
items.context: Banjo course · course subtitle
items.translation: Lima tali, G terbuka: roll, lagu old-time dan clawhammer

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · title

items.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · unit summary
items.translation: Kenali lima tali, tala kepada G terbuka, cari tali dengung dan mainkan sebuah lagu.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banjo mempunyai empat tali sepanjang leher dan tali kelima yang bermula di pertengahan leher, pada pasak tala kecilnya sendiri. Tali pendek itu memberikan bunyi khas banjo.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tali 1 ialah tali nipis paling dekat dengan lantai. Tali 2, 3 dan 4 menyusul ke arah muka anda. Tali pendek di atas ialah tali 5.

items.source: Which string is the short one?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali kelima terletak di sebelah tali 4 tetapi bermula pada fret kelima, dengan pasaknya di sisi leher.

items.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik tali 1, tali nipis paling dekat dengan lantai.

items.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang tali pendek, tali 5. Petik dengan ibu jari.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Penalaan standard banjo ialah G terbuka. Dari tali 4 hingga tali 1, notnya ialah D, G, B, D, dan tali kelima yang pendek ialah G tinggi. Apabila distrum terbuka, semuanya membentuk kord G.

items.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 4, 3, 2 dan 1: D, G, B, D.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: What chord do the open strings make?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord apakah yang dibentuk oleh tali terbuka?

items.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G, B dan D ialah not kord G. Itulah sebabnya penalaan ini dipanggil G terbuka.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banjo bluegrass menggunakan plektrum ibu jari plastik dan dua plektrum jari logam, pada telunjuk dan jari tengah. Plektrum jari menghala ke bawah, melengkung mengikut arah hujung jari anda.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Buat masa ini, ibu jari memainkan tali 3, 4 dan 5, telunjuk memainkan tali 2 dan jari tengah memainkan tali 1. Letakkan jari manis dan kelingking dengan ringan pada membran banjo.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari memainkan tali 3, 4 dan 5, telunjuk memainkan tali 2 dan jari tengah memainkan tali 1.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tali kelima ialah tali dengung: anda memainkannya terbuka di antara not melodi, dan bunyinya mengiringi semuanya. Dalam pelajaran ini, anda tidak pernah menekannya pada fret.

items.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mula-mula tali 5, kemudian tali 1. Mana lebih tinggi?

items.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapakah tali kelima berbunyi begitu tinggi?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It is short and tuned to high G
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ia pendek dan ditala kepada G tinggi

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Panjangnya yang pendek membolehkannya menghasilkan G tinggi. Bunyinya melayang di atas melodi seperti loceng.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · title

items.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ditala kepada G terbuka, plektrum dipakai, ibu jari sedia pada tali dengung. Mainkan setiap tali dengan jelas dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, G tinggi, D rendah, D tinggi, G. Cari setiap tali berdasarkan notnya.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali 3, kemudian tali 5. Mana lebih tinggi?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · song bjo-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb memerlukan tiga not: tali 2 terbuka ialah B, fret 2 pada tali 3 ialah A, dan tali 3 terbuka ialah G. Jari kedua menekan A; ibu jari memetik tali 3.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · title

items.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · unit summary
items.translation: Corak tangan kanan di sebalik bunyi bergulung bluegrass: pinch, roll ibu jari berselang-seli dan forward roll.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Ibu jari dan jari tengah serentak

items.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pinch ialah petikan ibu jari dan jari tengah pada masa yang sama, pada tali 5 dan 1. Bunyinya seperti kord kecil dua not dan sering memulakan atau mengakhiri frasa.

items.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pinch, atau satu not pada satu masa?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah yang dimainkan oleh pinch?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari pada tali kelima yang pendek dan jari tengah pada tali 1, pada masa yang sama.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Ibu jari, telunjuk, ibu jari, tengah

items.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Roll ini terdiri daripada lapan not sekata: ibu jari pada 3, telunjuk pada 2, ibu jari pada 5, jari tengah pada 1, kemudian ibu jari pada 4, telunjuk pada 2, ibu jari pada 5, jari tengah pada 1.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which finger plays every other note?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Jari manakah yang memainkan not berselang-seli?

items.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari, telunjuk, ibu jari, tengah: ibu jari memainkan not berselang-seli, dan itulah asal nama roll ini.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Forward roll bergerak sehala, ibu jari kemudian telunjuk kemudian jari tengah, berulang-ulang. Lapan not terdiri daripada ibu jari, telunjuk, tengah dua kali, kemudian ibu jari, telunjuk.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bagaimanakah forward roll dimuatkan dalam lapan not?

items.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari, telunjuk, tengah dua kali, kemudian ibu jari, telunjuk. Aksen beralih sepanjang corak, lalu menghasilkan bunyi bergulung.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kualiti roll bergantung pada ketepatan masanya. Kekalkan kelapan-lapan not sekata, seperti detikan jam, dan mainkan not pertama setiap bar tepat pada detik.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 2 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda kehilangan detik di tengah roll. Apa sekarang?

items.source: Stop and start the bar over
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Slow down until it feels right
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Terus gerakkan tangan kanan dan sambung semula

items.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dalam kumpulan muzik, detik tidak menunggu. Teruskan corak dan sambung pada bar seterusnya.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 6 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pinch, roll ibu jari berselang-seli dan forward roll, semuanya pada tali terbuka. Kekalkan kuaver sekata dan biarkan setiap tali berbunyi.

items.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Roll manakah yang mengulang ibu jari, telunjuk, tengah?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · title

items.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · unit summary
items.translation: Bentukkan G, C, D7 dan E minor pada fret dan teruskan roll sepanjang pertukaran.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 1 tali 2, jari kedua pada fret 2 tali 4, jari ketiga pada fret 2 tali 1. Tali 3 dan 5 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah anda menekan tali kelima pada fret untuk C?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G tinggi terbuka tergolong dalam kord C, jadi ia berbunyi tanpa ditekan. Anda tidak pernah menekannya pada fret dalam pelajaran ini.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 6 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jari pertama pada fret 1 tali 2, jari kedua pada fret 2 tali 3. Tali 4 dan 1 berbunyi terbuka. Jangan mainkan tali kelima; G bertembung dengan D7.

items.source: The full D7, if you like
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D7 dua jari tiada F syap. Tambahkan jari kelingking pada fret 4 tali 1 supaya keempat-empat not D7 berbunyi. Kedua-dua bentuk sesuai untuk lagu; bentuk lengkap berbunyi lebih kaya.

items.source: Which chord wants to move on?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah yang terasa ingin beralih?

items.source: What does your thumb do on D7?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang dilakukan oleh ibu jari pada D7?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G terbuka pada tali 5 bukan sebahagian daripada D7. Buat masa ini, ibu jari anda kekal pada tali 3 dan 4.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 8 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G ialah tempat asal, C bergerak menjauh dan D7 menarik anda kembali. Tukar pada detik pertama setiap bar dan terus gerakkan tangan kanan.

items.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah yang menarik anda kembali ke G?

items.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D7 mengandungi C, yang cenderung turun ke B dalam kord G. Tarikan itu menyebabkan begitu banyak lagu berakhir dengan D7 ke G.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 6 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bentukkan C, kemudian angkat jari pertama dari tali 2. Dua jari kekal pada fret 2, tali 4 dan 1, dan kord menjadi lebih suram: E minor.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat kord dan dua roll. Kekalkan tangan kanan stabil walaupun tangan kiri sibuk bertukar.

items.source: Which string sits out on D7?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah yang tidak dimainkan pada D7?

items.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: Ibu jari berselang-seli: G, C, D7, G

items.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G
items.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G

items.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 “First melodies” · unit summary
items.translation: Empat lagu tradisional, dengan tali dengung berbunyi di celah melodi.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Di sini melodi menjadi tumpuan: petik setiap not dengan jari yang ditetapkan untuk talinya. Tali 3, 2 dan 1 memainkan seluruh lagu ini.

items.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 2 terbuka, tali 3 fret 2, tali 3 terbuka, tali 2 fret 1, tali 1 terbuka.

items.source: Which note does the tune end on?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada not manakah lagu ini berakhir?

items.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lagu dalam G kembali ke G, di sini tali ketiga terbuka.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · title
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cripple Creek mempunyai bahagian tinggi yang menggunakan tali kelima sebagai not melodi, dan bahagian rendah pada tali 3 dan 4. Mainkan setiap bahagian perlahan dahulu.

items.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5 terbuka, kemudian tali 1 pada fret 4 dan fret 2.

items.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari manakah G tinggi dalam bar pertama berasal?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tali dengung turut menjadi not melodi di sini. Ibu jari anda memainkannya, tepat pada detik.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · title

items.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Lagu yang dinamakan sempena laluan gunung

items.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cumberland Gap ialah laluan yang digunakan peneroka awal untuk masuk ke Kentucky. Melodinya naik ke E dan F♯ pada tali 1, jadi jari kedua dan keempat anda akan sibuk.

items.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, kemudian terbuka.

items.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah anda memainkan F♯ dalam lagu ini?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F♯ berada empat fret di atas D terbuka pada tali 1. Tali kelima tidak pernah ditekan pada fret di sini.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · title
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Shady Grove mempunyai bunyi suram dan lama yang dipanggil mountain minor oleh pemain. Ia berakhir pada A dan bukannya G, dan G tinggi pada tali kelima berbunyi mengiringinya.

items.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 3 fret 2, tali 2 terbuka, tali 1 terbuka, tali 1 fret 2.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lagu manakah yang berakhir pada A dan bukannya G?

items.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Shady Grove menggunakan mountain minor, berpusat pada A. Lagu-lagu lain kembali ke G.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · title

items.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · unit summary
items.translation: Bunyikan not dengan tangan pada fret, kemudian gunakannya dalam Old Joe Clark.

items.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Petik satu tali terbuka, kemudian hentakkan hujung jari betul-betul di belakang fret 2. Not baharu berbunyi daripada hentakan itu sahaja, tanpa petikan kedua.

items.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik tali 3 terbuka, kemudian lakukan hammer-on pada fret 2 dengan jari kedua.

items.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa kali anda memetik untuk hammer-on?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Dua kali, sekali bagi setiap not

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Plektrum membunyikan not pertama. Not kedua terhasil apabila jari menghentak tali.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tekan satu not pada fret, petiknya, kemudian tarik jari sedikit ke sisi sambil mengangkatnya. Gerakan itu memetik tali terbuka, jadi not kedua berbunyi tanpa plektrum.

items.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Petik tali 1 pada fret 2, kemudian lakukan pull-off ke tali terbuka.

items.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Ke arah manakah jari bergerak dalam pull-off?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Along the string to the next fret
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mengangkat terus ke atas hanya menghentikan not. Gerakan kecil ke sisi memetik tali terbuka.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tekan tali 3 pada fret 2, petiknya, dan gelongsorkan jari yang sama naik ke fret 4 sambil terus menekan. A ke B dalam satu gelongsoran lancar ialah bunyi klasik banjo.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Hanya not pertama dipetik. Teruskan tekanan semasa menggelongsor, atau bunyi not akan terhenti dalam perjalanan.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Old Joe Clark dalam nada dasar G, tetapi bahagian keduanya menggunakan F dan bukannya F♯, pada tali 1 di fret 3. Not yang direndahkan itu memberikan bunyi old-time kepada lagu ini.

items.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, terbuka. Cuba hammer-on dari 2 ke 3.

items.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah yang memberikan warna old-time kepada bahagian kedua?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G major menggunakan F♯. Menurunkannya ke F menghasilkan bunyi Mixolydian yang banyak terdapat dalam muzik old-time dan bluegrass.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off dan gelongsoran, kemudian Old Joe Clark. Petik hanya apabila perlu dan biarkan tangan pada fret melakukan selebihnya.

items.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Gerakan manakah yang menggelongsorkan not pada fret naik ke fret lebih tinggi?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 “Clawhammer” · title

items.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 “Clawhammer” · unit summary
items.translation: Cara tangan kanan yang berbeza: petik ke bawah dengan kuku dan mainkan tali dengung dengan ibu jari.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Clawhammer tidak menggunakan plektrum. Bengkokkan tangan menjadi bentuk cakar yang santai dan petik tali ke bawah dengan belakang kuku telunjuk atau jari tengah, menggunakan gerakan pergelangan tangan dan lengan bawah.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semasa tangan memetik, ibu jari berhenti pada tali kelima. Pada detik seterusnya, ia menolak melalui tali itu sambil tangan terangkat.

items.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Ke arah manakah kuku bergerak dalam clawhammer?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Clawhammer memetik ke bawah dengan kuku. Jari tidak pernah memetik ke atas.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 4 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Irama asas clawhammer berbunyi seperti namanya. Bum: petik satu not pada detik. Dit: sapukan ke bawah merentasi tali. Ty: ibu jari memainkan tali 5.

items.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bahagian bum-ditty manakah yang dimainkan oleh ibu jari?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bum ialah satu not, dit ialah sapuan dan ty ialah ibu jari pada tali kelima.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam clawhammer, not melodi jatuh pada petikan bum. Sapuan dan ibu jari mengisi ruang di sekelilingnya, jadi melodi dan irama terhasil bersama.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah not melodi dimainkan dalam bum-ditty?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bum jatuh pada detik, jadi di situlah melodi dimainkan. Dit dan ty mengekalkan irama bergulung.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Skip to My Lou ialah permainan keramaian pada tahun 1840-an. Dalam clawhammer, setiap not melodi ialah bum, diikuti sapuan dan ibu jari pada tali 5.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang dimainkan oleh ibu jari selepas setiap sapuan?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bum, dit, ty: ty sentiasa dimainkan oleh ibu jari pada tali kelima yang pendek.

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Segala-galanya dalam clawhammer kembali kepada bum-ditty. Kekalkan gerakan santai dan ibu jari bersedia, lalu melodi akan mengalir sendiri.

items.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bentuk tangan manakah yang digunakan dalam clawhammer?

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Jari memetik ke atas dengan plektrum

items.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training course · title

items.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
items.context: Ear Training course · course subtitle
items.translation: Dengar selang dan kord, serta nyanyikan semula apa yang anda dengar

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · title

items.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary
items.translation: Kenal pasti yang mana antara dua not lebih tinggi, daripada lompatan besar hingga jarak nada terkecil.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

items.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pic ialah tahap tinggi atau rendah bunyi not. Pada papan kekunci, not rendah berada di kiri dan not tinggi di kanan. Telinga anda sudah tahu perbezaannya; di sini anda mengasahnya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Apabila not kedua lebih tinggi, melodi menaik. Apabila lebih rendah, melodi menurun. Jejaki arahnya di udara dengan tangan semasa mendengar.

items.source: Does the second note go up or down?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah not kedua menaik atau menurun?

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semakin rapat dua not, semakin sukar membezakannya. Biarkan setiap not habis sebelum menjawab. Setiap jawapan, betul atau salah, melatih pendengaran anda.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tidak pasti? Senandungkan not pertama, kemudian gelongsorkan suara ke not kedua. Rasakan sama ada suara anda menaik atau menurun. Badan anda tahu arahnya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

items.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak melodi bergerak ke not skala yang betul-betul bersebelahan: satu langkah kecil. Langkah berbunyi lancar dan rapat. Dengarkan kenaikan atau penurunan lembut, bukan lompatan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Simpan not pertama dalam fikiran semasa not kedua berbunyi. Kemudian bandingkannya, seperti membandingkan dua ketinggian bersebelahan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jarak nada terkecil dalam kebanyakan muzik ialah separuh ton, juga dipanggil semiton: dari satu kekunci ke kekunci yang betul-betul bersebelahan. Perubahannya kecil, dan anda boleh belajar mendengarnya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk jarak yang sangat kecil, tanggapan pertama biasanya betul. Jawab, dan jangan terlalu meraguinya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title
items.translation: Cabaran lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
