items.translation: Lompatan besar, langkah kecil dan semiton, tinggi dan rendah, semuanya bercampur. Tarik nafas sebelum setiap satu.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

items.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar apabila dua not sepadan, kemudian padankan not dengan suara atau alat muzik anda.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

items.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dua not sepadan apabila picnya betul-betul sama. Dengarkan sama ada not kedua tepat pada not pertama atau beralih daripadanya.

items.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dua suara menyanyikan pic yang betul-betul sama. Apakah namanya?

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Menyanyi secara unison bermaksud menyanyikan not yang betul-betul sama.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk memadankan pic, dengar, bayangkan not itu semula dalam fikiran, kemudian nyanyikan atau mainkannya. Timbre menunjukkan sama ada anda terlalu tinggi atau rendah. Gelongsorkan suara sehingga tepat.

items.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not yang baru anda dengar.

items.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not kedua yang anda dengar.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jika tersasar, jangan berhenti. Gelongsorkan suara perlahan ke atas atau ke bawah sehingga not tepat. Gelongsoran itu membantu telinga dan suara belajar untuk sepadan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum menyanyi, mainkan semula not itu secara senyap dalam fikiran. Pemuzik memanggilnya audiasi: mendengar muzik yang tidak sedang berbunyi. Inilah asas pendengaran yang baik.

items.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not yang lebih tinggi.

items.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not yang lebih rendah.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang padankan dua not berturut-turut. Nyanyikan yang pertama, kemudian beralih ke yang kedua. Perhatikan sama ada suara anda menaik atau menurun untuk mencapainya.

items.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not yang baru anda dengar, mengikut urutan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sama atau berbeza, not tunggal dan berpasangan. Dengar hingga habis sebelum menyanyi, dan gelongsor sehingga setiap not tepat.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · title

items.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar semiton dan ton, kemudian lompatan lebih lebar bagi selang ketiga.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semiton bergerak ke kekunci yang betul-betul bersebelahan. Ton melangkau satu kekunci, jadi ia bersamaan dua semiton. Kedua-duanya berbunyi seperti langkah, tetapi ton sedikit lebih lebar.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ton melangkau satu kekunci, jadi jaraknya dua semiton.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemuzik memanggil langkah sebagai selang kedua kerana ia bergerak ke huruf seterusnya: C ke D. Semiton ialah selang kedua minor. Ton ialah selang kedua major.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: E up to F is a...
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E dan F tiada kekunci di antaranya: satu semiton, jadi selang kedua minor.

items.source: C up to D is a...
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C ke D melangkau kekunci hitam di antaranya: satu ton, jadi selang kedua major.

items.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Langkah bergerak ke huruf seterusnya. Lompatan melangkau satu huruf, seperti C ke E, melangkau D. Jarak itu dipanggil selang ketiga. Lompatan berbunyi lebih terbuka daripada langkah.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: D up to F is a...
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D ke F melangkau E, jadi ia satu lompatan: selang ketiga.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang ketiga major merangkumi empat semiton dan berbunyi cerah. Selang ketiga minor merangkumi tiga dan berbunyi lebih suram, sedikit sayu. Dengarkan kecerahannya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C naik ke E merangkumi berapa semiton?

items.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: empat semiton, jadi selang ketiga major.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semiton, ton dan selang ketiga, menaik dan menurun. Tentukan langkah atau lompatan dahulu, kemudian saiz tepatnya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · title

items.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary
items.translation: Unison, oktaf, selang kelima dan keempat, setiap satu dikaitkan dengan lagu yang boleh anda senandungkan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang ialah jarak antara dua not. Unison langsung tiada jarak: not yang sama dua kali. Oktaf bergerak dari satu huruf ke huruf yang sama di atasnya, seperti C ke C. Bunyinya seperti satu not, tetapi lebih terang.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jingle Bells bermula dengan satu not berulang: unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game bermula dengan lompatan naik satu oktaf. Senandungkan setiap pembukaan untuk mengingati bunyinya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Why is it called an octave?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: lapan nama huruf, termasuk kedua-dua hujung.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

items.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang kelima sempurna merangkumi tujuh semiton, seperti C naik ke G. Bunyinya terbuka dan kuat. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star melompat naik selang kelima selepas dua not pertama.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah not satu selang kelima sempurna di atas D?

items.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira lima huruf: D, E, F, G, A. D ke A merangkumi tujuh semiton.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

items.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang keempat sempurna merangkumi lima semiton, seperti C naik ke F. Bunyinya seperti panggilan meminta perhatian. Amazing Grace bermula dengan selang keempat menaik.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kedua-duanya berbunyi terbuka. Selang kelima lebih lebar dan terasa stabil. Selang keempat terasa ingin bergerak lagi. Jika tidak pasti, senandungkan lagu bagi setiap satu.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selang kelima merangkumi tujuh semiton; selang keempat merangkumi lima.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nama selang kekal sama sama ada menaik atau menurun. G turun ke C masih selang kelima. Dengar saiz jaraknya, bukan arahnya.

items.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Apabila dua not berbunyi serentak, dengar gabungannya. Oktaf menyatu menjadi satu bunyi. Selang kelima berbunyi berongga dan kuat. Selang keempat berbunyi terbuka tetapi belum stabil.

items.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan selang kelima menurun: G turun ke C.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Unison, oktaf, selang kelima dan keempat, menaik, menurun dan serentak. Jika buntu, senandungkan lagu bagi setiap satu.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · title

items.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · unit summary
items.translation: Selang ketiga, keenam dan kedua dalam saiz major dan minor.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In bermula dengan selang ketiga major, cerah dan berani. Greensleeves bermula dengan selang ketiga minor, lebih lembut dan sedih. Senandungkan kedua-duanya untuk mengingati bunyinya.

items.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa semiton dalam selang ketiga minor?

items.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selang ketiga minor merangkumi tiga semiton, seperti A ke C. Selang ketiga major merangkumi empat.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · title

items.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang keenam major merangkumi sembilan semiton; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean bermula dengannya. Selang keenam minor merangkumi lapan dan berbunyi lebih suram. The Entertainer melompat naik selang ini sejurus selepas not pembukaannya yang pantas.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: C up to A is which interval?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C naik ke A ialah selang apa?

items.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C ke A merangkumi sembilan semiton: selang keenam major.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Frère Jacques bermula dengan selang kedua major, satu ton menaik. Für Elise bermula dengan gerakan turun naik selang kedua minor, satu semiton. Jarak kecil, perbezaan besar.

items.source: Which interval is a half step?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selang kedua minor ialah satu semiton. Selang kedua major ialah dua.

items.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan gerakan turun naik semiton: E, D♯, E.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nilai saiz dahulu: langkah, lompatan kecil atau lompatan besar. Kemudian nilai warnanya: cerah untuk major, lebih suram untuk minor. Dua pilihan mudah lebih baik daripada satu tekaan sukar.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selang minor berbunyi lebih suram daripada pasangan majornya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang kedua, ketiga dan keenam, major dan minor, dicampur dengan selang keempat dan kelima yang sudah anda kenali.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · title

items.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar kord major dan minor, kemudian diminished, augmented dan ketujuh dominan.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord ialah tiga atau lebih not yang berbunyi serentak. Kord major berbunyi cerah dan stabil. Kord minor berbunyi lebih suram. Hanya not tengah yang berbeza antara kedua-duanya.

items.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord major bertukar menjadi minor. Berapa notnya berubah?

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Hanya not tengah, iaitu not ketiga, turun semiton: C E G menjadi C E♭ G.

items.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan semula not kord, dari rendah ke tinggi.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tidak pasti? Tumpukan pada not tengah. Dalam kord major, ia berada empat semiton di atas not paling rendah. Dalam minor, ia satu semiton lebih rendah, menjadikan keseluruhan bunyi lebih suram.

items.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah yang membentuk kord C minor?

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Turunkan not tengah C major sebanyak semiton: E menjadi E♭.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord diminished menyusun dua selang ketiga minor dan berbunyi rapat serta resah. Kord augmented menyusun dua selang ketiga major dan berbunyi renggang, seperti soalan yang tergantung.

items.source: Which kind of chord is this?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah yang menyusun dua selang ketiga major?

items.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selang ketiga major ditambah selang ketiga major, seperti C E G♯, membentuk kord augmented.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord ketujuh dominan ialah kord major dengan satu not tambahan di atas: selang ketujuh minor di atas not akar, iaitu not yang memberi nama kepada kord. Bunyinya bercorak blues dan terasa belum stabil.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G7 ialah G major (G B D) ditambah F, satu selang ketujuh minor di atas G.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Major, minor, diminished, augmented dan ketujuh dominan: cerah, suram, rapat, renggang, belum stabil. Namakan warnanya, kemudian kordnya.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · title

items.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar kedudukan setiap not dalam nada dasar, daripada do, not asal, hingga ti.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap nada dasar mempunyai not asal yang dipanggil tonik. Penyanyi memanggilnya do. Di sini anda akan mendengar kord yang menetapkan nada dasar, kemudian satu not untuk dikenal pasti kedudukannya.

items.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah not terakhir do, not asal?

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not skala major ialah do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, kemudian do semula. Setiap satu ialah darjah skala, bernombor bermula dari do: do ialah 1, re ialah 2, hingga ti, 7.

items.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan do, re, mi dalam C major: C, D, E.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Do, mi dan sol ialah not kord tonik, jadi bunyinya stabil dan tenang. Mi berbunyi manis, sol berbunyi kuat dan terbuka, dan do berbunyi selesai.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: In C major, which note is sol?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam C major, not manakah sol?

items.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira naik dari do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.

items.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan do, mi, sol dalam G major: G, B, D.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · title

items.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Re, fa, la dan ti berbunyi belum selesai. Ti berada semiton di bawah do dan kuat tertarik ke atas. Fa cenderung turun ke mi. Re dan la ingin melangkah ke not berjiran.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah yang paling kuat tertarik naik ke do?

items.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ti berada hanya semiton di bawah do, jadi ia sangat cenderung ke arahnya.

items.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan ti menaik ke do dalam C major: B, kemudian C.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · title

items.source: Set the key with a cadence
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kadens ialah corak kord pendek yang mengakhiri frasa. Mendengarnya menetapkan nada dasar dengan jelas. Nyanyikan do perlahan untuk diri sendiri, kemudian ukur not baharu dari situ.

items.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kord menunjukkan do, jadi anda boleh mendengar hubungan setiap not lain dengannya.

items.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan skala menaik dari do dalam C major: C, D, E, F, G.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kord menetapkan nada dasar, kemudian satu not berbunyi. Cari do dahulu, kemudian namakan not itu. Setiap nada dasar menggunakan cara yang sama.

items.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan atau mainkan do, ti, do dalam D major: D, C♯, D.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · title

items.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar melodi pendek, pilih yang anda dengar dan nyanyikan semula.

items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · title

items.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Imlak bermaksud mendengar melodi dan menuliskannya. Di sini anda memilihnya daripada senarai. Cari do daripada kord, kemudian ikuti setiap gerakan: naik atau turun, langkah atau lompatan.

items.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum menamakan not, jejaki bentuknya dengan tangan: naik, turun atau berbelok. Kebanyakan jawapan salah mempunyai bentuk yang salah, jadi anda boleh menyingkirkannya dengan cepat.

Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Langkah berbunyi lancar; lompatan lebih ketara. Apabila mendengar lompatan, semak sama ada ia mendarat pada not kord tonik: do, mi atau sol.

items.translation: Do ke mi melangkau re, dan mi ke sol melangkau fa.

items.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi lebih panjang menggunakan cara yang sama. Pastikan not pertama berhubung dengan do, kemudian ikuti yang selebihnya satu gerakan pada satu masa.

items.translation: Melodi berhenti pada ti. Bagaimanakah bunyinya?

items.source: Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ti cenderung naik ke do, jadi melodi yang berhenti pada ti terasa seperti sedang menunggu.

items.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi sering turun di bawah do ke ti, la atau sol yang lebih rendah. Notnya sama, cuma lebih rendah. Banyak lagu bermula pada sol di bawah dan melompat naik ke do.

items.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Amazing Grace bermula pada sol di bawah do dan melompat naik. Ke not apa?

items.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
items.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Sol naik ke do ialah selang keempat sempurna, selang yang anda pelajari melalui lagu ini.

items.translation: Kord dahulu, kemudian melodi. Cari do, jejaki bentuknya, namakan setiap not, kemudian nyanyikan atau mainkan semula.
