Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira huruf untuk nombor. Kira semiton untuk saiz. Bersama-sama, kedua-duanya menamakan apa-apa selang.

items.source: F up to A is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F, G, A ialah selang ketiga, dan empat semiton menjadikannya major.

items.source: D up to A is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D ke A merangkumi tujuh semiton.

items.source: B up to D is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B, C, D ialah selang ketiga dengan tiga semiton: minor.

items.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G ke F merangkumi tujuh huruf dan sepuluh semiton: selang ketujuh minor.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · title

items.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · unit summary
items.translation: Susun selang ketiga menjadi triad, bina kord major dan minor, serta nomborkan kord dalam nada dasar.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · title
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triad ialah tiga not yang disusun dalam selang ketiga. Mulakan pada mana-mana not, langkau satu huruf, ambil yang seterusnya, langkau lagi. C, langkau D, E, langkau F, G: C E G.

items.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah membentuk triad yang dibina pada G?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G, langkau A, B, langkau C, D.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not yang menjadi asas triad ialah not akarnya. Not tengah ialah not ketiga dan not atas ialah not kelima, dinamakan mengikut jaraknya di atas akar.

items.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam triad F A C, not manakah akarnya?

items.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F ialah not bawah yang menjadi asas triad.

items.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam triad D F A, not manakah yang kelima?

items.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D naik ke A ialah selang kelima: D, E, F, G, A.

items.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan hanya kekunci putih, triad manakah dibina pada E?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E, langkau F, G, langkau A, B.

items.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan triad C satu not pada satu masa: C, E, G.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · title
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triad major mempunyai selang ketiga major di bawah, empat semiton, kemudian selang ketiga minor di atas. C E G ialah major. Begitu juga F A C dan G B D.

items.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Terbalikkan susunan selang ketiga untuk mendapat minor: selang ketiga minor di bawah, kemudian selang ketiga major. Turunkan not tengah C major untuk mendapat C minor: C E♭ G.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D ke F ialah selang ketiga minor; F ke A ialah selang ketiga major.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E ke G♯ ialah selang ketiga major; G♯ ke B ialah selang ketiga minor.

items.source: Is A C E major or minor?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah A C E major atau minor?

items.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A ke C ialah selang ketiga minor, tiga semiton.

items.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan A minor satu not pada satu masa: A, C, E.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · title
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bina triad pada setiap not skala, menggunakan hanya not skala itu, untuk mendapat keluarga kord nada dasar tersebut. C major mempunyai tujuh, satu bagi setiap not.

items.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan hanya not C major, triad apakah dibina pada D?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D F A: selang ketiga minor, kemudian selang ketiga major.

items.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan hanya not C major, triad apakah dibina pada G?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G B D: selang ketiga major, kemudian selang ketiga minor.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triad pada B berbeza: B D F. Kedua-dua selang ketiga ialah minor, jadi ia triad diminished. Bunyinya tegang dan terasa ingin bergerak.

items.source: In C major, which chords are major?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam C major, kord manakah major?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C E G, F A C dan G B D masing-masing mempunyai selang ketiga major di bawah.

items.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dengan hanya not C major, triad apakah dibina pada A?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A C E: selang ketiga minor, kemudian selang ketiga major.

items.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan triad diminished pada B: B, D, F.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · title
Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemuzik menomborkan kord nada dasar dengan angka Rom: I untuk kord pada not 1, hingga vii untuk not 7. Huruf besar bermaksud major, huruf kecil minor, dan ° diminished.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap nada dasar major mengikut satu corak: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. Dalam C major, ia ialah C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor dan B diminished.

items.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam C major, kord manakah IV?

items.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not keempat C major ialah F.

items.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam C major, kord manakah vi?

items.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not keenam ialah A, dan vi berhuruf kecil bermaksud minor.

items.source: In G major, which chord is V?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam G major, kord manakah V?

items.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira naik dari G: G, A, B, C, D. Not kelima ialah D, dan V ialah major.

items.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapakah ii ditulis dengan huruf kecil?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.translation: Dalam G major, kord manakah IV?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G, A, B, C: not keempat ialah C.

items.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Susun selang ketiga, semak saiznya, kemudian letakkan kord dalam nada dasarnya: major pada I, IV dan V, minor pada ii, iii dan vi, diminished pada vii°.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam C major, kord manakah ii?

items.source: In F major, which chord is V?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam F major, kord manakah V?

items.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.

items.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: not kelima ialah C.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · title

items.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · unit summary
items.translation: Cara kord bergerak dalam lagu: I–IV–V, gelung pop, ii–V–I, blues 12 bar dan kadens.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · title
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak sekali lagu rakyat, rock dan country hanya menggunakan tiga kord: I, IV dan V. Dalam C major, ia ialah C, F dan G. Bersama-sama, semuanya mengandungi setiap not skala.

items.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam G major, apakah I, IV dan V?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kira naik dari G: not 1 ialah G, not 4 ialah C, not 5 ialah D.

items.source: Does this end on the home chord?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah ini berakhir pada kord tonik?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: I terasa seperti tempat asal. IV bergerak menjauh. V membina ketegangan yang menarik kembali ke I. Perjalanan pergi dan kembali itu membentuk banyak sekali lagu.

items.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah paling kuat menarik kembali ke I?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: V membina ketegangan yang diselesaikan pada I.

items.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam D major, kord manakah IV?

items.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D, E, F♯, G: not keempat ialah G.

items.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan akar I, IV, V, I dalam C: C, F, G, C.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · title
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gelung empat kord ini mengiringi banyak sekali lagu pop. Dalam C major, ia ialah C, G, A minor, F. vi minor menambah sedikit kesuraman sebelum IV membawa kembali ke arah asal.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dalam G: I ialah G, V ialah D, vi ialah E minor, IV ialah C.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mulakan gelung yang sama pada vi untuk mendapat vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. Kordnya sama, tetapi bermula pada minor menjadikan bunyinya lebih serius.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam F major, kord manakah vi?

items.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: not keenam ialah D, dan vi ialah minor.

items.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan akar I–V–vi–IV dalam C: C, G, A, F.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · title
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: ii–V–I ialah progresi paling lazim dalam jazz. Dalam C major: D minor, G, C. Setiap akar turun selang kelima ke yang seterusnya, jadi gerakannya terasa seperti pulang ke asal.

items.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: ii ialah D minor, V ialah G, dan I ialah C.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain jazz biasanya menambah not ketujuh: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Not tambahan menjadikan setiap peralihan lebih lancar. Akar dan perjalanan kembali ke asal kekal sama.

items.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii ialah G minor dan V ialah C.

items.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D turun ke G, kemudian G turun ke C: selang kelima setiap kali.

items.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan akar ii–V–I dalam C: D, turun ke G, naik ke C.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Blues 12 bar ialah susunan kord sepanjang dua belas bar yang menjadi asas banyak lagu blues, rock dan jazz. Ia menggunakan I, IV dan V, sering semuanya sebagai kord ketujuh dominan untuk memberi rasa blues.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat bar I. Dua bar IV, dua bar I. Satu bar V, satu bar IV, dua bar I. Kemudian ulang. Dalam A: A7 empat kali, D7 dua kali, A7 dua kali, E7, D7, A7 dua kali.

items.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa bar I membuka blues 12 bar?

items.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Empat bar I, kemudian IV hadir pada bar 5.

items.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam blues 12 bar, kord manakah pada bar 9?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar 9 ialah satu bar V, sebelum IV pada bar 10.

items.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam nada dasar E, apakah tiga kord blues?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dalam E, I ialah E, IV ialah A dan V ialah B.

items.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Mainkan atau nyanyikan akar blues dalam A: A, D, E, kembali ke A.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · title

items.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kadens ialah peralihan kord yang mengakhiri frasa, seperti tanda baca. V ke I paling kuat, seperti noktah. Ia dipanggil kadens autentik.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: IV ke I ialah kadens plagal, “amen” lembut pada akhir banyak himne. Berhenti pada V ialah kadens separuh, seperti koma. V ke vi ialah kadens mengelirukan: anda menjangkakan kembali ke asal tetapi mendapat kejutan.

items.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kadens manakah mengakhiri frasa pada V?

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kadens separuh berhenti seketika pada V, seperti koma.

Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: IV ke I ialah “amen” lembut pada akhir banyak himne.

Music Theory · Unit 8 · challenge thy-8-6 “Progressions challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · challenge thy-8-6 “Progressions challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Asal, menjauh dan kembali. Namakan progresi, kemudian kadens yang mengakhirinya. Dengarkan tempat muzik ingin berehat.

items.translation: Dalam D: I ialah D, V ialah A, vi ialah B minor, IV ialah G.

items.translation: V ke I ialah noktah dalam muzik.

items.context: Rhythm course · title

items.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
items.context: Rhythm course · course subtitle
items.translation: Rasai detik, kira dan ketuk mengikut masa

items.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 “The beat” · unit summary
items.translation: Cari denyutan, kira hingga empat dan ketuk mengikut masa.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · title

items.source: The beat is a steady pulse
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Detik ialah denyutan tetap yang anda ikuti dengan mengetuk kaki. Ia tidak tergesa-gesa atau melambat, seperti langkah berjalan santai. Setiap irama berasaskan detik itu.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan hujung jari sedikit di atas skrin dan ketuk setiap kali klik berbunyi. Biarkan jari melantun dari kaca seperti kayu dram. Sasarkan ketukan bersama klik, bukan selepasnya.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik mengekalkan jarak yang sama antara denyutan, seperti jam berdetik.

items.source: How many clicks did you hear?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan muzik mengumpulkan detik dalam empat. Kira 1, 2, 3, 4 dengan kuat bersama klik, kemudian mulakan semula pada 1. Menyebut nombor membantu tangan mengekalkan masa.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bar ialah satu kumpulan detik. Di sini setiap bar mempunyai empat detik, ditulis 4/4. Detik 1 memulakan setiap bar, jadi beri sedikit penekanan semasa mengira.

items.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Klik kuat ialah detik 1. Berapa detik dalam setiap bar?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kiraan bermula semula pada 1 pada awal setiap bar.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title

items.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not yang berlangsung satu detik ialah krocet. Empat krocet memenuhi bar 4/4, jadi mengetuk setiap detik bermaksud mengetuk krocet.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang ketuk hanya pada 1 dan 3. Setiap ketukan ialah minim, sepanjang dua detik. Terus kira keempat-empat detik; detik yang dilangkau tetap berlangsung.

items.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda mengetuk pada 1 dan 3. Apakah yang berlaku pada 2 dan 4?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Anda mengetuk dua kali lebih cepat

items.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik tidak pernah berhenti. Anda mengira sepanjang detik yang tidak diketuk.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semibrif berlangsung keempat-empat detik. Ketuk sekali pada 1 dan kira 2, 3, 4 perlahan supaya 1 seterusnya jatuh tepat pada masanya.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · title

items.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tempo ialah kelajuan detik, dikira dalam detik seminit, atau bpm. Pada 60 bpm, detik hadir sekali sesaat, seperti jam.

items.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pada 60 bpm, berapa kerap detik hadir?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 60 detik dalam 60 saat ialah satu detik setiap saat.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tempo lebih cepat memerlukan kurang usaha, bukan lebih. Kekalkan tangan santai dan ketuk dari sendi pangkal jari, bukan pergelangan tangan atau bahu.

items.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tempo meningkat. Bagaimanakah ketukan anda sepatutnya?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Wait a little behind the click
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Gerakan kecil dan santai lebih pantas serta mudah dikekalkan sekata.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

items.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini mencampurkan detik, bar, not lebih panjang dan tempo. Kira dengan kuat sepanjang latihan, dan kekalkan ketukan kecil serta santai.

items.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah berlangsung satu bar penuh 4/4?

items.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Semibrif berlangsung empat detik, satu bar penuh 4/4.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: bpm mengira detik seminit, jadi 90 bpm ialah satu setengah detik setiap saat.

items.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 “Eighth notes” · unit summary
items.translation: Bahagikan setiap detik kepada dua dan kira “dan”.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kuaver berlangsung setengah detik, jadi dua dimuatkan dalam setiap detik. Lapan kuaver memenuhi bar 4/4.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebut nombor pada setiap detik dan “dan” tepat di tengah-tengah: 1 dan 2 dan 3 dan 4 dan. Ketuk pada setiap perkataan.

items.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kuaver ialah setengah detik, jadi dua memenuhi setiap detik.

items.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Klik kuat ialah detik. Berapa detik yang anda dengar?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sekarang sesetengah detik mendapat satu ketukan dan sesetengahnya dua. Terus sebut setiap “dan”, termasuk yang tidak anda ketuk.

items.source: How do you count this pattern?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik 1 mempunyai dua ketukan, 1 dan. Detik 2, 3 dan 4 mendapat satu ketukan setiap satu.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam kuaver, setiap ketukan jatuh pada nombor atau “dan”. Sebelum mengetuk corak baharu, sebut kiraannya sekali dengan kuat.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kiraan manakah sepadan dengan corak ini?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik 1 dan 3 mempunyai dua ketukan setiap satu; detik 2 dan 4 mempunyai satu.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Detik 1 mempunyai satu ketukan, detik 2 dan 3 mempunyai dua, dan detik 4 mempunyai satu.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · title
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: “Dan” perlu jatuh tepat di tengah-tengah antara detik. Jika kuaver anda berbunyi seperti derapan kuda, perlahankan dan sebut kiraan semasa mengetuk.

items.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kuaver anda berbunyi tidak sekata. Apakah yang paling membantu?

items.source: Slow down and count out loud
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ketuk lebih kuat pada setiap detik

items.source: Speed up until it smooths out
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Memperlahankan memberi masa untuk meletakkan setiap “dan” di tengah. Mengira mengekalkannya di situ.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari sedikit di atas kaca antara ketukan. Gerakan pendek dan ringan lebih mudah dikekalkan sekata pada tempo lebih cepat.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · title

items.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini mencampurkan krocet dan kuaver. Sebut kiraan setiap corak sekali, kemudian ketuk dengan setiap “dan” tepat di tengah.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · title

items.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · unit summary
items.translation: Sengaja tinggalkan ruang, kemudian ketuk di antara detik.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rehat ialah senyap dengan tempoh tertentu. Anda tetap mengiranya; cuma tidak mengetuk. Rehat krocet berlangsung satu detik.

items.source: What do you do on a rest?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang anda lakukan semasa rehat?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Rehat mengambil masa seperti not. Mengiranya mengekalkan kedudukan anda.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Membiarkan detik 1 kosong ialah rehat paling sukar. Anggukkan kepala pada 1 supaya anda merasainya tanpa mengetuk, kemudian masuk pada 2.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rehat kuaver berlangsung setengah detik. Kira 1 dan 2 dan, rehat pada 2, dan ketuk “dan” selepasnya. Rasanya seperti tolakan kecil menuju detik 3.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia berada di tengah-tengah antara detik 2 dan 3, pada “dan” selepas 2.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sinkopasi meletakkan not kuat di antara detik, di tempat yang tidak dijangka oleh telinga. Ia membuat irama terasa terdorong ke hadapan.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Corak ini jatuh pada 1, “dan” selepas 2, dan 4. Kira 1 dan 2 dan 3 dan 4 dan, dan ketuk hanya pada tiga tempat itu.

items.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kira klik dari 1 hingga 8. Di manakah klik kuat jatuh?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Sinkopasi mengalihkan penekanan dari detik utama ke “dan” atau detik lemah.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · title
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Offbeat ialah “dan” di antara detik. Angguk pada nombor dan ketuk hanya pada “dan”, seperti chop gitar reggae.

items.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Klik pertama ialah detik 1. Adakah klik kuat pada nombor atau “dan”?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Offbeat jatuh di tengah-tengah antara detik, pada setiap “dan”.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · title

items.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini mencampurkan rehat, “dan” secara bersendirian, sinkopasi dan offbeat. Kira setiap kuaver dengan kuat, walaupun anda tidak mengetuk.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mengetuk “dan” selepas 2 dan melangkau 3 mengalihkan penekanan dari detik utama.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · title

items.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · unit summary
items.translation: Tahan not merentasi detik dengan ikatan dan irama bertitik.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ikatan ialah garisan melengkung yang menyambungkan dua not. Anda memainkan yang pertama dan menahannya sepanjang yang kedua, jadi not yang diikat tidak mendapat ketukan baharu.

items.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Detik 2 diikat ke detik 3. Apakah yang anda lakukan pada 3?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ikatan memanjangkan satu not. Anda mengira 3, tetapi not dari detik 2 terus berbunyi.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ikat “dan” selepas 2 ke detik 3. Ketuk pada “dan”, kemudian biarkan detik 3 berlalu semasa not berbunyi. Itulah sinkopasi, ditulis dengan cara lain.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Titik selepas not menambah separuh tempohnya. Minim berlangsung dua detik, jadi minim bertitik berlangsung tiga. Ketuk 1, kira 2 dan 3, ketuk 4.

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Krocet berlangsung satu detik. Berapa lama krocet bertitik?

items.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Separuh daripada satu detik ialah setengah detik. Tambahkannya untuk mendapat satu setengah detik.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet bertitik berlangsung satu setengah detik, jadi not seterusnya jatuh pada “dan”. Kira 1 dan 2 dan: ketuk 1, kemudian “dan” selepas 2.

items.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda mengetuk corak ini dengan rehat dalam Unit 3. Apakah yang berubah dengan titik?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ketukan jatuh di tempat yang sama. Hanya tempoh not pertama berubah.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · title
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Krocet bertitik ditambah kuaver memenuhi dua detik: panjang, pendek. Kira 1 dan 2 dan; ketuk 1 dan “dan” selepas 2.

items.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa lama krocet bertitik dan kuaver bersama-sama?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Satu setengah ditambah setengah ialah dua.

items.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Manakah sama panjang dengan krocet bertitik?

items.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ikatan menambah setengah detik kepada krocet, sama seperti titik.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · title

items.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini mencampurkan ikatan dan titik. Kira setiap kuaver dengan kuat; not yang ditahan tetap mengambil tempoh penuhnya.

items.source: How long is a dotted half note?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Minim ialah dua detik; titik menambah satu lagi.

items.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Ikatan menyambungkan dua not. Berapa kali anda mengetuk?

items.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Anda mengetuk not pertama dan menahannya sepanjang not kedua.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · title

items.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · unit summary
items.translation: Bahagikan detik kepada tiga, kemudian mainkan kuaver dengan swing.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · title

items.source: Triplets split the beat in three
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Triplet memuatkan tiga not sekata dalam satu detik. Kira 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, dengan setiap suku kata sama panjang.

items.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa not triplet dimuatkan dalam satu detik?

items.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Triplet membahagikan setiap detik kepada tiga bahagian sama rata.

items.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah klik dalam kumpulan dua atau tiga?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kuaver membahagikan detik kepada dua; triplet membahagikannya kepada tiga. Detik itu sendiri kekal. Hanya cara membahagikannya berubah.

items.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Anda mengira 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. Apakah yang anda ketuk?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tiga suku kata setiap detik bermaksud tiga not setiap detik: triplet.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · title
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam swing, setiap pasangan kuaver menjadi panjang-pendek. “Dan” dilewatkan ke bahagian terakhir triplet. Bayangkan doo-ba, doo-ba.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira 1-trip-let dan ketuk hanya pada “1” dan “let”. Ruang di tengah itulah swing.

items.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Swing melewatkan “dan” ke triplet terakhir, lalu menghasilkan ayunan panjang-pendek.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · title
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain dram jazz memainkan ini pada simbal ride: 1, 2, “dan” gaya swing, 3, 4, “dan” gaya swing. Bunyinya seperti ding, ding-a ding.

items.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: “Dan” gaya swing menunggu hingga triplet terakhir dalam detik.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kuaver lurus membahagikan detik sama rata; kuaver swing bergerak panjang-pendek. Ketuk satu, kemudian yang lain, dan rasai perbezaannya.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · title

items.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini mencampurkan triplet, kuaver lurus dan swing. Kekalkan detik stabil semasa cara membahagikannya berubah.

items.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Swing mengubah setiap pasangan kuaver menjadi apa?

items.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kuaver pertama memanjang dan “dan” tiba lewat.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · title

items.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · unit summary
items.translation: Waltz dalam tiga, mars dalam dua, berayun dalam 6/8 dan letakkan aksen.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · title

items.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam masa 3/4, setiap bar mempunyai tiga detik: SATU, dua, tiga. Itulah waltz. Kira 1, 2, 3 dan tekankan 1.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minim memenuhi dua daripada tiga detik. Ketuk 1, kira 2, ketuk 3. Rasanya seperti langkah besar dan kecil dalam waltz.

items.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Nombor atas tanda masa memberitahu berapa detik dalam setiap bar.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 2/4 mempunyai dua detik setiap bar: SATU, dua, seperti kaki berkawad. Bar berlalu cepat, jadi detik 1 kerap kembali.

items.source: Which meter feels like a march?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua detik setiap bar sepadan dengan kiri, kanan, kiri, kanan.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam 6/8, setiap bar mempunyai enam kuaver dalam dua kumpulan tiga: SATU dua tiga EMPAT lima enam. Rasanya seperti dua detik besar yang berayun.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Enam detik sama rata, tiada corak

items.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Enam kuaver membentuk dua kumpulan tiga, jadi anda merasakan dua detik besar.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Corak 6/8 yang popular bergerak panjang-pendek, panjang-pendek: ketuk 1, 3, 4 dan 6. Ia berayun seperti lagu dodoi atau lagu kelasi.

items.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Enam klik setiap bar. Meter apakah ini?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · title
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Aksen ialah not yang dimainkan lebih kuat daripada not di sekelilingnya. Alihkan aksen dan rasanya berubah, walaupun setiap not kekal sama.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · title
