items.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira kelapan-lapan kuaver dan ketuk aksen sahaja: 1, “dan” selepas 2, dan 4. Corak 3-3-2 ini menggerakkan banyak muzik pop dan Latin.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Aksen berkaitan penekanan, bukan tempoh. Not itu cuma dimainkan lebih kuat.

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rock, pop dan soul meletakkan aksen pada detik 2 dan 4. Inilah backbeat. Kira keempat-empat detik dan ketuk hanya 2 dan 4, seperti dram snare.

items.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Klik pertama ialah detik 1. Di manakah klik kuat?

items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · title

items.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cabaran ini beralih antara meter dan aksen. Sebelum setiap latihan ketukan, kira satu bar perlahan untuk mencari detik 1.

items.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
items.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Enam kuaver setiap bar, dirasai dalam dua kumpulan tiga.

items.context: Singing course · title

items.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
items.context: Singing course · course subtitle
items.translation: Temui suara anda dan nyanyi tepat tala

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · title

items.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · unit summary
items.translation: Berdiri tegak, bernafas ke bahagian bawah, tahan not pertama dengan stabil dan nyanyikan sebuah lagu.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Berdiri dengan kaki selebar pinggul dan lutut tidak dikunci. Turunkan bahu dan biarkan kepala terangkat, seolah-olah ditarik oleh tali. Kekalkan rahang santai.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan tangan pada perut dan tarik nafas perlahan. Perut dan rusuk bawah mengembang sementara bahu tidak bergerak. Nafas rendah itu menyokong suara anda.

items.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apabila menarik nafas untuk menyanyi, apakah yang patut bergerak?

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Nafas rendah mengembangkan rusuk dan perut. Mengangkat bahu menegangkan leher dan tekak.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Timbre mendengar nama not, jadi C yang dinyanyikan rendah atau tinggi kedua-duanya diterima. Pilih oktaf yang selesa, tanpa memaksa suara.

items.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bernafas rendah, kemudian nyanyikan C dengan “ah” dalam oktaf yang selesa. Tahan dengan stabil.

items.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekali lagi: berdiri tegak, bernafas rendah dan biarkan not berbunyi.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mengekalkan not bermaksud menahannya pada satu pic yang stabil. Lepaskan udara perlahan dan sekata, seperti mengaburkan cermin dengan nafas tanpa berhenti.

items.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan C dengan “ah” dan tahan dengan stabil sehingga tepat tala.

items.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not anda bergetar tidak stabil dan semakin lemah. Apakah yang paling membantu?

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Udara stabil menghasilkan not stabil. Bunyi lebih kuat dan ketegangan tambahan menjadikannya lebih sukar dikawal.

items.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang E. Nafas rendah yang sama, “ah” santai yang sama.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nyanyikan “ah” dengan rahang diturunkan dan hujung lidah berehat di belakang gigi bawah. Bunyi mengalir keluar, bukan dipaksa melalui tekak yang sempit.

items.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kali ini G. Turunkan rahang dan kekalkan “ah” terbuka.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Memadankan pic bermaksud menyanyikan not yang sama seperti yang didengar. Dengar, bayangkan not itu seketika, kemudian nyanyikan lembut dan laraskan sehingga tepat.

items.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan E lembut, kemudian laraskan sehingga tepat.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Terlalu rendah bermaksud di bawah pic sasaran; terlalu tinggi bermaksud di atasnya. Jika terlalu rendah, naikkan sedikit. Jika terlalu tinggi, turunkan perlahan. Perubahan kecil paling berkesan.

items.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Timbre menunjukkan pic anda terlalu rendah. Apakah yang anda lakukan?

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Terlalu rendah bermaksud di bawah not sasaran, jadi naikkan pic sedikit.

items.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dua not kali ini: D, kemudian G. Tarik nafas di antaranya.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bersenandung dengan bibir tertutup ialah pemanasan lembut. Anda patut merasakan getaran ringan pada bibir dan hidung. Kekalkan lembut dan santai.

items.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Senandungkan C, E dan G, satu demi satu. Kekalkan ringan.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tutup bibir secara santai dan hembus supaya bergetar seperti enjin bot, kemudian tambahkan suara. Ini mengekalkan tekak santai semasa suara mula dipanaskan.

items.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Getarkan bibir pada G, E, kemudian C. Jika bibir berhenti, tekan pipi dengan ringan.

items.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Satu not terasa tegang atau menggaru tekak. Apakah yang anda lakukan?

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Berhenti, rehat dan cuba lebih lembut

items.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ketegangan ialah isyarat untuk mengurangkan usaha. Rehat, hirup sedikit air dan cuba semula dengan lebih ringan.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Berdiri tegak, bernafas rendah dan mulakan setiap not dengan lembut. Rehat antara langkah jika suara terasa penat.

items.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E, kemudian G. Bayangkan setiap not sebelum menyanyi.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Terlalu tinggi ialah di atas pic sasaran; terlalu rendah ialah di bawahnya.

items.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan D lembut, kemudian laraskan sehingga tepat.

items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb memerlukan tiga not: E, D dan C, setiap satu selangkah daripada yang seterusnya. Nyanyikan dalam julat yang selesa; Timbre mendengar not yang betul dalam mana-mana oktaf.

items.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E, D, C: tiga not menurun ke asal.

items.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
items.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · title

items.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · unit summary
items.translation: Dengar not, nyanyikan semula dan bergerak dengan langkah kecil.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum menyanyi, dengar not itu dalam fikiran seketika. Jeda itu membolehkan suara menyasarkan pic, bukannya tercari-cari.

items.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dengar D dalam fikiran, kemudian nyanyikannya.

items.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dengar F dalam fikiran, kemudian nyanyikannya.

items.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Cubaan pertama terlalu rendah. Apa seterusnya?

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Perubahan kecil mencari not paling cepat. Naikkan perlahan dan biarkan stabil.

items.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dengar A dalam fikiran, kemudian nyanyikannya.

items.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tiga not berturut-turut: D, F, A.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Unison bermaksud dua bunyi pada pic yang betul-betul sama. Apabila sepadan, kedua-duanya menyatu; apabila sedikit tersasar, anda mendengar denyutan.

items.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan E dan tahan tepat tala.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Untuk menyanyikan not yang sama dua kali, hentikan udara seketika, kemudian mulakan semula dengan “da” lembut. Jangan gelongsorkan suara di antaranya.

items.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan E tiga kali dengan “da”, dengan jeda kecil setiap kali.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · title

items.source: A step is the next note
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Langkah bergerak ke not seterusnya dalam skala, naik atau turun. Langkah ialah gerakan terkecil dan paling mudah untuk dinyanyikan tepat tala.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Did it go up or down?
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Semiton ialah jarak terkecil, seperti E ke F, tanpa not di antaranya. Kebanyakan not skala berjiran, seperti C dan D, berjarak satu ton: dua semiton.

items.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E, naik semiton ke F, dan kembali.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · title

items.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dengar setiap not dalam fikiran dahulu, mulakan lembut dan laraskan sedikit-sedikit. Mulakan semula setiap not berulang dengan jelas.

items.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Dengar G dalam fikiran, kemudian nyanyikannya.

items.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B, naik semiton ke C, dan kembali.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E ke F tiada not di antaranya. C ke D dan G ke A ialah ton.

items.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 “Scales” · title

items.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 “Scales” · unit summary
items.translation: Nyanyikan do-re-mi, skala major dan corak lima not.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Solfa memberikan setiap langkah skala satu suku kata: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do ialah tempat asal, di mana sahaja skala bermula.

items.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan do, re, mi pada C, D, E.

items.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Suku kata manakah tempat asal, langkah pertama skala?

items.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Do ialah langkah pertama dan not yang menjadi tempat skala kembali.

items.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sekarang turun semula: mi, re, do.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: lima langkah pertama digunakan dalam banyak lagu mudah. Nyanyikan menaik dan menurun semula dalam satu nafas jika selesa.

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C naik ke G.

items.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Antara dua langkah manakah terdapat semiton?

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mi ke fa (E ke F) ialah semiton. Langkah lain dari do ke sol ialah ton.

items.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sol turun semula ke do: G turun ke C.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Skala major bergerak dari do naik ke do seterusnya: lapan not. Mi ke fa dan ti ke do ialah semiton; setiap langkah lain ialah satu ton.

items.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do ke do: C naik ke C seterusnya.

items.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah semiton dalam skala major?

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mi-fa dan ti-do ialah semiton. Corak itu memberikan bunyi khas skala major.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tarik nafas rendah sebelum bermula supaya tidak kehabisan nafas dekat puncak. Biarkan not tinggi menjadi lebih ringan, bukan lebih kuat, dan kekalkan rahang santai.

items.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Turun semula dari C ke C. Kekalkan setiap not rendah cerah supaya picnya tidak menurun terlalu rendah.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Corak pendek seperti do-re-mi-re-do cepat membina ketepatan. Nyanyikan satu, kemudian mulakannya selangkah lebih tinggi dan biarkan skala membimbing anda.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do naik ke sol dan kembali: C ke G ke C.

items.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Nyanyikan C-D-E-D-C, kemudian bentuk yang sama selangkah lebih tinggi. Apakah not tertinggi sekarang?

items.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Selangkah lebih tinggi, bentuknya menjadi D, E, F, E, D.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · title

items.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bernafas rendah sebelum setiap skala, kekalkan bahagian tinggi ringan dan not rendah cerah semasa menurun.

items.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa not dalam skala major, do ke do?

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: lapan not, dengan do di kedua-dua hujung.

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · title

items.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · unit summary
items.translation: Lompat dengan selang ketiga, kelima dan oktaf, serta mendarat tepat tala.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Selang ialah jarak antara dua not. Langkau satu langkah skala untuk mendapat selang ketiga, seperti do ke mi. Dengar mi dalam fikiran sebelum meninggalkan do.

items.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do ke mi dan kembali: C, E, C.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Satu lagi selang ketiga: D, F, D.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C ke E melangkau D, jadi ia merangkumi tiga not skala: selang ketiga.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Do ke sol merangkumi lima not skala, selang kelima. Bunyinya terbuka dan kuat. Bayangkan langkah di antaranya, kemudian lompat terus ke sol.

items.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do ke sol dan kembali: C, G, C.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do, mi, sol: dua selang ketiga bertindan membentuk selang kelima.

items.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Termasuk kedua-dua hujung, berapa not skala dari do ke sol?

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: lima not, jadi selang kelima.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Nama yang sama, lapan not menaik

items.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Oktaf melompat dari do ke do seterusnya, lapan not skala menaik. Kedua-dua not berkongsi nama dan begitu serasi sehingga hampir berbunyi seperti satu.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum melompat satu oktaf, bernafas rendah dan kekalkan dagu mendatar. Bayangkan not atas sebagai ringan dan mudah, bukan sesuatu yang perlu dijangkau dengan paksa.

items.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C, kemudian G, kemudian C tinggi. Gunakan G sebagai batu loncatan.

items.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Mengapakah dua not dalam oktaf begitu serasi?

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Not atas bergetar dua kali lebih cepat

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not atas bergetar tepat dua kali lebih cepat daripada not bawah, jadi gelombangnya sejajar.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · title

items.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dengar setiap lompatan dalam fikiran sebelum menyanyi. Mendarat ringan pada not atas, kemudian melangkah kembali ke asal.

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do tinggi, sol, mi, do: turun semula.

items.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah selang dari do ke do seterusnya?

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Do ke do seterusnya merangkumi lapan not skala: oktaf.

items.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 “Melodies” · unit summary
items.translation: Lima lagu domain awam, melodi sahaja, pada tempo santai.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi tradisional ini melompat naik, kemudian melangkah turun kembali ke asal. Nyanyikan dengan “loo” dan mulakan setiap not berulang dengan jelas.

items.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lompatan pembukaan: C naik ke G, melangkah ke A, kembali ke G.

items.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Frasa tengah: adakah ia menaik atau menurun?

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi daripada Simfoni Kesembilan Beethoven ini hampir keseluruhannya bergerak selangkah demi selangkah. Kekalkan lancar dan sekata, seperti berjalan naik turun tangga.

items.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lima not yang digunakan dalam lagu ini: F naik ke C.

items.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Frasa pertama berakhir dengan not bertitik. Bagaimanakah rasanya?

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not bertitik ditahan lebih lama, kemudian not pendek membawa ke not terakhir.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi tradisional Scotland ini bermula dengan anakrusis, not sebelum bar penuh pertama. Nyanyikan ringan, kemudian tekankan not seterusnya.

items.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pendakian dalam bar ketiga: F, A, C, naik ke D.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The loudest note of a song
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A note before the first full bar
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Anakrusis membawa masuk ke detik 1 bar penuh pertama.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi himne Amerika dari awal abad 1800-an ini dalam 3/4: kira 1, 2, 3. Not panjang sering bertukar menjadi pasangan pantas, jadi kekalkan pasangan itu ringan.

items.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Gerakan pantas: F, naik ke A, kembali ke F.

items.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa detik dalam setiap bar himne ini?

items.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia dalam 3/4: tiga detik setiap bar, dengan penekanan pada 1.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu rakyat Amerika dari abad 1800-an ini bergerak perlahan, dengan lompatan besar. Tarik nafas pada setiap rehat, dan dengar setiap lompatan sebelum menyanyikannya.

items.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lompatan pembukaan: G rendah naik ke C. Mana-mana oktaf diterima.

items.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lompatan besar: G naik ke C tinggi, kemudian melangkah turun.

items.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah anda patut bernafas dalam lagu ini?

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Never; sing it in one breath
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Rehat menandakan akhir frasa. Bernafas di situ supaya setiap baris mendapat sokongan penuh.

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · title

items.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lima lagu berturut-turut, satu frasa setiap satu. Bernafas pada setiap rehat dan mulakan setiap not berulang dengan jelas.

items.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Amazing Grace dikira 1, 2, 3 dalam setiap bar.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · title

items.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · unit summary
items.translation: Tahan not dengan stabil, bentuk bunyi kuat dan lembut, serta lakukan pemanasan dengan baik.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pic menyimpang apabila aliran udara berubah. Kekalkan nafas rendah dan sekata, serta perhatikan not kekal tepat dari mula hingga tamat.

items.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tahan G dan kekalkan tepat pada sasaran.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pic not sering turun terlalu rendah apabila udara hampir habis. Berhenti sedikit sebelum kehabisan nafas, kemudian tarik nafas rendah yang baharu.

items.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not panjang anda menjadi terlalu rendah pada penghujungnya. Apakah yang membantu?

items.source: End the note sooner and breathe
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Akhiri not lebih awal dan bernafas

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Pic menurun apabila udara hampir habis. Mengakhiri sedikit awal mengekalkan seluruh not tepat tala.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · title

items.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Vibrato ialah gelombang pic yang lembut dan teratur, sekitar lima hingga tujuh kali sesaat. Ia terhasil daripada tekak santai dan nafas stabil, bukan goncangan.

items.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dari manakah vibrato yang sihat terhasil?

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Vibrato muncul apabila suara bebas dan disokong. Memaksanya dari rahang atau perut menghasilkan goyangan yang tidak stabil.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Belajar menahan not lurus dan stabil sebelum mengejar vibrato. Apabila suara santai dan disokong, vibrato sering muncul sendiri.

items.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A yang lurus dan stabil. Tiada gelombang, hanya garisan jelas.

items.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah sasaran pertama terbaik untuk penyanyi baharu?

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Nada stabil ialah asasnya. Vibrato yang berkembang daripadanya berbunyi semula jadi.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dinamik ialah tahap kuat atau lembut nyanyian. Kuatkan bunyi dengan lebih tenaga nafas, bukan dengan menegangkan tekak. Pic perlu kekal sama.

items.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Nyanyikan E lembut, kemudian lebih kuat pada pic yang sama.

items.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apabila bunyi semakin kuat, apakah yang boleh berlaku pada pic?

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tolakan tambahan cenderung menaikkan pic, dan not sangat lembut boleh menjadi terlalu rendah. Perhatikan pic dalam kedua-dua keadaan.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bunyi menguat daripada lembut ke lebih kuat dan kembali dalam satu nafas. Mulakan perlahan, kuatkan secara lembut, kemudian lembutkan, semuanya pada pic yang sama.

items.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kuatkan dan lembutkan G: lembut, lebih kuat, lembut. Kekalkan tepat pada sasaran.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemanasan ringkas menyediakan suara secara beransur: bernafas rendah, bersenandung, getarkan bibir, kemudian nyanyikan skala. Mulakan di tengah julat suara dan kekalkan selesa.

items.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Suara terasa penat selepas latihan. Apakah yang terbaik?

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Rehat membantu suara penat pulih. Jika suara serak berterusan selama beberapa minggu, dapatkan pemeriksaan doktor.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · title

items.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lakukan pemanasan dahulu. Kemudian tahan setiap not stabil, bentukkan bunyi lembut dan kuat, serta bernafas sebelum kehabisan udara.

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Vibrato ialah gelombang lembut dan sekata di sekitar not, beberapa kali sesaat.

items.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Untuk menyanyi lebih kuat, apakah yang anda tambah?

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tenaga nafas menghasilkan bunyi lebih besar tanpa ketegangan.

items.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
items.context: Songs course · course subtitle
items.translation: Mainkan melodi, atau strum kord sambil menyanyi

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · title

items.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · unit summary
items.translation: Enam lagu terkenal, satu not pada satu masa, pada tali tinggi. Tempo perlahan, pencapaian besar.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada 1877, Thomas Edison membacakan sajak ini untuk menguji fonograf baharunya. Melodinya menggunakan C dan D pada tali 2, kemudian E terbuka, dan G pada fret 3 tali 1.

items.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E D C D E E E: tali 1 terbuka, kemudian tali 2 pada fret 3 dan 1, dan kembali.

items.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D D D pada fret 3 tali 2. Kemudian E terbuka, dan G pada fret 3 tali 1.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini mula-mula dicetak di Perancis pada 1761, dan Mozart kemudian menulis dua belas variasi daripadanya. Ia melompat naik, kemudian melangkah turun merentasi tali 2 dan 3.

items.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, lompat naik ke D pada fret 3 tali 2, E terbuka, dan kembali ke D.

items.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Melangkah turun berpasangan: C pada fret 1, B terbuka, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G terbuka.

items.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lagu lain manakah menggunakan melodi yang sama?

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Lagu abjad dan Baa, Baa, Black Sheep kedua-duanya meminjam melodi Perancis ini.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beethoven menyiapkan Simfoni Kesembilan pada 1824, dan melodi ini kini menjadi lagu rasmi Kesatuan Eropah. Di sini anda akan memainkan seluruh melodi, termasuk bahagian tengah.

items.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: E E F G G F E D, selangkah pada satu masa.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam bahagian tengah, E dan F berkongsi satu detik. Kira satu, dua-dan, tiga, empat, dan mainkan E pada dua serta F pada “dan”.

items.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian tengah: pasangan E F pantas pada tali 1, kemudian turun ke G terbuka pada tali 3.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Frère Jacques ialah lagu pusingan Perancis, mula-mula dicetak sekitar 1780: pemain kedua memulakan melodi yang sama dua bar kemudian, dan bahagian-bahagiannya berpadu.

items.source: In a round, the second player…
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Semua orang memainkan melodi yang sama, masing-masing bermula sedikit lewat. Frasanya dibina supaya boleh dimainkan bertindih dengan serasi.

items.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian pantas: D E D C pada tali 2 dan 1, kemudian B dan G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Penamat turun dari G terbuka ke D terbuka pada tali 4, kemudian kembali.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: James Lord Pierpont menerbitkan lagu ini pada 1857 sebagai One Horse Open Sleigh. Anda akan memainkan korus terkenalnya, semuanya pada tali 1 dan 2.

items.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, G pada fret 3, turun ke C dan D pada tali 2, kemudian kembali ke E.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam frasa itu, C berbunyi selama satu setengah detik dan D masuk pada “dan” selepas empat. Kira satu, dua, tiga, empat-dan.

items.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris kedua berada pada F di fret 1, kemudian berakhir pada E terbuka.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu rohani tradisional ini menjadi standard jazz selepas Louis Armstrong merakamkannya pada 1938. Ia menggunakan C, D, E, F dan G pada tali 2 dan 1.

items.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: C pada tali 2, kemudian E, F dan G menaiki tali 1.

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada not baharu di sini: keenam-enam lagu daripada unit ini, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya. Kenal pasti pembukaan melalui pendengaran, kemudian mainkan.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · title

items.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · unit summary
items.translation: Lagu unggun api dan lagu laut, dengan kord mudah untuk distrum pada lagu paling ringkas.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster menerbitkan lagu ini pada 1848, dan pencari emas yang menuju California menjadikannya lagu semangat mereka. Rangkapnya dimainkan pada tali 3, 2 dan 1.

items.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka, D pada fret 3, E terbuka, kemudian turun semula ke G terbuka dan A pada fret 2.

items.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bar terakhir: B B A A, kemudian kembali ke G terbuka.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G terasa seperti tempat asal, dan D7 menarik kembali ke arahnya. Rangkapnya ialah tiga bar G, satu D7, dua G, kemudian D7 dan G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster menulis lagu perlumbaan ini pada 1850, dua tahun selepas Oh! Susanna. Ia menggunakan not yang sama dan dua kord yang sama.

items.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D D B D, naik ke E terbuka, kemudian D dan B. Tali 2 dan 1.

items.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dua kali dalam baris pertama, B pantas membawa ke A yang berbunyi selama tiga detik. Petik A sekali dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu ladang ini mula-mula dicetak pada 1917, tetapi orang telah menyanyikan versinya sejak lama sebelum itu. Melodinya turun hingga D dan E pada tali 4.

items.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka tiga kali, turun ke D terbuka, E pada fret 2 tali 4, kembali ke D.

items.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kemudian naik: B terbuka dua kali, A pada fret 2 tali 3, dan kembali ke G terbuka.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Di sini setiap kord berlangsung dua detik, jadi strum dikira satu, dua. Urutannya ialah G, G, C, G, kemudian G, D7, G, G. Bersedia menukar lebih awal.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Askar British mula-mula menyanyikan melodi ini untuk mengejek penduduk koloni Amerika. Menjelang akhir Revolusi, orang Amerika telah menjadikannya milik mereka.

items.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C C D E, C E D, kemudian turun ke G terbuka pada tali 3.

items.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Separuh pertama berakhir pada B. Bagaimanakah rasanya?

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B berada tepat di bawah C dan cenderung ke arahnya. Separuh kedua menjawab dengan berakhir pada C.

items.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris terakhir: turun dari F pada tali 1, turun ke G terbuka, kemudian naik semula ke C.

items.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korusnya rendah: A pada fret 2 tali 3, B terbuka, kemudian F dan E pada tali 4 serta C pada tali 5.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: George Poulton menerbitkan balada ini pada 1861. Hampir satu abad kemudian, melodinya menjadi lagu Love Me Tender.

items.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik ke C, turun ke B terbuka dan kembali, kemudian D, turun ke A, dan D lagi.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Aura Lee ialah balada perlahan. Kekalkan setiap jari pada tali sehingga not seterusnya berbunyi supaya not bersambung lancar.

items.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
