items.translation: Bahagian tinggi: E terbuka, F pada fret 1, kemudian turun ke D, A dan D lagi.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu dari utara England ini mengisahkan Bobby Shafto yang pergi ke laut. Liriknya telah dicetak menjelang 1805, dan pemain fiddle memainkan melodinya untuk tarian menjelang 1770.

items.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka, D pada fret 3, kembali ke B dan G terbuka, kemudian B, D dan B lagi.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Baris kedua turun ke F syap: tali 4, fret 4, dengan jari kelingking. Kekalkan tangan di atas empat fret pertama supaya bersedia.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, C pada fret 1 tali 2, A, turun ke F syap, dan naik semula.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiga baris pertama berakhir dengan cara yang sama: dua not satu detik, kemudian satu not dua detik. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · title

items.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rangkapnya hanya memerlukan dua kord daripada Oh! Susanna: dua bar G, dua D7, dua G, kemudian D7 dan G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada not atau kord baharu: keenam-enam lagu daripada unit ini, satu demi satu, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · title

items.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · unit summary
items.translation: Tema terkenal oleh Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg dan Beethoven, dalam kedudukan pertama.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johann Pachelbel menulis kanon ini lebih 300 tahun lalu. Besnya mengulang lapan not yang sama sepanjang karya, sementara biola menganyam melodi di atasnya.

items.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bes, dinaikkan satu oktaf: D, A, B, F syap, G, D, G, A.

items.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang dilakukan oleh bes sepanjang Canon?

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Plays a new tune each time
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bes berulang seperti ini dipanggil ground. Semua bahagian lain karya dibina di atasnya.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 4 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Syap ialah satu fret di atas huruf asalnya. Melodi menggunakan C syap pada tali 2, fret 2, dan F syap pada tali 4, fret 4. Capai yang itu dengan jari kelingking.

items.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris biola pertama: turun dari F syap pada tali 1, kemudian naik semula ke C syap.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Antonín Dvořák menulis tema ini untuk kor Inggeris pada 1893, dalam Simfoni From the New World, semasa tinggal di New York.

items.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 1, kembali ke E, kemudian D dan C pada tali 2.

items.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan bar bermula dengan not panjang dan not pantas. Kira satu, dua-dan, tiga: not pantas jatuh pada “dan” selepas dua.

items.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Penamat: D, E, D, kemudian berakhir pada C dan biarkan berbunyi.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johannes Brahms menulis lagu dodoi ini pada 1868 untuk anak lelaki sahabatnya yang baru lahir. Ia berayun dalam tiga, seperti buaian: satu not panjang, kemudian dua not pantas.

items.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan berayun antara B terbuka dan D pada fret 3 tali 2.

items.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka pada tali 3, kemudian not yang sama satu oktaf lebih tinggi: G pada fret 3 tali 1.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minuet ini terdapat dalam buku catatan 1725 yang diberikan Bach kepada isterinya, Anna Magdalena. Para sarjana kini mengaitkannya dengan rakan komposernya, Christian Petzold.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian naik dari G terbuka: A, B, C, D. Kemudian dua G terbuka.

items.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Minuet ialah tarian dalam tiga. Kebanyakan bar bermula dengan detik panjang, kemudian pasangan pantas: satu, dua-dan, tiga-dan.

items.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, kembali ke C dan D pada tali 2, kemudian E, F syap dan G pada tali 1.

items.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Penamat: A B A G, kemudian F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, dan kembali ke G.

items.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian kedua bermula rendah: B terbuka, A, D terbuka, kemudian C syap pada fret 4 dan B pada fret 2 tali 5, serta A terbuka.

items.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · title
items.translation: In the Hall of the Mountain King

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Grieg menulis ini untuk drama Peer Gynt pada 1875. Ia menggambarkan troll di dewan raja mereka, bermula lembut dan semakin cepat.

items.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naik dari tali 6 terbuka: F syap pada fret 2, G pada fret 3, A terbuka, B pada fret 2.

items.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian menyelinap: A syap pada fret 1 tali 5, kemudian A terbuka dengan F pada fret 1 tali 6.

items.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah A syap pada tali 5?

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A syap ialah satu fret di atas A, dan A ialah tali 5 terbuka. Jadi A syap ialah fret 1.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 8 (along) · title

Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Beethoven menulis karya piano ini pada 1810, tetapi ia hanya diterbitkan pada 1867, empat puluh tahun selepas kematiannya. Versi dipermudah ini mengekalkan pembukaan terkenal itu.

items.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Berayun antara E terbuka dan D syap pada fret 4 tali 2, kemudian turun B, D, C ke A.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap bar mempunyai tiga detik. Selepas A panjang hadir rehat pendek, kemudian tiga not pantas menaik: C, E, A. Angkat jari semasa rehat, tetapi terus mengira.

items.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A, kemudian C pada tali 5, E dan A. Kemudian B, E, G syap pada fret 1 tali 3, dan B.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian tengah: setiap frasa turun ke not rendah, kemudian melangkah turun. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada not baharu: enam tema daripada unit ini, dari Pachelbel hingga Beethoven, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya.

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Minuet ialah tarian dalam tiga. Canon dan mars troll kedua-duanya dikira dalam empat.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · title

items.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · unit summary
items.translation: Balada Demam Emas, dua himne kesayangan dan lagu Shaker daripada khazanah lagu Amerika.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu Amerika ini diterbitkan pada 1884 dan mengenang Demam Emas California pada 1849. Ia dalam tiga, pada tali 3, 2 dan 1.

items.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Clementine bermula dengan dua not pantas sebelum detik pertama. Apakah namanya?

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Anakrusis ialah beberapa not yang membawa ke detik kuat pertama. Di sini ia jatuh pada “dan” selepas detik ketiga.

items.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Gerakan di tengah: G pada fret 3 tali 1, turun ke D, kemudian naik semula ke F.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: John Newton menulis liriknya pada 1779. Melodi yang dipanggil New Britain mula-mula dicetak pada 1829 dan digabungkan dengan liriknya pada 1835.

items.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris tinggi: naik ke D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian B G, B A, G E D.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · title
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Samuel Francis Smith menulis lirik Amerika ini pada 1831, untuk melodi yang sudah dinyanyikan di Britain sebagai God Save the King.

items.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Titik memanjangkan not sebanyak separuh lagi nilainya. Dalam bar kedua, F syap berbunyi satu setengah detik, G masuk pada “dan” selepas dua, dan A jatuh pada tiga.

items.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris terakhir: B C B A G, kemudian B C D, naik ke E terbuka, dan turun C B A G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · title
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Joseph Brackett menulis Simple Gifts pada 1848 untuk komuniti Shaker, yang menari sambil menyanyi. Aaron Copland kemudian membina sebahagian balet Appalachian Spring berasaskan lagu ini.

items.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian kedua bermula tinggi: G pada fret 3 tali 1, kemudian E D, dan E F E D C.

items.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dua not berkongsi setiap detik dalam lagu ini. Bagaimanakah anda mengiranya?

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dua not sekata setiap detik ialah kuaver. Sebut nombor pada yang pertama dan “dan” pada yang kedua.

items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · title
Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada idea baharu: empat lagu daripada unit ini, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya. Tiga daripadanya berayun dalam tiga. Simple Gifts menari dalam empat.

items.source: What does a dot after a note do?
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Makes it half again as long
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
items.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Krocet bertitik berlangsung satu setengah detik. Not selepasnya biasanya pantas untuk melengkapkan detik.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 “Holiday and celebration” · title

items.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 “Holiday and celebration” · unit summary
items.translation: Karol dan lagu Tahun Baharu, dalam dua, tiga, empat dan enam.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini dicetak pada 1582 dalam Piae Cantiones, buku lagu dari Finland, sebagai lagu tentang musim bunga. John Mason Neale memberinya lirik Krismas pada 1853.

items.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris terakhir menaik dari D terbuka pada tali 4: E, F syap pada fret 4, G terbuka, kemudian A.

items.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Kemudian dari D pada fret 3 tali 2, melangkah turun ke G, singgah pada C dan mendarat pada G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Deck the Halls berasal daripada Nos Galan, lagu malam Tahun Baharu Wales dari abad 1700-an. Lirik bahasa Inggerisnya muncul pada 1862.

items.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris ketiga menaik: C syap pada fret 2 tali 2, D, kemudian E, F syap dan G pada tali 1.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 3 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A7 memerlukan dua jari pada fret 2: jari 1 pada tali 4, jari 3 pada tali 2. Mulakan strum pada tali 5. C syap pada tali 2 itulah yang dilalui melodi semasa menaik.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · title
items.translation: We Wish You a Merry Christmas

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Karol ini berasal dari West Country di England, tempat penyanyi pergi dari rumah ke rumah pada malam musim sejuk sambil mengharapkan juadah sebagai balasan.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2 dan tali 4 terbuka kedua-duanya D. Berapa jaraknya?

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Oktaf ialah huruf yang sama, lapan langkah lebih tinggi atau rendah. Kedua-dua D serasi, tetapi satu berbunyi lebih terang.

items.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B A G, kemudian lompat dari D pada fret 3 tali 2 turun ke D terbuka. Kemudian E, A, F syap, G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Auld lang syne dalam bahasa Scots bermaksud masa yang telah berlalu. Robert Burns menghantar liriknya untuk buku lagu pada 1788, dan melodi ini dicetak bersama lirik itu pada 1799.

items.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korusnya menaik: B, D, E terbuka, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 1. Turun semula: D, B B G.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lowell Mason menggubah susunan melodi ini pada 1839, dengan meminjam frasa daripada Messiah karya Handel. Ia bermula dengan skala G major, terus menurun dari G ke G.

items.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Karol ini dikira dalam dua. Dalam bar pertama, G memenuhi detik pertama, F syap mengambil kebanyakan detik kedua, dan E masuk pada penghujungnya.

items.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian tengah mengulang B terbuka dan melangkah naik ke D, kemudian mengulang A pada fret 2 tali 3 dan melangkah naik ke C.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber menulis Silent Night pada 1818 untuk malam Krismas di Oberndorf, Austria. Pada persembahan pertamanya, satu-satunya iringan ialah gitar.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Silent Night dalam 6/8: enam kiraan pantas setiap bar, dikumpulkan satu-dua-tiga, empat-lima-enam. Setiap kumpulan berayun seperti satu detik perlahan.

items.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Penamat menaik ke G pada fret 3 tali 1, berbunyi pada F syap, kemudian turun ke D terbuka.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D menggunakan empat tali tinggi. Jari 1 pada tali 3, fret 2; jari 2 pada tali 1, fret 2; jari 3 pada tali 2, fret 3. Strum dari tali 4 terbuka.

items.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), bahasa Inggeris oleh John Freeman Young (1859)

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · title
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada idea baharu: enam lagu dalam dua, tiga, empat dan enam, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya. Rasai permulaan setiap bar.

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Silent Night dalam 6/8. Bagaimanakah enam kiraannya dikumpulkan?

items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
items.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 6/8 berayun dalam dua detik besar, setiap satu dibahagi tiga: satu-dua-tiga, empat-lima-enam.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · title

items.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · unit summary
items.translation: Dua tema Mozart dan dua melodi lama: rehat, nada dasar minor, julat luas dan kedudukan ketiga.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · title
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mozart menyiapkan serenad untuk alat muzik bertali ini pada 1787. Pembukaannya melompat naik melalui not kord G, kemudian menjawab dengan not D7.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rehat ialah detik senyap. Sentuh tali dengan jari pada fret supaya senyapnya jelas, kemudian masuk semula tepat pada masa.

items.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Jawapan: C pada fret 1 tali 2, A pada fret 2 tali 3, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, kemudian D terbuka.

items.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pembukaan menaik melalui kord. Major atau minor?

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Greensleeves telah dinyanyikan di England menjelang tahun 1580-an, dan Shakespeare menyebutnya dalam The Merry Wives of Windsor. Di sini ia dalam E minor, rendah dan suram.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam E minor, D syap berada satu fret di bawah E dan tertarik ke arahnya. Cari D syap pada tali 4, fret 1, dan C syap pada tali 5, fret 4.

items.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Setiap separuh berakhir: G, F syap, E, kemudian D syap, C syap, D syap, dan kembali ke E.

items.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korus bermula tinggi: D pada fret 3 tali 2, C syap pada fret 2, B terbuka, kemudian turun ke D terbuka.

items.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-greensleeves “Greensleeves” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Greensleeves berasaskan kord ini. Major atau minor?

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · title
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini mula-mula dicetak dalam koleksi muzik Ireland oleh George Petrie pada 1855. Lirik Danny Boy dipadankan dengannya jauh kemudian, pada 1913.

items.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bahagian tertinggi: tiga A, naik ke F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, kemudian E E D B D, A F syap D.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Melodi ini merentasi tali 5 hingga tali 1. Apakah yang memastikan setiap tali dapat dicapai?

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Ibu jari rendah di belakang leher

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Dengan ibu jari rendah di belakang leher, jari-jari melengkung dan mencapai dari tali 5 hingga tali 1 tanpa ketegangan.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-danny-boy “Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)” · step 5 (along) · title

Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · title
Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mozart menyiapkan Simfoni No. 40 pada 1788. Ia salah satu daripada hanya dua simfoni yang ditulisnya dalam nada dasar minor, dan bermula dengan tema resah seperti keluhan ini.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gelongsorkan tangan ke atas supaya jari 1 berada pada fret 3. Setiap jari kini meliputi satu fret: 3, 4, 5 dan 6. Alihkan ibu jari juga, di belakang jari 2.

items.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam kedudukan ketiga, jari manakah memainkan fret 3?

items.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kedudukan dinamakan mengikut tempat jari 1. Dalam kedudukan ketiga, jari 1 memainkan fret 3 dan jari 4 mencapai fret 6.

items.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E flet pada fret 4 dan D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian jari 4 naik ke B flet pada fret 6 tali 1.

items.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Frasa terakhir: F syap, dengan jari 1 menjangkau ke belakang ke fret 2. Kemudian E flet, D, C pada fret 5 tali 3, dan B flet.

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-mozart-40 “Mozart's Symphony No. 40” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · title
Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada idea baharu: dua tema Mozart, dua melodi lama dan kedudukan ketiga, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya. Tarik nafas antara karya.

items.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam E minor, not manakah cenderung naik ke E?

items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
items.context: Songs · Unit 6 · challenge song-medley-classical-2 “Concert hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D syap berada satu fret di bawah E. Semiton itu kuat menarik ke asal, sebab itulah Greensleeves menggunakannya pada setiap kadens.

items.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.

items.translation: Lima lagu baharu dengan kord terbuka yang anda kenali: pop unggun api, balada, folk hentak, reggae dan country.

Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kite Weather ialah pop cerah dan mudah: empat kord berulang, G, D, E minor dan C, pada 88 detik seminit yang santai. Dengarkan bahagian tarikan melodi melompat naik ke F syap dalam bar keduanya.

items.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah bahagian tarikan melodi mula-mula menaik atau menurun?

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-kite-weather “Kite Weather” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, B terbuka dan kembali, kemudian E terbuka dan F syap pada fret 2 tali 1.

Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · title
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Porchlight mengalir pada 70 detik seminit. Balada ialah lagu perlahan yang bercerita, jadi beri setiap kord ruang untuk berbunyi. Dengarkan not panjang yang menutup setiap baris.

items.source: Does this phrase end at home?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Adakah frasa ini berakhir pada not asal?

items.source: The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-porchlight “Porchlight” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Korus menaiki tali 1: E terbuka, F syap pada fret 2, G pada fret 3, kemudian melangkah turun semula ke D.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · title
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Moth and Ember ialah lagu yang membuat seluruh bilik menghentak bersama: strum ke bawah yang berat, tarikan melodi seperti sorakan, 96 detik seminit. Ia bermula suram dalam A minor dan menjadi cerah pada D.

items.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naiki A minor: A pada fret 2 tali 3, C pada fret 1 tali 2, E terbuka. Kemudian melangkah turun semula.

items.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bar kedua bahagian tarikan melodi meniru yang pertama, beberapa not lebih tinggi. Apakah namanya?

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-moth-and-ember “Moth and Ember” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Sekuen mengulang bentuk melodi dari not permulaan baharu. Ia menjadikan tarikan melodi mudah diingati.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · title
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Low Tide Radio ialah reggae santai pada 80 detik seminit. Gitar hanya bermain pada “dan” selepas setiap detik, chop pendek yang dipanggil skank, sementara bes dan dram mengekalkan detik.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Strum ke bawah pada setiap “dan”, kemudian kurangkan tekanan jari pada tali supaya kord berhenti. Chk, chk, chk, chk. Senyap antara chop membentuk separuh rasa iramanya.

items.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-low-tide-radio “Low Tide Radio” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, C syap pada fret 2, B terbuka, kemudian A pada fret 2 tali 3.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · title

items.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dust on the Dashboard bergerak pada 100 detik seminit. Pemain country membahagikan bar: boom, not bes pada detik satu dan tiga, kemudian chick, strum pada dua dan empat.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pada boom, petik hanya not paling rendah kord, iaitu akarnya: tali 5 terbuka untuk A, tali 4 terbuka untuk D, tali 6 terbuka untuk E. Pada chick, sapukan tali yang lebih nipis.

items.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Tali manakah menjadi boom untuk kord D?

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Akar D ialah tali 4 terbuka, tali yang sama tempat strum D bermula.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · song orig-dust-on-the-dashboard “Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, B terbuka, C syap pada fret 2 tali 2, kemudian E terbuka dan F syap pada fret 2.

items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · title
Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada kord atau not baharu: lima lagu daripada unit ini, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat. Kenal pasti setiap tarikan melodi melalui pendengaran, kemudian mainkan.

items.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lagu manakah mempunyai tarikan melodi yang bermula seperti ini?

items.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam reggae, di manakah gitar memainkan chop?

items.source: On the and of each beat
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
items.context: Originals · Unit 1 · challenge orig-open-chord-set “Open-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Skank jatuh di antara detik, sementara bes dan dram mengekalkan detik utama.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 “Three-chord sing-alongs” · title

items.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 “Three-chord sing-alongs” · unit summary
items.translation: Lima lagu dengan tiga kord setiap satu: korus unggun api, country two-step, waltz, reggae mudah dan bedroom pop.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lantern Hill ialah lagu unggun api dengan tiga kord, G, C dan D, pada 92 detik seminit. Korusnya dibuat untuk dinyanyikan ramai-ramai, jadi pada ulangan kedua, nyanyikan dengan penuh suara.

items.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-lantern-hill “Lantern Hill” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, E terbuka lagi, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 1 dan turun semula.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ialah country dewan tari dalam A pada 116 detik seminit. Petik akar pada satu dan tiga, strum pada dua dan empat, serta tambah strum ke atas pantas selepas setiap strum.

items.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam two-step, di manakah not bes jatuh?

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bes berjalan bersama kaki penari pada satu dan tiga; strum mengisi dua dan empat.

items.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-gravel-road-two-step “Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian C syap pada fret 2 dan A pada tali 3.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: First Frost dikira dalam tiga pada 108 detik seminit: satu, dua, tiga, dengan penekanan pada satu. D, G dan A mengiringi semuanya, dan setiap baris berakhir pada not panjang yang ditahan.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-first-frost “First Frost” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1, D pada fret 3 tali 2, dua kali. Kemudian E, F syap pada fret 2, E, D dan A.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Hammock Season ialah reggae mudah dalam C pada 76 detik seminit. Gitar hanya bermain pada detik dua dan empat: satu strum ke atas yang pendek dan cerah pada tali tinggi, kemudian senyap.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-hammock-season “Hammock Season” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sapukan ke atas merentasi tali 1 hingga 3, kemudian rehatkan tangan pada fret supaya kord berhenti serta-merta. Chk pada dua, chk pada empat. Detik senyap itulah yang membuatnya berayun.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · title
Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars ialah bedroom pop lembut pada 84 detik seminit: E minor, C dan G, distrum ringan. Kebanyakan baris bermula sejurus selepas detik, jadi biarkan masuk dengan ringan.

items.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka dua kali, G pada fret 3 tali 1, E terbuka, G lagi, kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2.

items.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E minor, C dan G berkongsi satu not. Not mana?

items.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · song orig-glow-in-the-dark-stars “Glow-in-the-Dark Stars” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E minor ialah E, G dan B; C ialah C, E dan G; G ialah G, B dan D. G terdapat dalam ketiga-tiganya, jadi pertukaran terasa lancar.

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · title

items.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Dalam reggae, di manakah gitar bermain?

items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
items.context: Originals · Unit 2 · challenge orig-sing-along-set “Sing-along set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Gitar reggae menjawab detik: strum ke atas pendek pada dua dan empat, senyap di antaranya.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 “Four-chord pop anthems” · title

items.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 “Four-chord pop anthems” · unit summary
items.translation: Gelung empat kord dalam lima gaya: dua lagu semangat musim panas, lagu rancak gelanggang kasut roda, lagu pop dalam 6/8 dan korus stadium.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sparkler Season menggunakan gelung paling terkenal dalam pop: C, G, A minor dan F, iaitu satu, lima, enam dan empat dalam C. Ratusan lagu popular berkongsi kord ini; melodi dan lirik baharu menjadikan setiap satu unik.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F mini meliputi tali 4 hingga 1: jari 1 rata merentasi tali 2 dan 1 pada fret 1, jari 2 pada tali 3, fret 2, jari 3 pada tali 4, fret 3.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-sparkler-season “Sparkler Season” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Roller Rink ialah pop tarian cerah pada 120 detik seminit: G, E minor, C dan D, iaitu satu, enam, empat dan lima. Strum kuaver sekata dan rasai dram bes jatuh pada setiap detik.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-roller-rink “Roller Rink” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, E terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 1 tiga kali, F syap pada fret 2, E terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Echo Canyon memainkan E minor, C, G dan D pada 80 detik seminit. Strum besar pada satu, biarkan berbunyi, kemudian bina tenaga pada tiga dan empat. Detik half-time membuatnya terasa megah.

items.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kite Weather memainkan G, D, E minor dan C. Echo Canyon memainkan E minor, C, G dan D. Apakah yang berubah?

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Empat kord yang sama, nada dasar yang sama. Bermula pada E minor meletakkan kord sedih dahulu, jadi gelung berbunyi lebih suram.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-echo-canyon “Echo Canyon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1 dan E terbuka, dua kali. Kemudian G lagi dan D pada fret 3 tali 2, dua kali.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Open Windows berayun dalam 6/8 pada 120 kiraan seminit: enam kiraan pantas dirasai sebagai dua ayunan besar. C, F, A minor dan G mengalir di bawah korus yang terbuka luas.

items.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-open-windows “Open Windows” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C pada fret 1 tali 2, D pada fret 3, E terbuka, F pada fret 1 tali 1, E, G pada fret 3, E, G, kemudian C.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · title
Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Scoreboard Lights ialah lagu semangat stadium dalam D pada 100 detik seminit: D, A, B minor dan G, gelung satu, lima, enam, empat yang sama dalam nada dasar baharu. Gerakkan kuaver yang stabil.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B minor ini hanya menggunakan empat tali tinggi: fret 4 pada tali 4 dan 3, fret 3 pada tali 2, fret 2 pada tali 1. Barre penuh akan dipelajari kemudian.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · song orig-scoreboard-lights “Scoreboard Lights” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, B terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 1, F syap, E terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · title

items.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Manakah antara ini gelung empat kord dalam C?

items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
items.context: Originals · Unit 3 · challenge orig-pop-anthem-set “Pop anthem set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Satu, lima, enam dan empat dalam C ialah C, G, A minor dan F.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 “Sevenths, sus and swing” · title

items.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 “Sevenths, sus and swing” · unit summary
items.translation: Blues, waltz, folk 6/8, lo-fi dan funk, dengan kord ketujuh, kord sus dan irama swing.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle ialah blues pada 80 detik seminit: dua belas bar E7, A7 dan B7, distrum panjang-pendek. Melodi berayun dengan cara yang sama, jadi tekankan setiap not panjang.

items.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rust-belt-shuffle “Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka, D pada fret 3, E terbuka dan kembali. Kemudian G dan G syap pada tali 3, menggelongsor menuju B terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Carousel at Closing Time berpusing dalam tiga, seperti permainan pesta yang semakin perlahan: oom-pah-pah pada 96 detik seminit. Kira satu, dua, tiga, dengan penekanan pada satu.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-carousel-at-closing-time “Carousel at Closing Time” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, A pada tali 3, kemudian C syap pada fret 2, E terbuka dan G pada fret 3 tali 1.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cedar Smoke berayun dalam 6/8: enam kiraan pantas setiap bar, dirasai sebagai dua detik besar, satu-dua-tiga, empat-lima-enam. Pada 100 kiraan seminit, ia berayun seperti bot perlahan.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bar keempat menahan Dsus4: kord D dengan jari kelingking pada tali 1, fret 3. Ia terasa tergantung. Bar kelapan turun ke D biasa, dan lagu terasa selesai.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-cedar-smoke “Cedar Smoke” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, B terbuka dan kembali, kemudian E terbuka pada tali 1, dan turun lagi.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
