items.translation: Rain on the Skylight ialah lo-fi: kord ketujuh lembut di atas detik swing santai pada 72 detik seminit. Strum ke bawah pada satu, kemudian bawah-atas pada tiga, dengan strum ke atas sedikit lewat.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Am7 ialah A minor dengan jari 3 diangkat. Cmaj7 ialah C dengan jari 1 diangkat. Untuk Dm7, jari 2 pada tali 3, fret 2, dan jari 1 rata merentasi tali 2 dan 1 pada fret 1.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-rain-on-the-skylight “Rain on the Skylight” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · title
Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Neon Laundromat kekal pada satu kord, A7, sepanjang lagu. Vamp seperti ini bergantung pada irama: strum padat dan terputus-putus pada 96 detik seminit serta tarikan melodi yang mengelak detik utama.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pemain funk memanggil detik pertama sebagai “satu”. Tekankan kuat, kekalkan tangan strum berayun dalam kuaver, dan kurangkan tekanan jari selepas setiap strum supaya berbunyi chk.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, C dan C syap pada fret 1 dan 2 tali 2, E terbuka, G pada fret 3, kemudian turun semula.

items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · title

items.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
items.context: Originals · Unit 4 · challenge orig-seventh-chord-set “Swing and sevenths set” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 6/8 mempunyai enam kiraan kuaver, dirasai sebagai dua kumpulan tiga.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 “Grooves and seventh chords” · title

items.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 “Grooves and seventh chords” · unit summary
items.translation: Lo-fi, reggae one-drop, funk, tarian perlahan 6/8 dan bedroom pop, dengan kord ketujuh yang menyerikan irama.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Late Checkout ialah lo-fi pada 72 detik seminit: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 dan Am7 berulang. Strum ke bawah pada satu, kemudian bawah-atas pada tiga dengan strum ke atas sedikit lewat, dan ayunkan melodi dengan cara yang sama.

items.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-late-checkout “Late Checkout” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 ialah G dengan tali 1 pada fret 1 dan bukannya fret 3: jari 3 dan 2 pada tali 6 dan 5, jari 1 pada tali 1. Ia kuat cenderung ke C.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Saltwater Sunday ialah reggae dalam A minor pada 76 detik seminit. Gitar memainkan chop berganda pada dua dan empat, chk-a, chk-a, sementara dram menekankan tiga.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-saltwater-sunday “Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D7: jari 2 pada tali 3, fret 2, jari 1 pada tali 2, fret 1, jari 3 pada tali 1, fret 2. Am7 ke D7 dan kembali menghasilkan bunyi ceria, minor tetapi terang, sepanjang lagu.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Pocket Change ialah funk pada 100 detik seminit: vamp pada Em7, dengan A7 untuk korus. Tangan strum tidak pernah berhenti bergerak dalam kuaver; hanya sesetengah strum berbunyi bernada.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Di antara strum yang berbunyi bernada, letakkan jari tangan fret dengan ringan merentasi tali dan terus strum: strum teredam berbunyi chk. Tekan hanya untuk strum bernada.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-pocket-change “Pocket Change” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, kemudian C dan C syap pada fret 1 dan 2 tali 2. Dua kali.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kitchen Slow Dance ialah balada soul dalam 6/8 pada 108 kiraan seminit, dua ayunan perlahan setiap bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 dan G7 mengiringi rangkap; Fmaj7 dan Em7 membuka korus.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fmaj7 ialah F mini dengan tali 1 dibiarkan terbuka. Em7 menggunakan satu jari: jari 2 pada tali 5, fret 2, semua tali lain terbuka.

items.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-kitchen-slow-dance “Kitchen Slow Dance” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 1, E, D pada fret 3 tali 2, E terbuka lagi, kemudian B terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · title
Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Houseplants ialah bedroom pop lembut pada 88 detik seminit: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 dan D. Kord ketujuh memberi suasana mengkhayalkan. Strum sekali pada satu, kemudian sapukan ke atas dengan lembut pada “dan”.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gmaj7 ialah G dengan tali 1 pada fret 2 dan bukannya fret 3. Bm7 meletakkan tiga jari pada fret 2, pada tali 5, 3 dan 1, serta membiarkan tali 4 dan 2 berbunyi terbuka.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · song orig-houseplants “Houseplants” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1 dan E terbuka, dua kali, kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2 dan F syap pada fret 2 tali 1.

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · title

items.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah mempunyai not ketujuh major?

items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
items.context: Originals · Unit 5 · challenge orig-groove-set “Groove set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Cmaj7 menambah B, semiton di bawah C. G7 dan Am7 menambah ketujuh flet, satu ton di bawah akar.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 “Riffs, power chords and throwbacks” · title
items.translation: Rif, kord kuasa dan gaya retro

items.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 “Riffs, power chords and throwbacks” · unit summary
items.translation: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf dan heartland rock, dengan kord kuasa, rif dan kord sus.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Static on Channel Nine ialah punk: empat kord kuasa, kuaver diredam tapak tangan, 104 detik seminit. Rangkapnya berbisik pada not rendah; korusnya sorakan beramai-ramai, jadi mainkan penuh tenaga.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-static-on-channel-nine “Static on Channel Nine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1, turun ke D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian F syap pada fret 2 dan D lagi.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Basement Weather ialah garage rock pada 92 detik seminit: rif pada tali rendah, kemudian kord kuasa yang menjawab dengan bertenaga. Letakkan tapak tangan pada kekuda untuk mengekalkan rif padat.

items.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 5 terbuka, C pada fret 3 tali yang sama, kemudian tali 4 terbuka, dan kembali.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 6, A terbuka, G lagi, kemudian E rendah terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jawab rif dengan kord kuasa pada satu, “dan” selepas dua, dan empat: A5, G5, C5, D5. Antara hentakan, kurangkan tekanan jari pada fret supaya kord berhenti pendek.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-basement-weather “Basement Weather” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jukebox Moon ialah tarian perlahan dalam gaya doo-wop tahun 1950-an: C, A minor, F dan G7, berulang-ulang, pada 72 detik seminit. Strum setiap detik, dengan strum ke atas pantas gaya swing menuju setiap bar baharu.

items.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-jukebox-moon “Jukebox Moon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, C pada fret 1 tali 2, E terbuka, kemudian D dan C. Seterusnya, A pada fret 2 tali 3 dan naik semula.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Boardwalk Comet ialah surf rock: melodi berdenting di atas A minor, G, F dan E, berderap pada 104 detik seminit. Bayangkan gema, percikan air laut dan ombak yang hampir pecah.

items.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada tali 3, C pada fret 1, E terbuka dan turun semula. Kemudian B terbuka, D pada fret 3, dan naik ke G pada tali 1.

items.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di atas kord E, melodi memainkan G syap, bukan G. Di manakah G syap pada tali 3?

items.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-boardwalk-comet “Boardwalk Comet” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G ialah tali 3 terbuka, jadi G syap ialah satu fret ke atas. Ia kuat cenderung ke A, not asal.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · title
Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mile Marker Zero ialah rock jalan terbuka pada 100 detik seminit: kord besar yang berdering dan korus untuk memandu dengan tingkap terbuka. Dengarkan D naik ke Dsus4 dan kembali.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Asus4 ialah A dengan jari kelingking ditambah pada tali 2, fret 3. Seperti Dsus4, ia cenderung ke hadapan dan ingin kembali ke asal.

items.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · song orig-mile-marker-zero “Mile Marker Zero” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap pada fret 2 dan G pada fret 3 tali 1, kemudian turun ke D pada fret 3 tali 2.

items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · title

items.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
items.context: Originals · Unit 6 · challenge orig-throwback-set “Throwback set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Doo-wop menggunakan swing lembut. Punk dan surf bergerak dengan kuaver lurus dan sekata.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 “Power-chord punk and rock” · title

items.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 “Power-chord punk and rock” · unit summary
items.translation: Punk-pop, rock rif, rock suram 6/8, lagu semangat indie dan desert rock, dengan kord kuasa dan rif tali rendah.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · title
Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Last Bell ialah punk-pop pada 152 detik seminit: C5, G5, A5 dan F5, gelung empat kord sebagai kord kuasa. Semuanya strum ke bawah dalam kuaver stabil, dengan tapak tangan pada tali dekat kekuda.

items.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F5 ialah bentuk G5 dua fret lebih rendah: jari 1 pada tali 6, fret 1, jari 3 dan 4 pada tali 5 dan 4 di fret 3.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-last-bell “Last Bell” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1 dan E terbuka, dua kali. Kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2, dua kali, E terbuka dan D.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · title
Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Copper Wire berasaskan rif: baris pendek yang menarik pada tali rendah yang diikuti seluruh kumpulan. Ia bergerak pada 112 detik seminit dalam E, dengan kord kuasa dalam korus.

items.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 6 terbuka dua kali, G pada fret 3, E terbuka, tali 5 terbuka, G lagi, kemudian E terbuka.

items.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-copper-wire “Copper Wire” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Bar kedua berpatah balik: B pada fret 2 tali 5, A terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 6, A terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · title
Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cold Lake ialah rock alternatif suram dalam 6/8 pada 120 kiraan seminit: E5, C5, G5 dan D5. Kekalkan rangkap lembut dan rendah supaya korus boleh berkembang luas.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-cold-lake “Cold Lake” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1, E terbuka, G lagi, kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2. Biarkan setiap not berbunyi.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · title
Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Parking Lot Cathedral ialah indie rock pada 128 detik seminit: D5, A5, B5 dan G5, gelung empat kord lagi, kini sebagai kord kuasa. Kuaver besar, terbuka dan bertenaga.

items.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B5 ialah bentuk A5 dinaikkan dua fret: jari 1 pada tali 5, fret 2, jari 3 dan 4 pada tali 4 dan 3 di fret 4.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-parking-lot-cathedral “Parking Lot Cathedral” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, dua kali, F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, E terbuka, G pada fret 3, E terbuka.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · title
Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Halogen ialah desert rock dalam D minor pada 104 detik seminit: rif mengasyikkan pada tali 4 dan 5, suara rendah dan stabil, kemudian F5, C5 dan G5 membuka korus.

items.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Tali 4 terbuka dua kali, F pada fret 3, D terbuka, tali 3 terbuka, F lagi, kemudian D terbuka.

items.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · song orig-halogen “Halogen” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F pada fret 1 tali 1, E terbuka, C pada fret 1 tali 2, kemudian G pada fret 3 tali 1, E dan C.

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · title

items.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: Lagu manakah mempunyai rif yang bermula seperti ini?

items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kord kuasa terdiri daripada akar dan not kelimanya, tanpa not ketiga, jadi ia bukan major atau minor.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · title
items.translation: Lagu bercerita dan lagu yang membara perlahan

items.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · unit summary
items.translation: Balada, kisah laut dalam 6/8, waltz kotak muzik, lagu folk cerah untuk strum dan lagu suram dalam A minor.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letters in a Shoebox bercerita dalam C pada 72 detik seminit. Rangkapnya bergerak C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F dan G, rangkaian kord yang telah mengiringi balada selama berabad-abad.

items.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C pada fret 1 tali 2, D pada fret 3, E terbuka, F pada fret 1 tali 1, G pada fret 3, kemudian D lagi.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Keeper's Daughter ialah lagu bercerita dalam 6/8 pada 120 kiraan seminit: E minor, D, C dan B7. Tiga rangkap menceritakan kisahnya, dan korus menjawab setiap satu.

items.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka, E terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 1, E terbuka, kemudian C pada fret 1 tali 2, E dan C.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Snow Globe Town ialah waltz pantas dalam G pada 120 detik seminit, seperti kotak muzik: satu detik kuat, dua detik ringan. G, D, E minor dan C, dengan B7 dalam bridge.

items.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, C pada fret 1, D, C, kemudian B terbuka: turun perlahan, seperti salji.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Thistle and Thread ialah lagu folk cerah untuk strum dalam A pada 116 detik seminit. Asus4 dan Asus2 menghiasi kord A: ubah satu jari dan kord bersinar.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari A, letakkan jari 4 pada tali 2, fret 3 untuk Asus4. Angkat jari dari tali 2 dan biarkan berbunyi terbuka untuk Asus2. Kedua-duanya kembali ke A.

items.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, E terbuka, D pada fret 3 tali 2, E dua kali, C syap, B terbuka, kemudian A.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ghost Light ialah balada perlahan dan suram dalam A minor pada 70 detik seminit. Rangkapnya menurun dari A minor melalui F dan C ke E major, yang kuat menarik kembali ke A minor.

items.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E major dalam A minor membawa satu not baharu. Not mana?

items.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Not A minor sendiri mempunyai G. E major memerlukan G syap, semiton di bawah A, jadi ia kuat cenderung ke asal.

items.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: F pada fret 1 tali 1, E terbuka, G pada fret 3, kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2. Biarkan setiap not berbunyi lama.

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · title

items.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 3/4 dikira satu, dua, tiga, dengan penekanan pada satu: waltz.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · title

items.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · unit summary
items.translation: Indie pop, balada bertenaga, highlife, neo-soul dan lagu semangat dengan pertukaran nada dasar, menggunakan barre F dan B minor.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · title

items.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Late Bus Home ialah indie pop untuk perjalanan pulang melalui kota yang sedang tidur: D, B minor, G dan A pada 100 detik seminit. Setiap baris bermula sejurus selepas detik, jadi tunggu seketika.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mainkan barre B minor penuh pada fret 2 jika boleh. Jika belum, gunakan empat tali tinggi: fret 4 pada tali 4 dan 3, fret 3 pada tali 2, fret 2 pada tali 1.

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada fret 2 tali 3, D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian E terbuka dan F syap pada fret 2 tali 1.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Glass Satellites ialah balada perlahan yang menjulang pada 76 detik seminit: A minor, F, C dan G. Strum besar pada satu dan biarkan berbunyi, kemudian bina tenaga pada tiga dan empat.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Letakkan jari 1 rata merentasi keenam-enam tali pada fret 1 dan bina bentuk E di hadapannya. Belum mampu? Gunakan F mini pada empat tali tinggi buat masa ini.

items.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C pada fret 1 tali 2, E terbuka dua kali, D pada fret 3, C lagi, kemudian A pada fret 2 tali 3.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Market Day meminjam gaya highlife, pop gitar cerah Ghana dan Nigeria: G, B minor, C dan D pada 104 detik seminit. Tarikan melodinya melantun di luar detik utama, jadi terus gerakkan badan.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, B terbuka, D lagi, E terbuka, kemudian kembali ke D dan B.

items.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Bar kedua mengekalkan irama bar pertama tetapi menukar satu not. Mengapa?

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar kedua menaikkan E ke F syap, not dalam B minor. Irama sama, kord baharu, not baharu.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Velvet Hour ialah neo-soul pada 74 detik seminit: empat kord ketujuh yang kaya melangkah turun, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 dan Cmaj7. Strum sekali pada satu, kemudian sapukan ke atas lembut pada “dan”.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fmaj7 ialah F mini dengan tali 1 dibiarkan terbuka. Em7 menggunakan satu jari: jari 2 pada tali 5, fret 2, semua tali lain terbuka. Dm7 dan Cmaj7 sudah anda kenali daripada Rain on the Skylight.

items.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord menurun F, E, D. Di manakah gelung berakhir?

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Setiap kord berada selangkah di bawah yang sebelumnya, dan perjalanan berakhir pada C, kord tonik.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · title

items.source: An anthem with a key change
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: Lagu semangat dengan pertukaran nada dasar

items.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rooftop Choir ialah lagu semangat berskala stadium pada 92 detik seminit. Anda memainkan korus dalam C, kemudian satu bar A menaikkan semuanya satu ton, dan korus kembali dalam D.

items.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Pertukaran nada dasar naik satu ton menaikkan setiap not sebanyak…

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Satu ton ialah dua semiton, dan setiap fret ialah semiton. C menjadi D, dan G menjadi A.

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 4 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 6 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · title

items.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Kord manakah menaikkan Rooftop Choir dari C ke D?

items.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A membawa pulang ke D. Mendarat padanya menghalakan seluruh lagu ke nada dasar baharu.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · title

items.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · unit summary
items.translation: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, pop suram, indie pop dan penamat 6/8, dengan lima kord barre baharu.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ialah synth-pop pada 118 detik seminit: F syap minor, D, A dan E. Strumnya didahulukan: dua hentakan jatuh pada “dan”, sejurus sebelum detik.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Barre jari 1 merentasi keenam-enam tali pada fret 2, kemudian letakkan jari 3 dan 4 pada tali 5 dan 4 di fret 4: bentuk E minor, dinaikkan dua fret.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bright Side of the Block ialah lagu gospel-pop untuk nyanyian bersama dalam D pada 100 detik seminit: D, F syap minor, G dan A. Tepuk pada dua dan empat dan nyanyikan korus seolah-olah seluruh jalan turut serta.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Barre jari 1 merentasi tali 5 hingga 1 pada fret 2, kemudian bina bentuk A minor dua fret lebih tinggi dengan jari 2, 3 dan 4. Biarkan tali 6 senyap.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, E terbuka, G pada fret 3 tali 1, F syap pada fret 2, E, G, kemudian E.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Over You Soon ialah pop suram dalam B minor pada 84 detik seminit: B minor, G, D dan A. Strum sekali pada satu, kemudian strum ke atas lembut pada “dan”, dan kekalkan suasana senyap.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 1, F syap pada fret 2, D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian F syap, E terbuka dan D.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ialah indie pop pada 124 detik seminit: E, B, C syap minor dan A, gelung empat kord dengan dua barre. Gerakkan kuaver stabil dan biarkan mengalir.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B ialah bentuk A yang dibarre pada fret 2: jari 1 merentasi tali 5 hingga 1, tiga jari pada fret 4. C syap minor ialah bentuk A minor yang dibarre pada fret 4.

items.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G syap pada fret 4 tali 1, F syap, E terbuka, B terbuka, kemudian D syap pada fret 4 tali 2, C syap, D syap.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Constellation Prize menutup kursus: lagu semangat dalam 6/8 pada 126 kiraan seminit, dalam F. F dan B flet kedua-duanya barre, dengan C dan D minor di antaranya.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Barre jari 1 merentasi tali 5 hingga 1 pada fret 1, kemudian letakkan jari 2, 3 dan 4 pada tali 4, 3 dan 2 di fret 3. Biarkan tali 6 senyap.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, F pada fret 1 tali 1 dua kali, G pada fret 3, F dua kali, E terbuka, kemudian F.

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · title

items.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F syap minor ialah bentuk apa yang dibarre pada fret 2?

items.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Barre pada fret 2 dan bentuk E minor berada di hadapan jari pertama: F syap minor.

items.context: Standards & Classics course · title

items.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
items.context: Standards & Classics course · course subtitle
items.translation: Lagu terkenal yang dikenali semua, dari mula hingga tamat

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 “Campfire singalongs” · title

items.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 “Campfire singalongs” · unit summary
items.translation: Lagu rakyat dan lagu rohani yang boleh dinyanyikan semua, dengan carta kord ringkas untuk strum.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini bermula sebagai lagu rohani. Pada tahun 1890-an, pekerja kereta api di Midwest memberinya lirik baharu, dan Carl Sandburg mencetaknya pada 1927. Ia menaik dari B rendah ke D pada tali 2.

items.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Baris pertama: D terbuka, E, empat G terbuka, turun ke B pada tali 5, kemudian kembali ke G.

items.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Perkataan She'll be hadir sebelum detik pertama. Apakah namanya?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Anakrusis ialah beberapa not yang membawa ke detik kuat pertama. Di sini ia menuju suku kata com-.

items.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: Tiga kord: G, C dan D7

items.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan lagu berada pada G. D7 hadir pada akhir baris kedua, dan C mewarnai baris keempat. Tukar pada perkataan yang memulakan bar.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu rohani Afrika Amerika ini lebih tua daripada Perang Saudara dan mula-mula dicetak pada 1918. Baris ain't gonna study war no more menjadi lagu gerakan keamanan.

items.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lay down my burden: B terbuka, turun ke D terbuka, kemudian naik melalui E, G dan A ke B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A syap berada di antara A dan B, pada fret 3 tali 3. Ia menggelongsor naik menuju B terbuka, kenaikan bernuansa blues yang memberikan bunyi khas gospel.

items.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A syap pada fret 3, B, kemudian A dan G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · title

items.source: The high road and the low road
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu Scotland ini mula-mula dicetak pada 1841. Jalan rendah sering ditafsirkan sebagai jalan roh askar pulang, lebih cepat daripada orang hidup di jalan tinggi.

items.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: By yon bonnie banks: D terbuka, kemudian G, G, A, B dan turun semula ke G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi ini bergerak dalam krocet dan pasangan kuaver. Kira satu, dua-dan, tiga, empat-dan, dan ayunannya akan hadir sendiri.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu ini dicetak pada 1876 dan dikreditkan pada 1884 kepada James Yorkston dari Edinburgh. Kini ia lagu kebanggaan tidak rasmi Dublin, dan Molly bersama keretanya diabadikan sebagai patung di kota itu.

items.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: In Dublin's fair city: D terbuka, empat G terbuka, naik ke B terbuka dan kembali ke G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kira satu, dua, tiga dan tekankan satu. Dalam banyak bar, not tengah panjang: satu, dua, dan not pantas sejurus sebelum satu seterusnya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cecil Sharp mengumpulkan dan menerbitkan balada ini pada 1906, daripada rangkap yang berasal dari abad 1700-an. Mainkan perlahan dan biarkan setiap not panjang berbunyi.

items.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: naik dari D terbuka ke B, kemudian turun perlahan semula ke D.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Wide berbunyi dua detik dan two selama dua setengah detik. Terus mengira semasa tali berbunyi supaya perkataan seterusnya jatuh tepat pada masa.

items.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Perkataan manakah ditahan merentasi dua not dalam rangkap pertama?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Fly bermula pada C dan menggelongsor turun ke A panjang. Penyanyi memanggil satu suku kata merentasi beberapa not sebagai melisma.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tiada not baharu: lima lagu daripada unit ini, satu demi satu, sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya. Kenal pasti setiap satu daripada not pertamanya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · title

items.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · unit summary
items.translation: Lagu dodoi Wales, lagu bot Tanah Tinggi Scotland dan tiga karol, dalam bahasa Jerman, Latin dan Inggeris.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi Ar Hyd y Nos dicetak di Wales pada 1784, dan Harold Boulton menulis lirik bahasa Inggeris ini pada 1884. Satu frasa hadir tiga kali, dengan frasa lebih tinggi di tengah.

items.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: G terbuka, turun ke F syap dan E, kemudian G, A, G, F syap dan D.

items.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Frasa manakah dalam rangkap menaik paling tinggi?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Frasa ketiga, soft the drowsy hours, menaik ke C, D dan E. Tiga frasa lain berkongsi satu melodi.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Harold Boulton memadankan lirik ini pada 1884 dengan melodi mendayung Tanah Tinggi Scotland yang dikumpulkan Anne MacLeod. Ia menceritakan Bonnie Prince Charlie melarikan diri ke Pulau Skye pada 1746.

items.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lagu ini berayun dalam enam-lapan: dua detik besar setiap bar, setiap satu dibahagi tiga. Kira satu-dua-tiga, empat-lima-enam, seperti dayung ditarik dan dikembalikan.

items.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: D terbuka, E, D, tiga G terbuka, kemudian A, B, A dan naik ke D.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ernst Anschütz menulis lirik ini di Leipzig pada 1824, untuk melodi rakyat yang jauh lebih lama. Anda akan menyanyikannya dalam bahasa Jerman, bahasa asal liriknya.

items.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: D terbuka, tiga G terbuka, kemudian A pada fret 2 dan tiga B terbuka.

items.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tan-nen ialah not bertitik dan not sangat pendek, kemudian baum terus berbunyi. Sebut lirik semasa mengetuk, dan iramanya akan menyusul.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Himne Latin Adeste Fideles dicetak bersama melodi ini pada 1751, dan lirik bahasa Inggeris Frederick Oakeley menyusul pada 1841. Anda akan menyanyikan satu rangkap dalam setiap bahasa.

items.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: O come, all ye faithful: G terbuka dua kali, turun ke D terbuka, kembali ke G, A dan D lagi.

items.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa kali ulangan menyanyikan O come, let us adore him?

items.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tiga kali, setiap satu sedikit lebih tinggi, sebelum Christ the Lord membawa melodi kembali ke asal.

items.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: Himne Latin (1751); lirik Inggeris Frederick Oakeley (1841)

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Karol ini mula-mula dicetak pada 1823, dalam koleksi karol Krismas lama. Melodinya menaiki skala dan kembali, sebab itulah ia begitu mudah diingati.

items.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naiki skala D: F syap dan E, D terbuka, kemudian E, F syap, G terbuka, A, B terbuka, C syap pada fret 2 dan D.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Melodi bermula dengan dua not pantas, F syap dan E, sebelum detik pertama. Kemudian D panjang dan rangkaian kuaver menaik ke A.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 6 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lima lagu daripada unit ini: dua balada dan tiga karol. Tiada not baharu, hanya satu demi satu, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya.

items.source: Which of these counts in six?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Manakah antara ini dikira dalam enam?

items.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: The Skye Boat Song berayun dalam enam-lapan. O Christmas Tree dalam tiga, dan All Through the Night dalam empat.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · title

items.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · unit summary
items.translation: Mars bagpaip, tarian rakyat Rusia, Blue Danube dan can-can.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mars Scotland ini telah dicetak menjelang 1878, dan pancaragam bagpaip memainkannya di seluruh dunia. Pemain bagpaip memainkannya tanpa lirik, begitu juga anda.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Not bertitik dan not pantas memberikan rentak tajam kepada mars: panjang, kemudian pendek. Dalam bar pertama, D kedua panjang dan E masuk sejurus sebelum detik kedua.

items.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naiki kord D: D terbuka dua kali, E, F syap pada fret 4, D, F syap, A, kemudian D pada tali 2.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 5 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 6 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Puisi Nikolay Nekrasov tentang penjaja yang mengembara dicetak pada 1861, dan melodi rakyat ini diterbitkan bersamanya pada 1898. Sebuah permainan video menjadikannya terkenal di seluruh dunia hampir satu abad kemudian.

items.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Pembukaan: B terbuka, turun ke F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, naik G dan A, kemudian G, F syap, E.

items.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Separuh kedua mencapai lebih tinggi: A, C pada fret 1 tali 2, E terbuka, kemudian turun D, C, B dan G.

items.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Melodi ini dalam E minor. Not manakah terasa seperti tempat asal?

items.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Kedua-dua separuh berakhir pada E, not asal E minor. Anda mendengarnya sebagai tempat melodi berehat.
