Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johann Strauss II mula-mula mempersembahkan waltz ini di Vienna pada 1867, dan Vienna masih memainkannya setiap Hari Tahun Baharu. Melodinya menaiki kord, kemudian menjawab dengan dua not tinggi.

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G pada fret 3 tali 6 dua kali, B pada tali 5, D terbuka, kemudian lompat naik ke D pada fret 3 tali 2 dan turun ke B terbuka.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap frasa bermula rendah pada tali bes dan melompat naik satu oktaf. Lihat not tinggi sebelum memainkan not rendah supaya tangan tahu ke mana hendak bergerak.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 5 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jacques Offenbach menulis galop ini untuk opereta Orpheus in the Underworld pada 1858. Dewan tari Paris kemudian menjadikannya muzik can-can.

items.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka panjang, kemudian A, C, B, A, dan dua D pada fret 3 tali 2.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan melodi bergerak dalam kuaver. Kekalkan gerakan plektrum kecil dan selang-selikan bawah dan atas supaya tidak ketinggalan.

items.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Rangkaian besar: G terbuka, lompat ke G pada fret 3 tali 1, kemudian melangkah turun hingga A.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat melodi daripada unit ini: mars bagpaip, lagu rakyat Rusia, waltz Vienna dan galop Perancis. Setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Manakah antara ini waltz, dalam tiga?

items.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Waltz dikira satu, dua, tiga. Can-can dan mars bagpaip kedua-duanya dikira dalam empat.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · title

items.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · unit summary
items.translation: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet dan Grieg: sinkopasi, enam-lapan dan pertukaran nada dasar.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Scott Joplin menerbitkan The Entertainer pada 1902, dan filem pada 1973 menjadikannya terkenal semula. Dalam ragtime, melodi bergerak di luar detik utama sementara bes mengekalkan masa yang stabil.

items.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, D syap pada fret 1, E pada fret 2 tali 4, kemudian lompat ke C pada fret 1 tali 2 dan kembali, tiga kali.

items.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sinkopasi meletakkan aksen di antara detik. Dalam pembukaan, setiap C jatuh pada “dan”. Kira satu-dan-dua-dan dan rasai C mendahului detik.

items.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Rangkaian penamat mengelilingi C, D dan E pada tali 2 dan 1, kemudian melalui B dan D untuk mendarat pada C.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: John Philip Sousa menerbitkan The Liberty Bell pada 1893, dan komedi televisyen British kemudian menjadikannya lagu tema. Ia dalam enam-lapan: dua detik besar setiap bar, seperti kiri, kanan.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak detik bermula dengan senyap pendek. Hentikan tali dengan tangan pada fret, kemudian masuk semula pada kuaver seterusnya.

items.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka tiga kali, A syap pada fret 3 tali 3, B lagi, kemudian naik ke G pada tali 1 dan turun D, D, B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 5 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 6 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Opera Carmen oleh Georges Bizet mula dipentaskan di Paris pada 1875. Preludnya bermula dengan mars meriah ini, kemudian memainkan melodi Toreador Song yang terkenal.

items.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Empat A pada fret 2 tali 3, kemudian turun ke E pada fret 2 tali 4, D terbuka dan E.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mars dalam A major, dengan C syap dan G syap. Melodi Toreador beralih ke F major, dengan B flet pada fret 3 tali 3. Perhatikan pertukarannya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Apakah yang berlaku pada akhir melodi Toreador?

items.source: It climbs to a long E
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Ia menaik ke E tinggi yang panjang, not yang membawa kembali ke A major untuk mars.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Edvard Grieg menulis Morning Mood pada 1875 untuk drama Peer Gynt. Flut memainkan tema, obo menjawab, dan muzik menaik seperti matahari terbit.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tema hanya menggunakan G, A, B, D dan E. Skala lima not seperti ini dipanggil pentatonik, dan berbunyi tenang serta terbuka.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, B terbuka, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G terbuka, kemudian naik semula A dan B.

items.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Berapa not berbeza digunakan oleh tema?

items.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G, A, B, D dan E: skala pentatonik. Tiada C dan tiada F syap dalam seluruh tema.

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat karya daripada unit ini, berturut-turut: ragtime, mars, prelud opera dan matahari terbit. Setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat daripada sebelumnya.

items.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Antara karya ini, manakah yang hanya menggunakan lima not dalam temanya?

items.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Tema Morning Mood ialah pentatonik: G, A, B, D dan E. Yang lain menggunakan jauh lebih banyak.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · title

items.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · unit summary
items.translation: Empat karol Krismas untuk dinyanyikan dalam cahaya lilin: Wesley dan Mendelssohn, lagu dodoi, serta dua melodi dari Amerika.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Charles Wesley menulis liriknya pada 1739. Pada 1856, pemain organ Inggeris memadankannya dengan melodi daripada karya koral Felix Mendelssohn, dan karol itu dinyanyikan begitu sejak itu.

items.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, G terbuka dua kali, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, G, kemudian B terbuka dua kali dan A pada fret 2 tali 3.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Her-ald ialah panjang-pendek: her- jatuh pada tiga dan ditahan, dan -ald masuk pada “dan” selepas empat. Kira satu, dua, tiga, empat-dan.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Korus bergerak C, A minor, D7 dan G. Tukar pada perkataan yang memulakan setiap separuh bar, dan kekalkan strum ringan di bawah E tinggi.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lirik ini mula-mula muncul dalam buku kanak-kanak Amerika pada 1885, dan James R. Murray memberinya melodi lembut ini pada 1887. Ia berayun dalam tiga, seperti buaian.

items.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Ia bermula tinggi: D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian melangkah turun C, B, A, G dan F syap hingga D terbuka.

items.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Baris pertama menurun dari D tinggi ke D rendah. Berapa jaraknya?

items.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D turun ke D ialah oktaf: lapan langkah skala, nama not yang sama, satu julat lebih rendah.

items.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tahan G untuk kebanyakan baris, C untuk crib for a bed, dan D7 untuk membawa pulang. Dalam tiga, strum ke bawah pada satu dan ringan pada dua serta tiga.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: Tanpa nama (1885); rangkap 3 John T. McFarland (1892)

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Phillips Brooks menulis lirik ini pada 1868 untuk kanak-kanak gerejanya di Philadelphia, dan pemain organnya, Lewis Redner, menulis melodi untuk upacara Krismas mereka.

items.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka tiga kali, A syap pada fret 3 tali 3, B lagi, kemudian D, C dan turun ke E pada tali 4.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A syap pada fret 3 tali 3 cenderung ke B terbuka, semiton menaik. Ia memberikan ayunan lembut kepada O little town.

items.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Perkataan manakah turun ke D rendah dalam rangkap pertama?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Thee, dalam how still we see thee lie

items.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: How still we see thee lie: melodi turun ke D terbuka pada thee, kemudian naik ke B pada lie.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · title
items.translation: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Edmund Sears menulis lirik ini di Massachusetts pada 1849, dan Richard Storrs Willis menulis melodinya setahun kemudian. Ia berayun dalam dua detik besar setiap bar, setiap satu dibahagi tiga.

items.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dalam enam-lapan, krocet dan kuaver membentuk satu detik besar: panjang, pendek. Kira satu-dua-tiga, empat-lima-enam, dan mainkan pada satu, tiga, empat dan enam.

items.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, lompat ke E terbuka pada tali 1, kemudian B, D, C, A, dan kembali ke G melalui A.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bahagian tengah rangkap turun ke E rendah dan menaik melalui G syap, pada fret 1 tali 3, ke A. Di bawahnya, kord bergerak dari E7 ke A minor.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Empat karol daripada unit ini, satu demi satu, setiap satu sedikit lebih cepat. Kekalkan kord lembut dan biarkan melodi bernyanyi.

items.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Antara karol ini, manakah yang dikira dalam tiga?

items.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Away in a Manger ialah waltz: satu, dua, tiga. Dua yang lain dikira dalam empat.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · title

items.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · unit summary
items.translation: Karol pembukaan King's College, karol pertengahan musim sejuk Holst, karol rakyat dan perarakan megah.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander menulis lirik ini untuk kanak-kanak pada 1848. Sejak 1919, satu suara muda menyanyikan rangkap pertama untuk membuka karol malam Krismas di King's College, Cambridge.

items.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, G terbuka, kemudian gerakan: G, F syap, G, A, A, G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Da-vid's membahagikan setiap suku kata merentasi dua kuaver. Mainkan kedua-duanya, tetapi nyanyikan sebagai satu bunyi yang lancar.

items.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Di manakah not tertinggi karol ini?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mary was that mother mild bermula pada E terbuka, not tertinggi melodi.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · title

items.source: A poem and a quiet tune
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Christina Rossetti menulis puisi ini pada 1872, dan Gustav Holst menggubah muziknya untuk buku himne pada 1906. Barisnya pendek dan tenang, seperti salji turun.

items.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka dua kali, C pada fret 1 dan D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian turun semula B, A dan G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Banyak perkataan jatuh pada minim: -ter dalam mid-winter, i-ron. Biarkan setiap satu berbunyi selama dua detik penuh sebelum meneruskan.

items.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Long ago memanjangkan tiga suku kata merentasi berapa not?

items.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Long menggunakan dua not, a- dua, dan go satu: lima not untuk tiga suku kata.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Di bawah frost-y wind made moan, kord bergerak dari A minor ke D7, tarikan yang membawa baris kembali ke G.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Karol ini berusia berabad-abad. Pengumpul lagu Cecil Sharp mendengarnya dinyanyikan di sebuah pekan Cotswold dan mencetak melodi ini pada 1911. Ia menari dalam tiga.

items.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Empat G terbuka, kemudian lompat ke E terbuka pada tali 1, turun ke D pada fret 3 tali 2 dan B terbuka.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dari G terbuka ke E terbuka ialah selang keenam. Kekalkan plektrum dekat dengan tali dan beralih dari tali 3 ke tali 1 dalam satu gerakan.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · title
items.translation: Angels from the Realms of Glory

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: James Montgomery mencetak lirik ini dalam akhbar Sheffield miliknya pada malam Krismas, 1816. Melodi Henry Smart dari 1867 memberinya bunyi perarakan yang megah.

items.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A pada tali 3, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, D pada fret 3 tali 2, A, kemudian F syap pada fret 2 tali 1, E dan D.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nada dasar ini mempunyai dua syap, F syap dan C syap. C syap terletak pada fret 2 tali 2.

items.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Karol daripada unit ini, berturut-turut. Kebanyakannya bergerak dalam not panjang: biarkan setiap satu berbunyi sepanjang tempohnya sebelum yang seterusnya.

items.source: Which of these counts in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Manakah antara ini dikira dalam tiga?

items.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.

items.translation: The Holly and the Ivy dalam tiga. Dua yang lain dikira dalam empat.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 “Hymns everyone knows” · title

items.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 “Hymns everyone knows” · unit summary
items.translation: Lima himne hebat dengan not panjang yang bernyanyi, dari 1708 hingga 1861.

items.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · title
items.translation: O God, Our Help in Ages Past

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: William Croft menulis melodi St Anne ini pada 1708, dan lirik Isaac Watts mula-mula dicetak pada 1719. Setiap rangkap mempunyai empat baris pendek, bentuk himne paling ringkas.

items.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, E pada fret 2 tali 4, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G, kemudian C pada fret 1 tali 2, C, B terbuka dan C.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap baris bermula pada detik sebelum bar: O, our, our, and. Kira empat, kemudian nyanyikan perkataan pertama padanya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Carta menggunakan A minor, F dan G7. God, our berada pada A minor, dan a-ges past bergerak dari G7 ke C.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Reginald Heber menulis lirik ini, dicetak pada 1826, dan John Bacchus Dykes menulis melodinya pada 1861. Baris pertama menaiki not kord G major.

items.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Naiki kord G: G terbuka dua kali, B terbuka dua kali, kemudian D pada fret 3 tali 2, ditahan panjang.

items.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Holy, holy, holy menaiki not apa?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G, B dan D ialah not kord G major, jadi melodi menaiki kord itu sendiri.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Himne ini bergerak dalam not panjang: minim dua detik dan semibrif empat detik pada akhir. Kira setiap detik, walaupun not masih berbunyi.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Henry Francis Lyte menulis lirik ini pada 1847, dan William Henry Monk menulis melodi Eventide untuknya pada 1861. Penonton bola sepak di England menyanyikannya sebelum perlawanan akhir piala sejak 1927.

items.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka dua kali, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G terbuka, kemudian D pada fret 3 dan E pada tali 1, kembali melalui D dan C ke B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap not di sini ialah krocet, minim atau semibrif. Kira empat detik stabil setiap bar dan biarkan not panjang berbunyi.

items.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Not manakah membawa ke D pada akhir baris kedua?

items.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C syap, pada fret 2 tali 2, menaik semiton ke D, seperti fungsi not pengantar.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sarah Flower Adams menulis lirik ini di London pada 1841, dan Lowell Mason, guru muzik Amerika, memberinya melodi ini pada 1856.

items.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B terbuka, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G terbuka dua kali, kemudian E pada fret 2 tali 4 dua kali.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap baris mempunyai pasangan panjang-pendek: krocet bertitik, kemudian kuaver pantas, seperti dalam -er, my dan God, to. Biarkan not panjang mengalir menuju not pendek.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: For the Beauty of the Earth
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · title
items.translation: For the Beauty of the Earth

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Folliott Pierpoint menulis lirik ini pada 1864, pada hari musim bunga di desa England. Ia dinyanyikan dengan Dix, melodi Jerman dari 1838.

items.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, G, A pada fret 2 tali 3, G, kemudian C pada fret 1 tali 2 dua kali dan B terbuka.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: For the bermula dengan dua kuaver pada the: F syap dan G, satu suku kata dinyanyikan merentasi kedua-duanya. Mainkan sekata dalam satu detik.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Himne daripada unit ini, berturut-turut, daripada melodi tertua hingga terbaharu. Biarkan not panjang berbunyi dan tukar kord pada perkataan yang ditetapkan.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Antara melodi ini, manakah yang tertua?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: William Croft menulis St Anne pada 1708, hampir 150 tahun sebelum dua yang lain.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 “Parlor songs and a planet” · title
items.translation: Lagu ruang tamu dan sebuah planet

items.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 “Parlor songs and a planet” · unit summary
items.translation: Tiga lagu yang dinyanyikan keluarga di sekeliling piano, kemudian Jupiter karya Holst.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Henry Bishop menulis melodi ini untuk opera London pada 1823, dengan lirik oleh pelakon Amerika John Howard Payne. Dalam beberapa tahun, ia menjadi antara lagu paling disayangi di dunia.

items.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G terbuka, A pada fret 2 tali 3, B terbuka, C pada fret 1 dan D pada fret 3 tali 2, kemudian kembali ke B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rangkap bermula sejurus sebelum detik pertama, pada kuaver bertitik dan semikuaver. Kira empat-e-dan-a: 'Mid jatuh pada empat, dan gerakan pendeknya pada a.

items.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Korus bermula pada satu not panjang. Berapa lamakah tempohnya?

items.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Home! ialah semibrif: tahan D pada fret 3 tali 2 sepanjang bar.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · title
items.translation: Hard Times Come Again No More

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster menerbitkan lagu ini pada 1854. Ia meminta pendengar berhenti dan memikirkan golongan kurang berkemampuan, dan penyanyi masih kembali kepadanya hingga kini.

items.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, E dan F syap pada tali 4, tiga lagi F syap, kemudian A pada fret 2 tali 3 dan kembali ke F syap.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The verse sings several words on one note. Keep each F sharp short and even, and let the words carry the line.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Rangkap menyanyikan beberapa perkataan pada satu not. Kekalkan setiap F syap pendek dan sekata, dan biarkan lirik membawa baris itu.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Korus menaik ke G di bawah not panjang pada wear-y, kemudian berehat pada D untuk hard times. A7 membawa setiap baris kembali ke asal.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Thomas Moore memadankan lirik ini dengan melodi Ireland lama dan mencetaknya pada 1813. Kemudian, Mendelssohn menulis fantasia berdasarkan melodi itu, dan Flotow memasukkannya dalam opera Martha.

items.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D terbuka, E dan F syap pada tali 4, kemudian lompat ke D pada fret 3 tali 2, dan turun C syap, B dan A.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Kebanyakan detik dibahagi panjang-pendek: kuaver bertitik dan semikuaver. Mainkan not panjang sepenuhnya dan biarkan not pendek membawa ke detik seterusnya.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Di tengah, no rosebud is nigh menaik melalui A syap ke B. Kord bertukar ke B minor di situ, saat paling sedih dalam lagu.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gustav Holst menulis The Planets antara 1914 dan 1916. Melodi luas ini ialah inti Jupiter. Pada 1921, beliau menjadikannya melodi himne dan menamakannya Thaxted, sempena pekan tempat tinggalnya.

items.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E pada fret 2 tali 4, G terbuka, A pada fret 2, kemudian C pada fret 1 tali 2, B terbuka, G, dan naik C, D, C, B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Bahagian tengah melodi turun ke C pada fret 3 tali 5. Capai dengan jari ketiga, kemudian terus kembali ke tali 4.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Like a slow waltz: one, two, three. Each phrase starts with two eighth notes before beat one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Seperti waltz perlahan: satu, dua, tiga. Setiap frasa bermula dengan dua kuaver sebelum detik pertama.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Before records, families sang these songs around the piano at home. Here they are back to back, with Holst's big tune to finish.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sebelum adanya rakaman, keluarga menyanyikan lagu ini di sekeliling piano di rumah. Di sini semuanya berturut-turut, dengan melodi besar Holst sebagai penamat.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Antonio Vivaldi menerbitkan empat konserto biola yang dipanggil The Four Seasons pada 1725. Spring bermula dengan melodi cerah ini, kemudian biola solo memainkan kicauan burung dan anak sungai yang mengalir.

items.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E pada fret 2 tali 4, G syap pada fret 1 tali 3 tiga kali, F syap pada fret 4 tali 4, E, kemudian B terbuka.

items.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nada dasar E mempunyai empat syap. Dalam kedudukan pertama, G syap pada fret 1 tali 3, D syap pada fret 1 tali 4, dan C syap pada fret 2 tali 2.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Setiap detik boleh dibahagi kepada empat semikuaver. Dalam tema, pasangan F syap, E pantas jatuh pada separuh kedua detik kedua.

items.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mozart menerbitkan rondo ini pada 1784 sebagai gerakan terakhir sonata piano. Marsnya meniru bunyi pancaragam tentera Turki, yang digemari Vienna ketika itu.

items.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B pada fret 2 tali 5, A terbuka, G syap pada fret 4 tali 6, A, kemudian C pada fret 3 tali 5, D terbuka, C, B dan C.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tema mengelilingi A: B, A, G syap, A. Setiap pusingan ialah empat semikuaver. Kemudian ia menaik selangkah dan mengelilingi lagi.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Mars bergerak dari A minor ke A major: C menjadi C syap, pada fret 2 tali 2. Melodi tiba-tiba berbunyi cerah.

Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: John Philip Sousa menulis mars ini pada akhir 1896, dan ia diterbitkan pada 1897. Ia ialah mars kebangsaan rasmi Amerika Syarikat. Inilah melodi trio besarnya.

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D pada fret 3 tali 2, C pada fret 1, B terbuka, kemudian turun ke A syap pada fret 3 tali 3 dan kembali ke B.

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The trio holds notes across the bar line. Keep counting through them: one, two, three, four, then on into the next bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Trio menahan not merentasi garisan bar. Terus mengira sepanjang not itu: satu, dua, tiga, empat, kemudian terus ke bar seterusnya.

items.source: The tune keeps dipping a half step below B. Which note is that?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Melodi kerap turun semiton di bawah B. Not apakah itu?

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A sharp, at fret 3 on string 3, sits a half step below open B and leans right back into it.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A syap, pada fret 3 tali 3, berada semiton di bawah B terbuka dan cenderung kembali kepadanya.

items.translation: Antara karya ini, manakah yang ditulis untuk pancaragam?
